seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Tysiące bezpłatnych stacji radiowych na żywo, uporządkowanych według gatunku — pop, jazz, rozmowy, wiadomości, przeboje i nie tylko. Przeglądaj {link1} lub przejdź do zakładki Radio nad kulą ziemską.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Transmisje na żywo z kamer z miast, charakterystycznych obiektów, plaż i miejsc przyrodniczych na całym świecie — bezpłatnie i bez rejestracji. Przeglądaj {link1} lub przejdź do zakładki Kamera internetowa nad kulą ziemską.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Każdy kanał jest również uporządkowany według języka – w sumie ponad 84 – dzięki czemu możesz znaleźć coś do obejrzenia w języku, w którym faktycznie mówisz, a nie tylko w kraju, który przeglądasz.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Każdy z ponad 200 krajów objętych programem FreeTV Garden ma własną dedykowaną stronę z kanałami — wybierz swój poniżej lub przeglądaj według kontynentu z pełnej listy.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden nie jest dostępny w Sklepie Play ani App Store — można go zainstalować bezpośrednio z przeglądarki, na dowolnym urządzeniu, za pomocą kilku kliknięć.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Otwórz Chrome (lub inną przeglądarkę obsługującą instalacje internetowe) i przejdź do freetvgarden.com. Poszukaj ikony instalacji na pasku adresu lub otwórz menu przeglądarki i wybierz „Dodaj do ekranu głównego” / „Zainstaluj aplikację”. FreeTV Garden otworzy się wówczas na ekranie głównym w trybie pełnoekranowym, podobnie jak aplikacja natywna, bez konieczności pobierania ze Sklepu Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Otwórz stronę freetvgarden.com w przeglądarce Safari. Kliknij ikonę Udostępnij, a następnie „Dodaj do ekranu głównego”. Spowoduje to dodanie ikony aplikacji do Twojego iPhone'a lub iPada, która uruchomi witrynę na pełnym ekranie — nie jest wymagana lista App Store i nie trzeba niczego aktualizować.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Otwórz wbudowaną przeglądarkę telewizora i przejdź do witryny freetvgarden.com. Jeśli Twój telewizor nie ma działającej przeglądarki, prześlij stronę z telefonu lub laptopa za pomocą Chromecasta lub AirPlay, aby zamiast tego oglądać na dużym ekranie.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Otwórz przeglądarkę Silk (preinstalowaną na urządzeniach Fire TV lub bezpłatną z Amazon Appstore) i przejdź do freetvgarden.com. Wybierz kraj lub kategorię i zacznij oglądać — nie jest wymagana subskrypcja ani dodatkowa aplikacja.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Działa każda nowoczesna przeglądarka komputerowa — wystarczy odwiedzić stronę freetvgarden.com. W przeglądarce Chrome lub Edge na pasku adresu pojawia się ikona instalacji, która umożliwia dodanie aplikacji jako aplikacji komputerowej; w przeciwnym razie będzie działać poprawnie jako zwykła karta przeglądarki.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Czy FreeTV Garden jest naprawdę darmowy?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Tak. Nie musisz się rejestrować, subskrybować ani płacić w żadnym momencie — po prostu wybierz kraj lub kanał i zacznij oglądać.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Czy tv.garden to to samo co FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nie. W 2026 roku nazwa pierwotnego serwisu tv.garden została zmieniona na Famelack i nie używa już nazwy TV Garden. FreeTV Garden to osobna, niezależnie prowadzona witryna — niezwiązana z Famelack ani oryginalnym tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Czy FreeTV Garden ma te same funkcje co TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Tak, i jeszcze więcej. FreeTV Garden oferuje takie same możliwości podróżowania po świecie i wybierania kraju, a także ponad 84 filtry językowe, ponad 25 kategorii treści, odtwarzanie obrazu w obrazie, ulubione, które możesz oznaczać gwiazdką i do których powracasz, przycisk losowego kanału i instalację jednym dotknięciem bezpośrednio z Chrome lub Safari – nie jest potrzebny sklep z aplikacjami.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Czy FreeTV Garden posiada także radio i kamery internetowe?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Tak. FreeTV Garden ma także zakładkę Radio ze stacjami na żywo z różnych gatunków, takich jak Pop, Jazz i Talk, oraz zakładkę Kamera internetowa z transmisjami na żywo z kamer z całego świata. Przełączaj karty nad kulą ziemską.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Czym FreeTV Garden różni się od radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden to odrębny, niezależnie prowadzony projekt – niezwiązany z radio.garden. Oferuje prostszy, bardziej intuicyjny interfejs z łatwiejszą nawigacją i wykracza poza radio z telewizją na żywo i kamerami internetowymi wbudowanymi w to samo bezpłatne narzędzie obsługiwane jednym dotknięciem.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Co się stało ze starą stroną FreeTool TV Garden w Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Tutaj wznowiono. Strona, która wcześniej znajdowała się pod adresem freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, to ten sam projekt, teraz działający pod własną nazwą i domeną: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Żadne konto nie jest potrzebne. FreeTV Garden nie wymaga podania adresu e-mail, hasła ani żadnych danych osobowych, aby móc oglądać.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: Czy to działa na urządzeniach mobilnych?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Tak — FreeTV Garden działa w dowolnej nowoczesnej przeglądarce mobilnej na Androidzie lub iPhonie i można go dodać do ekranu głównego, aby uzyskać dostęp jednym dotknięciem (patrz sekcja Instalacja powyżej).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanały to transmisje na żywo pochodzące od nadawców publicznych, więc niektóre z nich tymczasowo przestają działać z powodu problemów z serwerem nadawcy. Wypróbuj inny kanał lub sprawdź później — większość wraca w ciągu kilku minut do godzin.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden agreguje publicznie dostępne transmisje na żywo — głównie z katalogu społeczności iptv-org — i sama nie hostuje ani nie przechowuje żadnych plików wideo. Aby uzyskać więcej informacji, zobacz sekcję „Prawo i bezpieczeństwo” poniżej.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Odpowiedzi na więcej pytań znajdują się w pełnym {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden gromadzi publicznie dostępne transmisje na żywo z bezpłatnych, publicznych źródeł, w tym z katalogu społeczności iptv-org. Nie hostuje ani nie przechowuje żadnych plików wideo ani audio i nie wymaga konta do użycia.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Masz pytania, opinie lub kanał do zaproponowania? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Cum să vizionați {countryName} TV pe dispozitivul dvs

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Nu este nevoie de nicio aplicație sau cont pentru a viziona {countryName} canale. Această pagină funcționează direct în browserul dvs. pe orice dispozitiv - trebuie doar să atingeți un canal și să apăsați pe redare.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Deschideți această pagină în Chrome, atingeți un canal {countryName} pentru a începe vizionarea, apoi folosiți butonul ecran complet pentru cea mai bună vizualizare. Pentru acces rapid data viitoare, atingeți meniul Chrome și alegeți „Adăugați la ecranul de pornire” pentru a crea o pictogramă asemănătoare aplicației.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Deschideți această pagină în Safari și atingeți orice canal {countryName} pentru a începe streamingul instantaneu. Atingeți pictograma Partajare și selectați „Adăugați la ecranul de pornire” pentru acces cu o singură atingere fără a descărca o aplicație din App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Orice browser modern funcționează - Chrome, Safari, Firefox sau Edge. Deschideți un canal {countryName} și folosiți pictograma pe ecran complet din player pentru o experiență de vizionare fără distracție, asemănătoare unui televizor.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Deschideți această pagină în browserul încorporat al televizorului sau proiectați-o de pe telefon sau laptop folosind Chromecast sau AirPlay pentru a viziona canale {countryName} pe ecranul mare.

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Vă conectați direct la serverul propriu al radiodifuzorului, așa că viteza și fiabilitatea depind de infrastructura lor, nu de a noastră. Dacă un canal nu se încarcă, încercați altul din listă.

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Da — playerul funcționează pe orice browser de telefon fără descărcare de aplicație. Doar deschideți această pagină, atingeți un canal de știri și utilizați ecranul complet pentru cea mai bună vizualizare.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Canalele TV în direct sunt organizate în peste 25 de categorii — Știri, Sport, Filme, Muzică, Copii, Documentare și multe altele — astfel încât să puteți naviga după ceea ce doriți să vizionați în loc să defilați prin toate.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Mii de posturi de radio live gratuite, organizate pe gen — Pop, Jazz, Talk, Știri, Oldies și multe altele. Răsfoiți {link1} sau comutați la fila Radio de deasupra globului.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Fluxuri live ale camerelor din orașe, repere, plaje și locuri naturale din întreaga lume - gratuit, fără înscriere. Răsfoiți {link1} sau comutați la fila Cameră web de deasupra globului.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Fiecare canal este, de asemenea, organizat în funcție de limbă – peste 84 în total – astfel încât să puteți găsi ceva de vizionat în limba pe care o vorbiți de fapt, nu doar în țara pe care o navigați.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Fiecare dintre cele peste 200 de țări FreeTV Garden are propria pagină dedicată de canale - alege-l pe a ta de mai jos sau răsfoiește-l pe continent din lista completă.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden nu se află în Play Store sau App Store – se instalează direct din browser, pe orice dispozitiv, în câteva atingeri.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Deschideți Chrome (sau alt browser care acceptă instalări web) și accesați freetvgarden.com. Căutați pictograma de instalare în bara de adrese sau deschideți meniul browserului și alegeți „Adăugați la ecranul de pornire” / „Instalați aplicația”. FreeTV Garden se va deschide apoi pe ecran complet de pe ecranul de pornire, la fel ca o aplicație nativă, fără a fi necesară descărcarea din Magazinul Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Deschide freetvgarden.com în Safari. Atinge pictograma Partajare, apoi „Adaugă la ecranul de pornire”. Acest lucru adaugă o pictogramă de aplicație pe iPhone sau iPad care lansează site-ul pe ecran complet - nu este necesară listarea App Store și nimic de actualizat.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Deschideți browserul încorporat al televizorului și navigați la freetvgarden.com. Dacă televizorul dvs. nu are un browser utilizabil, proiectați pagina de pe telefon sau laptop folosind Chromecast sau AirPlay pentru a viziona pe ecranul mare.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Deschideți Silk Browser (preinstalat pe dispozitivele Fire TV sau gratuit din Amazon Appstore) și accesați freetvgarden.com. Selectați o țară sau o categorie și începeți să vizionați - nu este nevoie de abonament sau aplicație suplimentară.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Orice browser modern de desktop funcționează - trebuie doar să vizitați freetvgarden.com. În Chrome sau Edge, o pictogramă de instalare apare în bara de adrese pentru ao adăuga ca aplicație desktop; în caz contrar, funcționează bine ca o filă obișnuită de browser.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Este FreeTV Garden cu adevărat gratuit?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Da. Nu există nicio înscriere, nici un abonament și nicio plată în niciun moment - doar alegeți o țară sau un canal și începeți să vizionați.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Este tv.garden la fel cu FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nu. Tv.garden original a devenit Famelack în 2026 și nu mai folosește numele TV Garden. FreeTV Garden este un site separat, administrat independent, care nu este afiliat cu Famelack sau cu tv.garden original.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden are aceleași caracteristici ca și TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Da, plus mai mult. FreeTV Garden are aceeași experiență de rotire a globului, de alegere a țării, împreună cu peste 84 de filtre de limbă, peste 25 de categorii de conținut, redare imagine în imagine, favorite pe care le puteți vedea cu stea și pe care le puteți revedea, un buton pentru canal aleatoriu și o instalare cu o singură atingere direct din Chrome sau Safari - nu este nevoie de magazin de aplicații.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden are și radio și camere web?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Da. FreeTV Garden are, de asemenea, o filă Radio cu posturi live din genuri precum Pop, Jazz și Talk și o filă Cameră web cu fluxuri live ale camerelor din întreaga lume. Comutați filele deasupra globului.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Cum este FreeTV Garden diferit de radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden este un proiect separat, condus independent, care nu este afiliat cu radio.garden. Oferă o interfață mai simplă, mai intuitivă, cu navigare mai ușoară și depășește radioul, cu TV live și camere web integrate în același instrument gratuit, cu o singură atingere.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Ce s-a întâmplat cu vechea pagină FreeTool TV Garden de pe Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: S-a relansat aici. Pagina care locuia pe vremuri la freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden este același proiect, care rulează acum sub propriul nume și domeniu: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Trebuie să îmi creez un cont?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Nu este nevoie de cont. FreeTV Garden nu cere un e-mail, o parolă sau orice detalii personale de urmărit.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Da — FreeTV Garden rulează în orice browser mobil modern pe Android sau iPhone și poate fi adăugat la ecranul de pornire pentru acces cu o singură atingere (consultați secțiunea Instalare de mai sus).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Canalele sunt streamuri live provenite de la radiodifuzori publici, așa că unele sunt temporar offline din cauza problemelor proprii cu serverul radiodifuzorului. Încercați alt canal sau verificați din nou mai târziu - majoritatea revin în câteva minute sau ore.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden reunește fluxurile live disponibile public – în principal din directorul comunității iptv-org – și nu găzduiește și nu stochează niciun fișier video. Consultați secțiunea Juridic și siguranță de mai jos pentru mai multe.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: La mai multe întrebări se răspunde pe {link1} integral.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden reunește fluxuri live disponibile public din surse publice gratuite, inclusiv directorul comunității iptv-org. Nu găzduiește și nu stochează niciun fișier video sau audio și nu necesită un cont pentru utilizare.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Întrebări, feedback sau un canal de sugerat? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Varför buffrar vissa {countryName}-kanaler eller inte laddas?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Du ansluter direkt till sändarens egen server, så hastighet och tillförlitlighet beror på deras infrastruktur, inte vår. Om en kanal inte laddas, prova en annan från listan.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden finns inte i Play Store eller App Store – den installeras direkt från din webbläsare istället, på vilken enhet som helst, med några få tryck.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Öppna Chrome (eller en annan webbläsare som stöder webbinstallationer) och gå till freetvgarden.com. Leta efter installationsikonen i adressfältet, eller öppna webbläsarmenyn och välj "Lägg till på startskärmen" / "Installera appen." FreeTV Garden kommer sedan att öppnas i helskärmsläge från din startskärm, precis som en inbyggd app, utan att ladda ner från Play Butik.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Öppna freetvgarden.com i Safari. Tryck på ikonen Dela och sedan på "Lägg till på startskärmen". Detta lägger till en appikon på din iPhone eller iPad som startar webbplatsen i helskärmsläge - ingen App Store-information behövs och inget att hålla uppdaterat.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Öppna din TV:s inbyggda webbläsare och navigera till freetvgarden.com. Om din TV inte har en användbar webbläsare kan du casta sidan från din telefon eller bärbara dator med Chromecast eller AirPlay för att titta på den stora skärmen istället.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Öppna Silk Browser (förinstallerad på Fire TV-enheter eller gratis från Amazon Appstore) och gå till freetvgarden.com. Välj ett land eller en kategori och börja titta – ingen prenumeration eller ytterligare app krävs.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Alla moderna stationära webbläsare fungerar - besök bara freetvgarden.com. I Chrome eller Edge visas en installationsikon i adressfältet för att lägga till den som en skrivbordsapp; annars fungerar den bra som en vanlig webbläsarflik.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Det finns ingen registrering, ingen prenumeration och ingen betalning vid något tillfälle – välj bara ett land eller en kanal och börja titta.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Är tv.garden detsamma som FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nej. Den ursprungliga tv.garden omdöptes till Famelack 2026 och använder inte längre TV Garden-namnet. FreeTV Garden är en separat, självständigt driven sajt — inte ansluten till Famelack eller den ursprungliga tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden samma funktioner som TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, plus mer. FreeTV Garden har samma spin-the-globe, välj-ett-land-upplevelse, tillsammans med 84+ språkfilter, 25+ innehållskategorier, bild-i-bild-uppspelning, favoriter som du kan stjärnmärka och besöka igen, en knapp för slumpmässig kanal och installation direkt från Chrome eller Safari – ingen appbutik behövs.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden även radio och webbkameror?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden har också en Radio-flik med live-stationer över genrer som Pop, Jazz och Talk, och en Webcam-flik med live-kameraflöden från hela världen. Byt flik ovanför jordklotet.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hur skiljer sig FreeTV Garden från radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden är ett separat, självständigt driven projekt — inte kopplat till radio.garden. Den erbjuder ett enklare, mer intuitivt gränssnitt med enklare navigering och går längre än radio med live-TV och webbkameror inbyggda i samma kostnadsfria verktyg med ett tryck.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Vad hände med den gamla FreeTool TV Garden-sidan på Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Den återlanserades här. Sidan som tidigare bodde på freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden är samma projekt som nu körs under sitt eget namn och domän: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Inget konto behövs. FreeTV Garden ber inte om e-post, lösenord eller någon personlig information för att titta på.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden körs i vilken modern mobil webbläsare som helst på Android eller iPhone och kan läggas till på din startskärm för åtkomst med en knapptryckning (se avsnittet Installera ovan).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaler är liveströmmar som kommer från offentliga programföretag, så vissa går offline tillfälligt på grund av programföretagets egna serverproblem. Prova en annan kanal, eller kom tillbaka senare – de flesta kommer tillbaka inom några minuter till timmar.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Är streams lagliga att titta på?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden samlar offentligt tillgängliga liveströmmar - främst från iptv-org-gemenskapskatalogen - och är inte värd för eller lagrar några videofiler själv. Se avsnittet Juridik och säkerhet nedan för mer.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Fler frågor besvaras på hela {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden samlar offentligt tillgängliga liveströmmar från gratis, offentliga källor, inklusive iptv-org-gemenskapskatalogen. Det är inte värd för eller lagrar några video- eller ljudfiler och kräver inget konto för att använda.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Frågor, feedback eller en kanal att föreslå? E-posta {link1} .

seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Tusindvis af gratis live radiostationer, organiseret efter genre - Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies og mere. Gennemse {link1} eller skift til fanen Radio over kloden.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Live kamerafeeds fra byer, vartegn, strande og natursteder verden over - gratis, ingen tilmelding. Gennemse {link1} eller skift til fanen Webcam over kloden.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Hver kanal er også organiseret efter sprog — 84+ i alt — så du kan finde noget at se på det sprog, du faktisk taler, ikke kun det land, du gennemser.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Hvert eneste af de 200+ lande, FreeTV Garden dækker, har sin egen dedikerede side med kanaler - vælg din nedenfor, eller gennemse efter kontinent fra den fulde liste.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden findes ikke i Play Butik eller App Store – den installeres direkte fra din browser i stedet, på enhver enhed, med få tryk.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Åbn Chrome (eller en anden browser, der understøtter webinstallationer), og gå til freetvgarden.com. Se efter installationsikonet i adresselinjen, eller åbn browsermenuen og vælg "Tilføj til startskærmen" / "Installer app." FreeTV Garden åbner derefter fuld skærm fra din startskærm, ligesom en indbygget app, uden krav om download fra Play Butik.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Åbn freetvgarden.com i Safari. Tryk på Del-ikonet og derefter på "Tilføj til startskærm". Dette tilføjer et app-ikon til din iPhone eller iPad, der starter webstedet i fuld skærm - ingen App Store-fortegnelse nødvendig, og intet at holde opdateret.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Åbn dit tv's indbyggede browser og naviger til freetvgarden.com. Hvis dit tv ikke har en brugbar browser, kan du caste siden fra din telefon eller bærbare computer ved hjælp af Chromecast eller AirPlay for at se den på den store skærm i stedet.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Åbn Silk Browser (forudinstalleret på Fire TV-enheder eller gratis fra Amazon Appstore), og gå til freetvgarden.com. Vælg et land eller en kategori, og begynd at se - intet abonnement eller yderligere app kræves.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Enhver moderne desktop-browser fungerer - bare besøg freetvgarden.com. I Chrome eller Edge vises et installationsikon i adresselinjen for at tilføje det som en desktop-app; ellers kører den fint som en almindelig browserfane.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Der er ingen tilmelding, intet abonnement og ingen betaling på noget tidspunkt - bare vælg et land eller en kanal og begynd at se.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Er tv.garden det samme som FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nej. Den originale tv.garden blev omdøbt til Famelack i 2026 og bruger ikke længere navnet TV Garden. FreeTV Garden er et separat, uafhængigt drevet websted — ikke tilknyttet Famelack eller den originale tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden de samme funktioner som TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, plus mere. FreeTV Garden har den samme spin-the-globe, vælg-et-land-oplevelse sammen med 84+ sprogfiltre, 25+ indholdskategorier, billed-i-billede-afspilning, favoritter, du kan stjernemarkere og gense, en tilfældig kanal-knap og installation med et enkelt tryk direkte fra Chrome eller Safari – ingen app-butik nødvendig.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden også radio og webcams?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden har også en Radio-fane med live-stationer på tværs af genrer som Pop, Jazz og Talk, og en Webcam-fane med live kamera-feeds fra hele verden. Skift faner over kloden.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hvordan adskiller FreeTV Garden sig fra radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden er et separat, selvstændigt drevet projekt — ikke tilknyttet radio.garden. Det tilbyder en enklere, mere intuitiv grænseflade med lettere navigation og går ud over radio med live-tv og webcams indbygget i det samme gratis værktøj med et enkelt tryk.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Hvad skete der med den gamle FreeTool TV Garden-side på Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Det relancerede her. Siden, der plejede at bo på freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, er det samme projekt, som nu kører under sit eget navn og domæne: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ingen konto er nødvendig. FreeTV Garden beder ikke om en e-mail, adgangskode eller nogen personlige detaljer for at se.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden kører i enhver moderne mobilbrowser på Android eller iPhone og kan føjes til din startskærm for adgang med et enkelt tryk (se afsnittet Installation ovenfor).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaler er livestreams hentet fra offentlige tv-selskaber, så nogle går offline midlertidigt på grund af tv-stationens egne serverproblemer. Prøv en anden kanal, eller tjek tilbage senere - de fleste kommer tilbage inden for et par minutter til timer.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentligt tilgængelige livestreams - primært fra iptv-org-fællesskabsmappen - og hoster eller gemmer ikke selv videofiler. Se afsnittet Juridisk og sikkerhed nedenfor for mere.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Flere spørgsmål besvares på den fulde {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentligt tilgængelige livestreams fra gratis, offentlige kilder, herunder iptv-org-fællesskabskataloget. Det hoster eller gemmer ikke nogen video- eller lydfiler og kræver ikke en konto for at bruge.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Spørgsmål, feedback eller en kanal at foreslå? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Hvorfor bufrer noen {countryName}-kanaler eller ikke lastes inn?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Du kobler direkte til kringkasterens egen server, så hastighet og pålitelighet avhenger av deres infrastruktur, ikke vår. Hvis en kanal ikke laster inn, prøv en annen fra listen.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Kan jeg se {countryName} nyhetskanaler direkte på telefonen min?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Ja – spilleren fungerer på alle telefonnettlesere uten appnedlasting. Bare åpne denne siden, trykk på en nyhetskanal og bruk fullskjerm for best mulig visning.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Er dette den offisielle nettsiden til en hvilken som helst {countryName} kringkaster?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Hvert eneste av de over 200 landene som FreeTV Garden dekker har sin egen dedikerte side med kanaler - velg din nedenfor, eller bla etter kontinent fra hele listen.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden er ikke på Play Store eller App Store – den installeres rett fra nettleseren din i stedet, på hvilken som helst enhet, med noen få trykk.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Åpne Chrome (eller en annen nettleser som støtter nettinstallasjoner) og gå til freetvgarden.com. Se etter installasjonsikonet i adressefeltet, eller åpne nettlesermenyen og velg "Legg til på startskjermen" / "Installer app." FreeTV Garden vil da åpne fullskjerm fra startskjermen din, akkurat som en innebygd app, uten å måtte laste ned fra Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Åpne freetvgarden.com i Safari. Trykk på Del-ikonet og deretter "Legg til på startskjermen." Dette legger til et appikon på iPhone eller iPad som starter nettstedet i full skjerm - ingen App Store-oppføring nødvendig, og ingenting å holde oppdatert.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Åpne TV-ens innebygde nettleser og naviger til freetvgarden.com. Hvis TV-en din ikke har en brukbar nettleser, kan du caste siden fra telefonen eller den bærbare datamaskinen med Chromecast eller AirPlay for å se den på storskjerm i stedet.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Åpne Silk Browser (forhåndsinstallert på Fire TV-enheter, eller gratis fra Amazon Appstore) og gå til freetvgarden.com. Velg et land eller en kategori og begynn å se – ingen abonnement eller ekstra app kreves.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Enhver moderne nettleser fungerer – bare besøk freetvgarden.com. I Chrome eller Edge vises et installasjonsikon i adressefeltet for å legge det til som en skrivebordsapp; ellers kjører den fint som en vanlig nettleserfane.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Det er ingen registrering, intet abonnement og ingen betaling på noe tidspunkt – bare velg et land eller en kanal og begynn å se.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Er tv.garden det samme som FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nei. Den originale tv.garden ble omdøpt til Famelack i 2026 og bruker ikke lenger TV Garden-navnet. FreeTV Garden er et eget, uavhengig drevet nettsted — ikke tilknyttet Famelack eller den originale tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden de samme funksjonene som TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, pluss mer. FreeTV Garden har samme spin-the-globe, velg-et-land-opplevelse, sammen med 84+ språkfiltre, 25+ innholdskategorier, bilde-i-bilde-avspilling, favoritter du kan stjernemerke og se på nytt, en tilfeldig kanalknapp og ett-trykks installering rett fra Chrome eller Safari – ingen appbutikk nødvendig.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden også radio og webkameraer?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden har også en Radio-fane med live-stasjoner på tvers av sjangre som Pop, Jazz og Talk, og en Webcam-fane med live kamerafeeder fra hele verden. Bytt fane over kloden.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hvordan er FreeTV Garden forskjellig fra radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden er et eget, uavhengig drevet prosjekt — ikke tilknyttet radio.garden. Den tilbyr et enklere, mer intuitivt grensesnitt med enklere navigering, og går utover radio med direktesendt TV og webkameraer innebygd i det samme gratis verktøyet med ett trykk.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Hva skjedde med den gamle FreeTool TV Garden-siden på Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Den ble relansert her. Siden som tidligere bodde på freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden er det samme prosjektet, som nå kjører under sitt eget navn og domene: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ingen konto er nødvendig. FreeTV Garden ber ikke om en e-post, passord eller noen personlige detaljer for å se.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden kjører i enhver moderne mobilnettleser på Android eller iPhone, og kan legges til startskjermen din for tilgang med ett trykk (se Installer-delen ovenfor).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaler er direktestrømmer hentet fra offentlige kringkastere, så noen går midlertidig frakoblet på grunn av kringkasterens egne serverproblemer. Prøv en annen kanal, eller kom tilbake senere – de fleste kommer tilbake innen noen få minutter til timer.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentlig tilgjengelige direktesendinger – primært fra iptv-org-fellesskapskatalogen – og er ikke vert for eller lagrer noen videofiler selv. Se delen Juridisk og sikkerhet nedenfor for mer.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Flere spørsmål er besvart på hele {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentlig tilgjengelige direktesendinger fra gratis, offentlige kilder, inkludert iptv-org-samfunnskatalogen. Den er ikke vert for eller lagrer video- eller lydfiler, og krever ingen konto for å bruke.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Spørsmål, tilbakemeldinger eller en kanal å foreslå? E-post {link1} .

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Pyöritä fotorealistista 3D-satelliittipalloa ja löydä tuhansia live-radioasemia ympäri maailmaa niiden todellisen lähetyspaikan mukaan – ilmaiseksi, ilman rekisteröitymistä.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Live-TV-kanavat on jaettu yli 25 luokkaan – Uutiset, Urheilu, Elokuvat, Musiikki, Lapset, Dokumentti ja paljon muuta – joten voit selata mitä haluat sen sijaan, että selaatisi kaikkea.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Tuhansia ilmaisia ​​live-radioasemia, lajiteltuina - pop, jazz, keskustelu, uutiset, vanhat kappaleet ja paljon muuta. Selaa {link1} tai vaihda Radio-välilehteen maapallon yläpuolella.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Suorat kamerasyötteet kaupungeista, maamerkeistä, rannoista ja luontokohteista maailmanlaajuisesti – ilmaiseksi, ilman rekisteröitymistä. Selaa {link1} tai vaihda Webcam-välilehdelle maapallon yläpuolella.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Jokainen kanava on myös järjestetty kielen mukaan – yhteensä yli 84 – joten voit löytää katsottavaa kielellä, jota todella puhut, ei vain selaamassasi maassa.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Jokaisella yli 200 maan FreeTV Garden -kansilla on oma kanavasivunsa – valitse omasi alta tai selaa maanosittain täydestä luettelosta.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ei ole Play Storessa tai App Storessa – se asentuu sen sijaan suoraan selaimesta mihin tahansa laitteeseen muutamalla napautuksella.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Avaa Chrome (tai muu selain, joka tukee verkkoasennuksia) ja siirry osoitteeseen freetvgarden.com. Etsi asennuskuvake osoitepalkista tai avaa selainvalikko ja valitse "Lisää aloitusnäyttöön" / "Asenna sovellus". FreeTV Garden avautuu sitten koko näytön kokoisena aloitusnäytöltäsi, aivan kuten natiivisovellus ilman latausta Play Kaupasta.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Avaa freetvgarden.com Safarissa. Napauta Jaa-kuvaketta ja sitten "Lisää aloitusnäyttöön". Tämä lisää iPhoneen tai iPadiin sovelluskuvakkeen, joka käynnistää sivuston koko näytön kokoisena – App Store -listausta ei tarvita, eikä mitään päivitettävää.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Avaa televisiosi sisäänrakennettu selain ja siirry osoitteeseen freetvgarden.com. Jos televisiossasi ei ole käyttökelpoista selainta, suoratoista sivu puhelimestasi tai kannettavasta tietokoneesta Chromecastin tai AirPlayn avulla katsoaksesi sitä suurelta näytöltä.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Avaa Silk Browser (esiasennettu Fire TV -laitteisiin tai ilmainen Amazon Appstoresta) ja siirry osoitteeseen freetvgarden.com. Valitse maa tai luokka ja aloita katselu – tilausta tai lisäsovellusta ei tarvita.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Mikä tahansa nykyaikainen työpöytäselain toimii – käy vain osoitteessa freetvgarden.com. Chromessa tai Edgessä osoitepalkkiin tulee asennuskuvake, jonka avulla se voidaan lisätä työpöytäsovellukseksi. muuten se toimii hyvin tavallisena selaimen välilehtenä.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Kyllä. Ei rekisteröitymistä, tilausta tai maksua missään vaiheessa – valitse vain maa tai kanava ja aloita katselu.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Onko tv.garden sama kuin FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ei. Alkuperäinen tv.garden nimettiin uudelleen Famelackiksi vuonna 2026, eikä se enää käytä TV Garden -nimeä. FreeTV Garden on erillinen, itsenäisesti hoidettu sivusto – ei liity Famelackiin tai alkuperäiseen tv.gardeniin.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Onko FreeTV Gardenissa samat ominaisuudet kuin TV Gardenissa?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Kyllä, plus enemmän. FreeTV Gardenissa on sama pyörivä maapallon kokemus, yli 84 kielisuodatinta, 25+ sisältöluokkaa, kuva kuvassa -toisto, suosikit, jotka voit merkitä tähdellä ja käydä uudelleen, satunnainen kanavapainike ja yhden napautuksen asennus suoraan Chromesta tai Safarista – sovelluskauppaa ei tarvita.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Onko FreeTV Gardenissa myös radiota ja web-kameroita?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Kyllä. FreeTV Gardenissa on myös Radio-välilehti, jossa on live-asemia eri tyylilajeista, kuten Pop, Jazz ja Talk, ja Webcam-välilehti, jossa on suoria kamerasyötteitä ympäri maailmaa. Vaihda välilehteä maapallon yläpuolella.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Miten FreeTV Garden eroaa radio.gardenista?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden on erillinen, itsenäisesti johdettu projekti – ei liity radio.gardeniin. Se tarjoaa yksinkertaisemman, intuitiivisemman käyttöliittymän, jossa on helpompi navigoida, ja se on radiota pidemmälle rakennettu live-TV:n ja verkkokameroiden ansiosta, jotka on rakennettu samaan ilmaiseen yhden napautuksen työkaluun.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Mitä tapahtui vanhalle FreeTool TV Garden -sivulle Odoossa?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Täällä se käynnistettiin uudelleen. Sivu, joka asui aiemmin osoitteessa freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, on sama projekti, joka toimii nyt omalla nimellä ja verkkotunnuksella: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Tiliä ei tarvita. FreeTV Garden ei pyydä sähköpostia, salasanaa tai muita henkilökohtaisia ​​tietoja katsoakseen.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Kyllä – FreeTV Garden toimii missä tahansa nykyaikaisessa Android- tai iPhone-mobiiliselaimessa, ja se voidaan lisätä aloitusnäyttöön yhdellä napautuksella (katso yllä oleva asennusosio).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanavat ovat suoria lähetyksiä, jotka on hankittu julkisilta yleisradioyhtiöiltä, ​​joten osa siirtyy tilapäisesti offline-tilaan lähetystoiminnan harjoittajan omien palvelinongelmien vuoksi. Kokeile toista kanavaa tai palaa myöhemmin – useimmat palaavat muutaman minuutin tai tunnin kuluessa.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden kokoaa julkisesti saatavilla olevia suoria lähetyksiä – pääasiassa iptv-org-yhteisöhakemistosta – eikä itse isännöi tai tallenna videotiedostoja. Katso lisätietoja alla olevasta Laki ja turvallisuus -osiosta.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Lisää kysymyksiä löytyy koko {link1} -sivustolta.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden kokoaa julkisesti saatavilla olevia suoratoistoja ilmaisista julkisista lähteistä, mukaan lukien iptv-org-yhteisöhakemisto. Se ei isännöi tai tallenna video- tai äänitiedostoja, eikä se vaadi tiliä käyttääkseen.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Onko sinulla kysyttävää, palautetta tai ehdotettavaa kanavaa? Sähköposti {link1} .

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: Το FreeTV Garden αυτή τη στιγμή παραθέτει {count} ζωντανά {countryName} κανάλια, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των {names} — τραβηγμένα ζωντανά από τον δημόσιο κατάλογο καναλιών iptv-org και μπορούν να αναπαραχθούν άμεσα στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας χωρίς επιπλέον λογισμικό. Όπως συμβαίνει με οποιονδήποτε free-to-aggregator, η ακριβής λίστα καναλιών μπορεί να αλλάζει μέρα με τη μέρα καθώς οι ροές συνεχίζονται και εκτός σύνδεσης.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Πώς να παρακολουθήσετε {countryName} τηλεόραση στη συσκευή σας

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Δεν απαιτείται εφαρμογή ή λογαριασμός για την παρακολούθηση καναλιών {countryName}. Αυτή η σελίδα λειτουργεί απευθείας στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας σε οποιαδήποτε συσκευή - απλώς πατήστε ένα κανάλι και πατήστε αναπαραγωγή.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Ανοίξτε αυτήν τη σελίδα στο Chrome, πατήστε ένα κανάλι {countryName} για να ξεκινήσετε να παρακολουθείτε και, στη συνέχεια, χρησιμοποιήστε το κουμπί πλήρους οθόνης για την καλύτερη προβολή. Για γρήγορη πρόσβαση την επόμενη φορά, πατήστε το μενού του Chrome και επιλέξτε "Προσθήκη στην αρχική οθόνη" για να δημιουργήσετε ένα εικονίδιο που μοιάζει με εφαρμογή.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Ανοίξτε αυτήν τη σελίδα στο Safari και πατήστε οποιοδήποτε κανάλι {countryName} για να ξεκινήσει η ροή αμέσως. Πατήστε το εικονίδιο Κοινή χρήση και επιλέξτε "Προσθήκη στην αρχική οθόνη" για πρόσβαση με ένα πάτημα χωρίς λήψη μιας εφαρμογής από το App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Οποιοδήποτε σύγχρονο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης λειτουργεί - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ή Edge. Ανοίξτε ένα κανάλι {countryName} και χρησιμοποιήστε το εικονίδιο πλήρους οθόνης στο πρόγραμμα αναπαραγωγής για μια εμπειρία θέασης που μοιάζει με τηλεόραση χωρίς περισπασμούς.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Ανοίξτε αυτήν τη σελίδα στο ενσωματωμένο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης της τηλεόρασής σας ή μεταδώστε την από το τηλέφωνο ή τον φορητό υπολογιστή σας χρησιμοποιώντας Chromecast ή AirPlay για να παρακολουθήσετε {countryName} κανάλια στη μεγάλη οθόνη.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: Επιστρέψτε στο {homeLink} για να περιστρέψετε τον διαδραστικό τρισδιάστατο κόσμο και να επιλέξετε οποιαδήποτε από τις 200+ χώρες που υποστηρίζουμε ή να περιηγηθείτε στο {countriesLink}.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Είναι δωρεάν η παρακολούθηση {countryName} TV στο FreeTV Garden;

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Ναί. Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει κανάλια Free-to-Air (FTA) που είναι δημόσια διαθέσιμα στο διαδίκτυο. Δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή, λογαριασμός ή εφαρμογή για παρακολούθηση.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: Πόσα {countryName} κανάλια έχει το FreeTV Garden;

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: Επί του παρόντος, περίπου {count} ζωντανά κανάλια, που καλύπτουν κατηγορίες όπως {categories} .

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: Ο αριθμός καναλιών αλλάζει συχνά καθώς οι δημόσιες ροές συνεχίζονται και εκτός σύνδεσης — ανοίξτε το παραπάνω εργαλείο για να δείτε τι είναι ζωντανά αυτήν τη στιγμή.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: Αυτή η λίστα ενημερώνεται αυτόματα από τον δημόσιο κατάλογο iptv-org.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Γιατί ορισμένα κανάλια {countryName} αποθηκεύουν προσωρινά ή αποτυγχάνουν να φορτώσουν;

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Συνδέεστε απευθείας στον διακομιστή του ίδιου του ραδιοτηλεοπτικού φορέα, επομένως η ταχύτητα και η αξιοπιστία εξαρτώνται από την υποδομή τους και όχι από τη δική μας. Εάν ένα κανάλι δεν φορτώνει, δοκιμάστε ένα άλλο από τη λίστα.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Μπορώ να παρακολουθώ {countryName} ειδησεογραφικά κανάλια ζωντανά στο τηλέφωνό μου;

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Ναι — το πρόγραμμα αναπαραγωγής λειτουργεί σε οποιοδήποτε πρόγραμμα περιήγησης τηλεφώνου χωρίς λήψη εφαρμογής. Απλώς ανοίξτε αυτήν τη σελίδα, πατήστε ένα κανάλι ειδήσεων και χρησιμοποιήστε την πλήρη οθόνη για την καλύτερη προβολή.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Είναι αυτός ο επίσημος ιστότοπος οποιουδήποτε ραδιοτηλεοπτικού φορέα {countryName};

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Όχι. Το FreeTV Garden είναι ένας ανεξάρτητος κατάλογος που συνδέεται με δημόσια διαθέσιμα ρεύματα. Δεν συνδέεται, δεν υποστηρίζεται από, ούτε λειτουργεί από κανέναν ραδιοτηλεοπτικό φορέα που αναφέρεται σε αυτή τη σελίδα.
