seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: Θέλετε περισσότερα; Περιηγηθείτε στο πλήρες {link} στο FreeTV Garden.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Εξερευνήστε το ζωντανό ραδιόφωνο σε μια διαδραστική δορυφορική σφαίρα

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Περιστρέψτε μια φωτορεαλιστική τρισδιάστατη δορυφορική υδρόγειο και ανακαλύψτε χιλιάδες ζωντανούς ραδιοφωνικούς σταθμούς από όλο τον κόσμο, σχεδιασμένους από την πραγματική τους τοποθεσία μετάδοσης — δωρεάν, χωρίς εγγραφή.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Τα ζωντανά τηλεοπτικά κανάλια είναι οργανωμένα σε 25+ κατηγορίες — Ειδήσεις, Αθλητικά, Ταινίες, Μουσική, Παιδιά, Ντοκιμαντέρ και πολλά άλλα — ώστε να μπορείτε να περιηγηθείτε ανάλογα με το τι θέλετε να παρακολουθήσετε αντί να κάνετε κύλιση στα πάντα.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Χιλιάδες δωρεάν ζωντανοί ραδιοφωνικοί σταθμοί, οργανωμένοι ανά είδος — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies και άλλα. Περιηγηθείτε στο {link1} ή μεταβείτε στην καρτέλα Ραδιόφωνο πάνω από την υδρόγειο.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Ζωντανές ροές κάμερας από πόλεις, ορόσημα, παραλίες και σημεία της φύσης σε όλο τον κόσμο — δωρεάν, χωρίς εγγραφή. Περιηγηθείτε στο {link1} ή μεταβείτε στην καρτέλα Webcam πάνω από την υδρόγειο.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Κάθε κανάλι οργανώνεται επίσης κατά γλώσσα — 84+ συνολικά — ώστε να μπορείτε να βρείτε κάτι να παρακολουθήσετε στη γλώσσα που μιλάτε πραγματικά, όχι μόνο στη χώρα που περιηγείστε.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Κάθε μία από τις 200+ χώρες εξώφυλλα του FreeTV Garden έχει τη δική της ειδική σελίδα καναλιών — επιλέξτε τη δική σας παρακάτω ή περιηγηθείτε ανά ήπειρο από την πλήρη λίστα.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: Το FreeTV Garden δεν βρίσκεται στο Play Store ή στο App Store — εγκαθίσταται απευθείας από το πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας, σε οποιαδήποτε συσκευή, με λίγα αγγίγματα.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Ανοίξτε το Chrome (ή άλλο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης που υποστηρίζει εγκαταστάσεις ιστού) και μεταβείτε στη διεύθυνση freetvgarden.com. Αναζητήστε το εικονίδιο εγκατάστασης στη γραμμή διευθύνσεων ή ανοίξτε το μενού του προγράμματος περιήγησης και επιλέξτε "Προσθήκη στην αρχική οθόνη" / "Εγκατάσταση εφαρμογής". Στη συνέχεια, το FreeTV Garden θα ανοίξει σε πλήρη οθόνη από την αρχική σας οθόνη, όπως μια εγγενής εφαρμογή, χωρίς να απαιτείται λήψη από το Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Ανοίξτε το freetvgarden.com στο Safari. Πατήστε το εικονίδιο Κοινή χρήση και μετά "Προσθήκη στην αρχική οθόνη". Αυτό προσθέτει ένα εικονίδιο εφαρμογής στο iPhone ή το iPad σας που εκκινεί τον ιστότοπο σε πλήρη οθόνη — δεν απαιτείται καταχώριση στο App Store και τίποτα που να ενημερώνεται συνεχώς.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Ανοίξτε το ενσωματωμένο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης της τηλεόρασής σας και μεταβείτε στη διεύθυνση freetvgarden.com. Εάν η τηλεόρασή σας δεν διαθέτει πρόγραμμα περιήγησης που μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί, μεταδώστε τη σελίδα από το τηλέφωνο ή τον φορητό υπολογιστή σας χρησιμοποιώντας Chromecast ή AirPlay για να την παρακολουθήσετε στη μεγάλη οθόνη.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Ανοίξτε το Silk Browser (προεγκατεστημένο σε συσκευές Fire TV ή δωρεάν από το Amazon Appstore) και μεταβείτε στη διεύθυνση freetvgarden.com. Επιλέξτε χώρα ή κατηγορία και ξεκινήστε την παρακολούθηση — δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή ή πρόσθετη εφαρμογή.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Οποιοδήποτε σύγχρονο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης για επιτραπέζιους υπολογιστές λειτουργεί — απλώς επισκεφτείτε το freetvgarden.com. Στο Chrome ή στο Edge, εμφανίζεται ένα εικονίδιο εγκατάστασης στη γραμμή διευθύνσεων για να το προσθέσετε ως εφαρμογή επιφάνειας εργασίας. Διαφορετικά τρέχει μια χαρά ως κανονική καρτέλα προγράμματος περιήγησης.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Είναι πραγματικά δωρεάν το FreeTV Garden;

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ναί. Δεν υπάρχει καμία εγγραφή, καμία συνδρομή και καμία πληρωμή σε κανένα σημείο - απλώς επιλέξτε μια χώρα ή ένα κανάλι και ξεκινήστε να παρακολουθείτε.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Είναι το tv.garden το ίδιο με το FreeTV Garden;

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Όχι. Το αρχικό tv.garden μετονομάστηκε σε Famelack το 2026 και δεν χρησιμοποιεί πλέον το όνομα TV Garden. Το FreeTV Garden είναι ένας ξεχωριστός ιστότοπος που λειτουργεί ανεξάρτητα — δεν σχετίζεται με το Famelack ή το αρχικό tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Το FreeTV Garden έχει τα ίδια χαρακτηριστικά με το TV Garden;

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ναι, συν περισσότερα. Το FreeTV Garden έχει την ίδια εμπειρία περιστροφής του πλανήτη, επιλογής χώρας, μαζί με 84+ φίλτρα γλώσσας, 25+ κατηγορίες περιεχομένου, αναπαραγωγή εικόνας σε εικόνα, αγαπημένα που μπορείτε να επισκέπτεστε με αστέρι και να επισκέπτεστε ξανά, ένα κουμπί τυχαίου καναλιού και εγκατάσταση με ένα πάτημα απευθείας από το Chrome ή το Safari — δεν χρειάζεται κατάστημα εφαρμογών.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Το FreeTV Garden έχει επίσης ραδιόφωνο και webcam;

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ναί. Το FreeTV Garden διαθέτει επίσης μια καρτέλα Ραδιόφωνο με ζωντανούς σταθμούς σε διάφορα είδη όπως Pop, Jazz και Talk, και μια καρτέλα Webcam με ζωντανές ροές κάμερας από όλο τον κόσμο. Εναλλαγή καρτελών πάνω από την υδρόγειο.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Σε τι διαφέρει το FreeTV Garden από το radio.garden;

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: Το FreeTV Garden είναι ένα ξεχωριστό έργο που εκτελείται ανεξάρτητα — δεν σχετίζεται με το radio.garden. Προσφέρει μια απλούστερη, πιο διαισθητική διεπαφή με ευκολότερη πλοήγηση και ξεπερνά το ραδιόφωνο με ζωντανή τηλεόραση και κάμερες web ενσωματωμένες στο ίδιο δωρεάν εργαλείο με ένα πάτημα.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Τι συνέβη με την παλιά σελίδα FreeTool TV Garden στο Odoo;

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Ξανακυκλοφόρησε εδώ. Η σελίδα που κατοικούσε στο freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden είναι το ίδιο έργο, που λειτουργεί τώρα με το δικό της όνομα και τομέα: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Δεν απαιτείται λογαριασμός. Το FreeTV Garden δεν ζητά email, κωδικό πρόσβασης ή προσωπικά στοιχεία για παρακολούθηση.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ναι — Το FreeTV Garden εκτελείται σε οποιοδήποτε σύγχρονο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης για κινητά σε Android ή iPhone και μπορεί να προστεθεί στην αρχική σας οθόνη για πρόσβαση με ένα πάτημα (δείτε την ενότητα Εγκατάσταση παραπάνω).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Τα κανάλια είναι ζωντανές ροές που προέρχονται από δημόσιους ραδιοτηλεοπτικούς φορείς, επομένως ορισμένα τίθενται εκτός σύνδεσης προσωρινά λόγω προβλημάτων διακομιστή του ίδιου του ραδιοτηλεοπτικού φορέα. Δοκιμάστε άλλο κανάλι ή ελέγξτε ξανά αργότερα — τα περισσότερα επιστρέφουν μέσα σε λίγα λεπτά έως ώρες.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Είναι νόμιμες οι ροές για παρακολούθηση;

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει ζωντανές ροές που είναι διαθέσιμες στο κοινό — κυρίως από τον κατάλογο της κοινότητας iptv-org — και δεν φιλοξενεί ούτε αποθηκεύει το ίδιο κανένα αρχείο βίντεο. Δείτε την ενότητα Νομική και Ασφάλεια παρακάτω για περισσότερα.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Περισσότερες ερωτήσεις απαντώνται στο πλήρες {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει δημόσια διαθέσιμες ζωντανές ροές από δωρεάν, δημόσιες πηγές, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του καταλόγου κοινότητας iptv-org. Δεν φιλοξενεί ούτε αποθηκεύει αρχεία βίντεο ή ήχου και δεν απαιτεί λογαριασμό για χρήση.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Ερωτήσεις, σχόλια ή κάποιο κανάλι να προτείνετε; Email {link1} .

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: Hostuje nebo nahrává FreeTV Garden video streamy?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: Ne. FreeTV Garden nehostuje, nenahrává ani neukládá žádné video soubory. Odkazuje na veřejně dostupné streamy, takže je můžete sledovat přímo z vlastních serverů provozovatele vysílání.

Zde se nástroj otevře přímo na {countryName} , takže můžete začít okamžitě sledovat ve svém prohlížeči – bez registrace, bez aplikace, bez předplatného a bez kreditní karty.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Ke sledování {countryName} kanálů není potřeba žádná aplikace ani účet. Tato stránka funguje přímo ve vašem prohlížeči na jakémkoli zařízení – stačí klepnout na kanál a stisknout tlačítko Přehrát.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Otevřete tuto stránku v Chromu, klepnutím na kanál {countryName} začněte sledovat a poté použijte tlačítko celé obrazovky pro nejlepší zobrazení. seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Funguje jakýkoli moderní prohlížeč – Chrome, Safari, Firefox nebo Edge. Otevřete kanál {countryName} a použijte ikonu na celou obrazovku v přehrávači, abyste měli ze sledování TV bez rozptylování.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Otevřete tuto stránku ve vestavěném prohlížeči televizoru nebo ji odešlete z telefonu či notebooku pomocí Chromecastu nebo AirPlay a sledujte {countryName} kanály na velké obrazovce.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Je sledování televize {countryName} na FreeTV Garden zdarma?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Každá z více než 200 zemí, které pokrývá FreeTV Garden, má svou vlastní stránku kanálů – vyberte si tu svou níže nebo procházejte podle kontinentu z úplného seznamu.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden není v Obchodě Play ani App Store – místo toho se nainstaluje přímo z vašeho prohlížeče na libovolné zařízení několika klepnutími.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Otevřete Chrome (nebo jiný prohlížeč, který podporuje webové instalace) a přejděte na freetvgarden.com. Vyhledejte ikonu instalace v adresním řádku nebo otevřete nabídku prohlížeče a zvolte „Přidat na domovskou obrazovku“ / „Nainstalovat aplikaci“. FreeTV Garden se poté otevře na celé obrazovce z vaší domovské obrazovky, stejně jako nativní aplikace, bez nutnosti stahování z Obchodu Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Otevřete freetvgarden.com v Safari. Klepněte na ikonu Sdílet a poté na „Přidat na domovskou obrazovku“. Do vašeho iPhonu nebo iPadu se tak přidá ikona aplikace, která spustí web na celou obrazovku – není potřeba žádný záznam v App Store a není třeba nic aktualizovat.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Otevřete vestavěný prohlížeč televizoru a přejděte na stránku freetvgarden.com. Pokud vaše televize nemá použitelný prohlížeč, odešlete stránku z telefonu nebo notebooku pomocí Chromecastu nebo AirPlay, abyste ji mohli sledovat na velké obrazovce.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Otevřete prohlížeč Silk Browser (předinstalovaný na zařízeních Fire TV nebo zdarma z obchodu Amazon Appstore) a přejděte na freetvgarden.com. Vyberte zemi nebo kategorii a začněte sledovat – není potřeba žádné předplatné ani další aplikace.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Funguje jakýkoli moderní počítačový prohlížeč – stačí navštívit freetvgarden.com. V prohlížeči Chrome nebo Edge se v adresním řádku zobrazí ikona instalace, kterou lze přidat jako desktopovou aplikaci; jinak funguje dobře jako běžná karta prohlížeče.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ano. Neexistuje žádná registrace, žádné předplatné ani žádná platba v žádném okamžiku – stačí si vybrat zemi nebo kanál a začít sledovat.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Je tv.garden to samé jako FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ne. Původní tv.garden se v roce 2026 přejmenoval na Famelack a již nepoužívá název TV Garden. FreeTV Garden je samostatný, nezávisle provozovaný web – není spojen s Famelack nebo původní tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Má FreeTV Garden stejné funkce jako TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ano, plus další. FreeTV Garden má stejný zážitek z rotace zeměkoule a výběru země, spolu s více než 84 jazykovými filtry, více než 25 kategoriemi obsahu, přehráváním obrazu v obraze, oblíbenými položkami, které můžete označit hvězdičkou a znovu je navštívit, tlačítkem pro náhodný kanál a instalací jedním klepnutím přímo z Chrome nebo Safari – není potřeba žádný obchod s aplikacemi.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Má FreeTV Garden také rádio a webkamery?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ano. FreeTV Garden má také kartu Rádio s živými stanicemi napříč žánry, jako je Pop, Jazz a Talk, a kartu Webová kamera s živými kanály z kamer z celého světa. Přepnout karty nad zeměkoulí.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Jak se FreeTV Garden liší od radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden je samostatný, samostatně provozovaný projekt — není spojen s radio.garden. Nabízí jednodušší, intuitivnější rozhraní se snazší navigací a přesahuje rámec rádia s živou televizí a webovými kamerami zabudovanými do stejného bezplatného nástroje jediným klepnutím.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Co se stalo se starou stránkou FreeTool TV Garden na Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Tady se to znovu spustilo. Stránka, která dříve žila na freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, je stejný projekt, nyní běží pod svým vlastním jménem a doménou: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Není potřeba žádný účet. FreeTV Garden ke sledování nepožaduje e-mail, heslo ani žádné osobní údaje.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ano – FreeTV Garden běží v jakémkoli moderním mobilním prohlížeči na Androidu nebo iPhonu a lze jej přidat na domovskou obrazovku pro přístup jedním klepnutím (viz část Instalace výše).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanály jsou živé přenosy pocházející od veřejnoprávních vysílacích společností, takže některé jsou dočasně offline kvůli problémům se serverem vysílajícího. Zkuste jiný kanál nebo se vraťte později – většina se vrátí během několika minut až hodin.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden shromažďuje veřejně dostupné živé přenosy – primárně z komunitního adresáře iptv-org – a sama nehostuje ani neukládá žádné video soubory. Další informace naleznete v části Právní předpisy a bezpečnost níže.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Další otázky jsou zodpovězeny v plném znění {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden shromažďuje veřejně dostupné živé přenosy z bezplatných veřejných zdrojů, včetně adresáře komunity iptv-org. Nehostuje ani neukládá žádné video ani zvukové soubory a k použití nevyžaduje účet.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Máte otázky, zpětnou vazbu nebo kanál, který chcete navrhnout? E-mail {link1} .

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: A FreeTV Garden nem elérhető a Play Áruházban vagy az App Store-ban – ehelyett közvetlenül a böngészőből települ bármely eszközre, néhány érintéssel.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Nyissa meg a Chrome-ot (vagy egy másik böngészőt, amely támogatja a webes telepítéseket), és lépjen a freetvgarden.com webhelyre. Keresse meg a telepítés ikont a címsorban, vagy nyissa meg a böngésző menüjét, és válassza a "Hozzáadás a kezdőképernyőhöz" / "Alkalmazás telepítése" lehetőséget. A FreeTV Garden ezután teljes képernyőn megnyílik a kezdőképernyőről, akárcsak egy natív alkalmazás, és nincs szükség a Play Áruházból való letöltésre.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Nyissa meg a freetvgarden.com webhelyet a Safariban. Koppintson a Megosztás ikonra, majd a „Hozzáadás a kezdőképernyőhöz” elemre. Ez egy alkalmazásikont ad iPhone-jához vagy iPadjéhez, amely teljes képernyőn elindítja a webhelyet – nincs szükség az App Store-beli listára, és nincs szükség frissítésre.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Nyissa meg TV-je beépített böngészőjét, és keresse fel a freetvgarden.com webhelyet. Ha TV-jén nincs használható böngésző, küldje át az oldalt telefonjáról vagy laptopjáról Chromecast vagy AirPlay segítségével, hogy inkább a nagy képernyőn nézze.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Nyissa meg a Silk Browser alkalmazást (előre telepítve a Fire TV eszközökre, vagy ingyenes az Amazon Appstore-ból), és lépjen a freetvgarden.com webhelyre. Válasszon országot vagy kategóriát, és kezdje el nézni – nincs szükség előfizetésre vagy további alkalmazásra.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Bármely modern asztali böngésző működik – csak látogassa meg a freetvgarden.com oldalt. A Chrome-ban vagy az Edge-ben a címsorban megjelenik egy telepítési ikon, amellyel asztali alkalmazásként adható hozzá; egyébként rendes böngészőlapként jól fut.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Igen. Nincs regisztráció, előfizetés és fizetés – csak válassz egy országot vagy csatornát, és kezdd el nézni.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: A tv.garden ugyanaz, mint a FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nem. Az eredeti tv.garden 2026-ban Famelack névre változott, és már nem használja a TV Garden nevet. A FreeTV Garden egy különálló, önállóan üzemeltetett webhely – nem kapcsolódik sem a Famelackhoz, sem az eredeti tv.gardenhez.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: A FreeTV Garden ugyanazokkal a funkciókkal rendelkezik, mint a TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Igen, plusz még több. A FreeTV Garden ugyanazt a körforgásos, országos választási élményt kínálja, 84+ nyelvi szűrővel, 25+ tartalomkategóriával, kép a képben lejátszással, megcsillagozható és újra megtekinthető kedvencekkel, véletlenszerű csatorna gombbal és egy koppintással történő telepítéssel közvetlenül a Chrome-ból vagy a Safariból – nincs szükség alkalmazásboltra.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: A FreeTV Garden is rendelkezik rádióval és webkamerával?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Igen. A FreeTV Garden rendelkezik egy Rádió lappal is, ahol élő állomások sugároznak olyan műfajokat, mint a Pop, Jazz és Talk, valamint egy Webkamera lap, amely a világ minden tájáról származó élő kameracsatornákat kínál. Váltás a földgömb feletti lapok között.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Miben különbözik a FreeTV Garden a radio.gardentől?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: A FreeTV Garden egy különálló, független projekt, amely nem kapcsolódik a radio.gardenhez. Egyszerűbb, intuitívabb kezelőfelületet kínál könnyebb navigációval, és túlmutat a rádión, élő TV-vel és webkamerákkal, amelyek ugyanabba az ingyenes, egyérintéses eszközbe vannak beépítve.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Mi történt a régi FreeTool TV Garden oldallal az Odoo-n?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Itt újraindult. Az oldal, amely korábban a freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden címen működött, ugyanaz a projekt, amely most saját néven és domainen fut: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Nincs szükség fiókra. A FreeTV Garden nem kér e-mailt, jelszót vagy semmilyen személyes adatot a nézéshez.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Igen – A FreeTV Garden bármely modern mobilböngészőben fut Androidon vagy iPhone-on, és hozzáadható a kezdőképernyőhöz, hogy egyetlen érintéssel hozzáférhessen (lásd a fenti Telepítés szakaszt).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Miért jelenik meg egy csatorna „Nem elérhető” felirat?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: A csatornák a közszolgálati műsorszolgáltatóktól származó élő közvetítések, így néhányuk átmenetileg offline állapotba kerül a műsorszolgáltató saját szerverproblémái miatt. Próbáljon ki egy másik csatornát, vagy nézzen vissza később – a legtöbben néhány percen vagy órán belül visszatérnek.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: A FreeTV Garden összesíti a nyilvánosan elérhető élő közvetítéseket – elsősorban az iptv-org közösségi címtárból –, és maga nem tárol vagy tárol semmilyen videofájlt. További információért tekintse meg az alábbi Jogi és biztonsági részt.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: További kérdésekre a teljes {link1} oldalon talál választ.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: A FreeTV Garden a nyilvánosan elérhető élő közvetítéseket összesíti ingyenes, nyilvános forrásokból, beleértve az iptv-org közösségi címtárat is. Nem tárol és nem tárol semmilyen video- vagy hangfájlt, és nem igényel fiókot a használatához.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Kérdése van, visszajelzést vagy javasolni kívánt csatornát? E-mail: {link1}.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Preskúmajte živé rádio na interaktívnom satelitnom glóbuse

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Roztočte fotorealistický 3D satelitný glóbus a objavte tisíce živých rozhlasových staníc z celého sveta, ktoré sú zakreslené podľa ich skutočného vysielacieho miesta – zadarmo, nie je potrebná žiadna registrácia.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Tisíce bezplatných rozhlasových staníc naživo, organizovaných podľa žánru – Pop, Jazz, Talk, Správy, Oldies a ďalšie. Prejdite si {link1} alebo prepnite na kartu Rádio nad zemeguľou.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Živé kamery z miest, pamiatok, pláží a prírodných miest na celom svete – zadarmo, bez registrácie. Prejdite si {link1} alebo prepnite na kartu Webová kamera nad zemeguľou.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Každý kanál je tiež usporiadaný podľa jazyka – celkovo 84+ – takže môžete nájsť niečo na pozeranie v jazyku, ktorým skutočne hovoríte, nielen v krajine, ktorú si prehliadate.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Každá z viac ako 200 krajín pokrytých FreeTV Garden má svoju vlastnú vyhradenú stránku kanálov – vyberte si tú svoju nižšie alebo si prezrite podľa kontinentu z úplného zoznamu.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden nie je v Obchode Play ani App Store – namiesto toho sa nainštaluje priamo z vášho prehliadača na akékoľvek zariadenie niekoľkými klepnutiami.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Otvorte prehliadač Chrome (alebo iný prehliadač, ktorý podporuje inštaláciu z webu) a prejdite na stránku freetvgarden.com. Vyhľadajte ikonu inštalácie v paneli s adresou alebo otvorte ponuku prehliadača a vyberte možnosť „Pridať na plochu“ / „Inštalovať aplikáciu“. FreeTV Garden sa potom otvorí na celej obrazovke z vašej domovskej obrazovky, rovnako ako natívna aplikácia, bez potreby sťahovania z Obchodu Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Otvorte freetvgarden.com v Safari. Klepnite na ikonu Zdieľať a potom na „Pridať na domovskú obrazovku“. Tým sa na váš iPhone alebo iPad pridá ikona aplikácie, ktorá spustí stránku na celej obrazovke – nie je potrebný žiadny záznam v App Store a nie je potrebné nič aktualizovať.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Otvorte vstavaný prehliadač vášho televízora a prejdite na stránku freetvgarden.com. Ak váš televízor nemá použiteľný prehliadač, preneste stránku z telefónu alebo notebooku pomocou Chromecastu alebo AirPlay, aby ste ju mohli pozerať na veľkej obrazovke.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Otvorte prehliadač Silk Browser (predinštalovaný na zariadeniach Fire TV alebo bezplatný z obchodu Amazon Appstore) a prejdite na stránku freetvgarden.com. Vyberte krajinu alebo kategóriu a začnite pozerať – nevyžaduje sa žiadne predplatné ani ďalšia aplikácia.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Funguje každý moderný prehliadač na počítači – stačí navštíviť freetvgarden.com. V prehliadači Chrome alebo Edge sa v paneli s adresou zobrazí ikona inštalácie, ktorá umožňuje pridať aplikáciu ako počítačovú aplikáciu. inak beží dobre ako bežná karta prehliadača.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: áno. Neexistuje žiadna registrácia, žiadne predplatné ani platba v žiadnom bode – stačí si vybrať krajinu alebo kanál a začať pozerať.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Je tv.garden to isté ako FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nie. Pôvodná tv.garden sa v roku 2026 zmenila na Famelack a už nepoužíva názov TV Garden. FreeTV Garden je samostatná, nezávisle prevádzkovaná stránka – nie je prepojená s Famelack ani s pôvodnou tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Má FreeTV Garden rovnaké funkcie ako TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Áno, plus ďalšie. FreeTV Garden má rovnaký zážitok z otáčania zemegule a výberu krajiny spolu s 84+ jazykovými filtrami, 25+ kategóriami obsahu, prehrávaním obrazu v obraze, obľúbenými položkami, ktoré môžete označiť hviezdičkou a prezerať, tlačidlom náhodného kanála a inštaláciou jedným klepnutím priamo z prehliadača Chrome alebo Safari – nepotrebujete žiadny obchod s aplikáciami.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Má FreeTV Garden aj rádio a webkamery?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: áno. FreeTV Garden má tiež kartu Rádio so živými stanicami rôznych žánrov, ako je Pop, Jazz a Talk, a kartu Webová kamera so živými kanálmi z kamier z celého sveta. Prepínajte karty nad zemeguľou.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: V čom sa FreeTV Garden líši od radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden je samostatný, nezávisle vedený projekt — nie je prepojený s radio.garden. Ponúka jednoduchšie, intuitívnejšie rozhranie s jednoduchšou navigáciou a presahuje rámec rádia so živou televíziou a webovými kamerami zabudovanými do rovnakého bezplatného nástroja na jedno klepnutie.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Čo sa stalo so starou stránkou FreeTool TV Garden na Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Tu sa to znova spustilo. Stránka, ktorá bývala na freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, je ten istý projekt, ktorý teraz beží pod vlastným názvom a doménou: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Nie je potrebný žiadny účet. FreeTV Garden na sledovanie nepožaduje e-mail, heslo ani žiadne osobné údaje.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Áno – FreeTV Garden beží v akomkoľvek modernom mobilnom prehliadači na Androide alebo iPhone a dá sa pridať na vašu domovskú obrazovku pre prístup jedným klepnutím (pozrite si časť Inštalácia vyššie).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Prečo sa na kanáli zobrazuje stav „Nedostupný“?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanály sú živé prenosy pochádzajúce od verejných vysielateľov, takže niektoré sú dočasne offline kvôli problémom so serverom vysielateľa. Skúste iný kanál alebo sa sem vráťte neskôr – väčšina sa vráti v priebehu niekoľkých minút až hodín.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden zhromažďuje verejne dostupné živé prenosy – predovšetkým z komunitného adresára iptv-org – a sama nehostuje ani neukladá žiadne video súbory. Ďalšie informácie nájdete v časti Právne predpisy a bezpečnosť nižšie.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Ďalšie otázky nájdete v úplnom {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden zhromažďuje verejne dostupné živé prenosy z bezplatných verejných zdrojov vrátane komunitného adresára iptv-org. Nehostuje ani neukladá žiadne video ani zvukové súbory a na používanie nevyžaduje účet.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Máte otázky, spätnú väzbu alebo kanál, ktorý chcete navrhnúť? E-mail {link1} .

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Завъртете фотореалистичен 3D сателитен глобус и открийте хиляди радиостанции на живо от цял ​​свят, начертани според тяхното реално местоположение на излъчване - безплатно, не се изисква регистрация.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Хиляди безплатни радиостанции на живо, организирани по жанрове — поп, джаз, разговори, новини, стари песни и други. Прегледайте {link1} или превключете към раздела Радио над глобуса.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Емисии на камера на живо от градове, забележителности, плажове и природни места по целия свят - безплатно, без регистрация. Прегледайте {link1} или превключете към раздела Уеб камера над глобуса.

seo.homeWebcamsIntroLink1.translated: директория на уеб камера на живо

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Всеки канал също е организиран по език — общо 84+ — така че можете да намерите нещо за гледане на езика, който всъщност говорите, а не само в държавата, в която разглеждате.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Всяка една от над 200-те държави в FreeTV Garden корици има своя собствена страница с канали — изберете своя по-долу или прегледайте по континент от пълния списък.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden не е в Play Store или App Store — вместо това се инсталира директно от вашия браузър, на всяко устройство, с няколко докосвания.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Отворете Chrome (или друг браузър, който поддържа уеб инсталирания) и отидете на freetvgarden.com. Потърсете иконата за инсталиране в адресната лента или отворете менюто на браузъра и изберете „Добавяне към началния екран“ / „Инсталиране на приложение“. След това FreeTV Garden ще се отвори на цял екран от вашия начален екран, точно като родно приложение, без да е необходимо изтегляне от Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Отворете freetvgarden.com в Safari. Докоснете иконата за споделяне, след което „Добавяне към началния екран“. Това добавя икона на приложение към вашия iPhone или iPad, която стартира сайта на цял екран — не е необходим списък в App Store и нищо за актуализиране.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Отворете вградения браузър на вашия телевизор и отворете freetvgarden.com. Ако вашият телевизор няма използваем браузър, предавайте страницата от телефона или лаптопа си с Chromecast или AirPlay, за да гледате вместо това на големия екран.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Отворете Silk Browser (предварително инсталиран на Fire TV устройства или безплатно от Amazon Appstore) и отидете на freetvgarden.com. Изберете държава или категория и започнете да гледате — не е необходим абонамент или допълнително приложение.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Всеки модерен настолен браузър работи - просто посетете freetvgarden.com. В Chrome или Edge в адресната лента се появява икона за инсталиране, за да го добавите като настолно приложение; иначе работи добре като обикновен раздел на браузъра.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Garden наистина ли е безплатен?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: да Няма регистрация, абонамент и плащане в нито един момент — просто изберете държава или канал и започнете да гледате.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden същото ли е като FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Не. Оригиналният tv.garden е ребрандиран на Famelack през 2026 г. и вече не използва името TV Garden. FreeTV Garden е отделен, независимо управляван сайт — не е свързан с Famelack или оригиналния tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden има ли същите функции като TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Да, плюс още. FreeTV Garden има същото завъртане на света, изживяване при избор на държава, заедно с 84+ езикови филтъра, 25+ категории съдържание, възпроизвеждане картина в картина, любими, които можете да отбележите и преглеждате отново, бутон за произволен канал и инсталиране с едно докосване направо от Chrome или Safari — не е необходим магазин за приложения.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden също има ли радио и уеб камери?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: да FreeTV Garden също има раздел Радио със станции на живо в различни жанрове като поп, джаз и разговори, както и раздел Уеб камера с емисии на камера на живо от цял ​​свят. Превключване на раздели над глобуса.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Как FreeTV Garden се различава от radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden е отделен, независимо управляван проект — не е свързан с radio.garden. Той предлага по-прост, по-интуитивен интерфейс с по-лесна навигация и надхвърля радиото с телевизия на живо и уеб камери, вградени в същия безплатен инструмент с едно докосване.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Какво се случи със старата страница на FreeTool TV Garden в Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Стартира отново тук. Страницата, която живееше на freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, е същият проект, който сега работи под собствено име и домейн: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Трябва ли да си създам акаунт?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Не е необходим акаунт. FreeTV Garden не иска имейл, парола или лични данни за гледане.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Да — FreeTV Garden работи във всеки модерен мобилен браузър на Android или iPhone и може да се добави към началния ви екран за достъп с едно докосване (вижте секцията Инсталиране по-горе).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Каналите са потоци на живо, произхождащи от обществени оператори, така че някои временно остават офлайн поради проблеми със сървъра на самия оператор. Опитайте друг канал или проверете отново по-късно - повечето се връщат в рамките на няколко минути до часове.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Потоците законни ли са за гледане?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden събира обществено достъпни потоци на живо — основно от директорията на общността iptv-org — и не хоства или съхранява никакви видео файлове. За повече информация вижте раздела Правна информация и безопасност по-долу.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: На още въпроси се отговаря на пълния {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden събира публично достъпни потоци на живо от безплатни обществени източници, включително директорията на iptv-org общността. Той не хоства и не съхранява никакви видео или аудио файлове и не изисква акаунт за използване.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Въпроси, отзиви или канал за предложение? Изпратете имейл на {link1}.

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: Да ли ФрееТВ Гарден хостује или отпрема видео стримове?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: Не. ФрееТВ Гарден не хостује, отпрема или складишти било какве видео датотеке. Повезује се са јавно доступним стримовима тако да их можете гледати директно са сервера емитера.

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: Број се мења како се стримови укључују и ван мреже — отворите алатку изнад да видите шта је тренутно уживо.

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Да. ФрееТВ Гарден обједињује Фрее-то-Аир (ФТА) канале који су јавно доступни на мрежи. За гледање није потребна претплата, налог или апликација.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: Број канала се често мења како се јавни стримови укључују и ван мреже — отворите алатку изнад да бисте видели шта је тренутно уживо.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: Ова листа се аутоматски ажурира из јавног именика иптв-орг.

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Повезујете се директно на сопствени сервер емитера, тако да брзина и поузданост зависе од њихове инфраструктуре, а не од наше. Ако се један канал не учита, покушајте са другим са листе.

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Да — плејер ради на било ком претраживачу телефона без преузимања апликације. Само отворите ову страницу, додирните канал са вестима и користите цео екран за најбољи приказ.

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Не. ФрееТВ Гарден је независни директоријум који повезује са јавно доступним стримовима. Није повезан, одобрен од стране или њиме управља ниједан емитер који је наведен на овој страници.

seo.genreFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.genreFaqFreeA.translated: Да. ФрееТВ Гарден обједињује Фрее-то-Аир (ФТА) канале који су јавно доступни на мрежи. Није потребна претплата, налог или апликација.

seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online, regardless of which country they broadcast from. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeA.translated: Да. ФрееТВ Гарден обједињује Фрее-то-Аир (ФТА) канале који су јавно доступни на мрежи, без обзира из које земље емитују. Није потребна претплата, налог или апликација.

ui.noFavoritesYet.en: No favorites yet. Tap the ☆ on any channel to save it here.
ui.noFavoritesYet.translated: Још нема фаворита. Додирните ☆ на било ком каналу да бисте га сачували овде.

ui.noRecentYet.translated: Још нема недавно пуштаних канала.

seo.homeH1.translated: Гледајте бесплатно ТВ, радио и амп; Веб камере са било ког места у свету

seo.faqFreeAnswer.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available streams. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.faqFreeAnswer.translated: Да. ФрееТВ Гарден обједињује јавно доступне стримове. Није потребна претплата, налог или апликација.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden
seo.satHubTitle.translated: Сателитски радио - Радио Глобе уживо | ФрееТВ Гарден

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: Истражите хиљаде радио станица уживо из целог света на интерактивном сателитском глобусу. Кликните на било коју станицу да бисте слушали уживо, бесплатно.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Истражите радио уживо на интерактивном сателитском глобусу

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Завртите фотореалистичан 3Д сателитски глобус и откријте хиљаде радио станица уживо из целог света, уцртаних њиховом стварном локацијом емитовања — бесплатно, није потребна регистрација.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: ТВ канали уживо су организовани у 25+ категорија — вести, спорт, филмови, музика, деца, документарни филмови и још много тога — тако да можете да претражујете по ономе што желите да гледате уместо да скролујете кроз све.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Сваки канал је такође организован по језику — 84+ укупно — тако да можете пронаћи нешто за гледање на језику који заправо говорите, а не само у земљи коју прегледате.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Свака од 200+ земаља које ФрееТВ Гарден покрива има своју наменску страницу канала — изаберите свој испод или претражујте по континентима са целе листе.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: ФрееТВ Гарден није у Плаи продавници или Апп Сторе-у – уместо тога се инсталира директно из вашег претраживача, на било који уређај, у неколико додира.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Отворите Цхроме (или други прегледач који подржава веб инсталације) и идите на фреетвгарден.цом. Потражите икону за инсталацију на траци за адресу или отворите мени прегледача и изаберите „Додај на почетни екран“ / „Инсталирај апликацију“. ФрееТВ Гарден ће се затим отворити преко целог екрана са вашег почетног екрана, баш као изворна апликација, без потребе за преузимањем из Плаи продавнице.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Отворите фреетвгарден.цом у Сафарију. Додирните икону Дели, а затим „Додај на почетни екран“. Ово додаје икону апликације на ваш иПхоне или иПад која покреће веб локацију преко целог екрана — није потребан унос у Апп Сторе-у и ништа за ажурирање.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Отворите уграђени претраживач вашег ТВ-а и идите на фреетвгарден.цом. Ако ваш ТВ нема употребљив прегледач, пребаците страницу са телефона или лаптопа користећи Цхромецаст или АирПлаи да бисте је гледали на великом екрану.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Отворите Силк Бровсер (унапред инсталиран на Фире ТВ уређајима или бесплатно са Амазон Аппсторе-а) и идите на фреетвгарден.цом. Изаберите земљу или категорију и почните да гледате — није потребна претплата или додатна апликација.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Сваки модерни десктоп претраживач ради - само посетите фреетвгарден.цом. У Цхроме-у или Едге-у, икона за инсталацију се појављује на траци за адресу да бисте је додали као апликацију за десктоп; иначе ради добро као обична картица претраживача.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Да ли је ФрееТВ Гарден заиста бесплатан?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Да. Нема регистрације, претплате и плаћања у било ком тренутку – само изаберите земљу или канал и почните да гледате.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Да ли је тв.гарден исто што и ФрееТВ Гарден?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Не. Оригинални тв.гарден је преименован у Фамелацк 2026. и више не користи назив ТВ Гарден. ФрееТВ Гарден је засебан, независно вођен сајт — није повезан са Фамелацк-ом или оригиналним тв.гарден-ом.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Да ли ФрееТВ Гарден има исте карактеристике као ТВ Гарден?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Да, плус више. ФрееТВ Гарден има исто окретно искуство, бирајте земљу, заједно са филтерима за 84+ језика, 25+ категорија садржаја, репродукцијом слике у слици, омиљеним садржајима које можете да означите звездицом и поново их посетите, дугметом за насумични канал и инсталирањем једним додиром директно из Цхроме-а или Сафарија – није потребна продавница апликација.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Да ли ФрееТВ Гарден такође има радио и веб камере?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Да. ФрееТВ Гарден такође има картицу Радио са станицама уживо у различитим жанровима као што су поп, џез и разговор, као и картицу веб камера са каналима уживо из целог света. Промените картице изнад глобуса.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: По чему се ФрееТВ Гарден разликује од радио.гарден?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: ФрееТВ Гарден је посебан, независно вођен пројекат — није повезан са радио.гарден. Нуди једноставнији, интуитивнији интерфејс са лакшом навигацијом и превазилази радио са ТВ уживо и веб камерама уграђеним у исти бесплатни алат једним додиром.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Шта се десило са старом ФрееТоол ТВ Гарден страницом на Одоо-у?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Овде је поново покренут. Страница која је некада живела на фреетоол.одоо.цом/тв-гарден је исти пројекат, а сада ради под сопственим именом и доменом: ФрееТВ Гарден.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Да ли треба да отворим налог?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Није потребан налог. ФрееТВ Гарден не тражи е-пошту, лозинку или било какве личне податке за гледање.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Да — ФрееТВ Гарден ради у било ком модерном мобилном претраживачу на Андроиду или иПхоне-у и може се додати на ваш почетни екран за приступ једним додиром (погледајте одељак Инсталација изнад).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Канали су стримови уживо који потичу од јавних емитера, тако да неки привремено одлазе ван мреже због проблема са сервером самог емитера. Покушајте са другим каналом или проверите касније – већина се враћа у року од неколико минута до сати.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Да ли су стримови легални за гледање?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: ФрееТВ Гарден обједињује јавно доступне стримове уживо — првенствено из директорија заједнице иптв-орг — и сам не хостује нити чува никакве видео датотеке. Погледајте одељак Право и безбедност у наставку за више.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: ФрееТВ Гарден обједињује јавно доступне стримове уживо из бесплатних јавних извора, укључујући иптв-орг именик заједнице. Не хостује и не чува никакве видео или аудио датотеке и не захтева налог за коришћење.
