seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Okrenite fotorealistični 3D satelitski globus i otkrijte tisuće radijskih postaja uživo iz cijelog svijeta, ucrtanih prema njihovoj stvarnoj lokaciji emitiranja — besplatno, nije potrebna registracija.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: TV kanali uživo organizirani su u više od 25 kategorija — Vijesti, Sport, Filmovi, Glazba, Djeca, Dokumentarci i još mnogo toga — tako da možete pregledavati prema onome što želite gledati umjesto da listate kroz sve.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Tisuće besplatnih radijskih postaja uživo, organiziranih po žanrovima — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies i više. Pregledajte {link1} ili se prebacite na karticu Radio iznad globusa.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Kamera prenosi uživo iz gradova, znamenitosti, plaža i prirodnih mjesta širom svijeta — besplatno, bez prijave. Pregledajte {link1} ili se prebacite na karticu Web kamera iznad globusa.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Svaki kanal također je organiziran prema jeziku — ukupno 84+ — tako da možete pronaći nešto za gledanje na jeziku koji zapravo govorite, a ne samo u zemlji koju pregledavate.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Svaka od 200+ zemalja FreeTV Garden naslovnica ima vlastitu namjensku stranicu kanala — odaberite svoj u nastavku ili pretražite po kontinentu s cijelog popisa.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden nije u Play Storeu ili App Storeu — umjesto toga instalira se izravno iz vašeg preglednika, na bilo kojem uređaju, u nekoliko dodira.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Otvorite Chrome (ili neki drugi preglednik koji podržava web instalacije) i idite na freetvgarden.com. Potražite ikonu instalacije u adresnoj traci ili otvorite izbornik preglednika i odaberite "Dodaj na početni zaslon" / "Instaliraj aplikaciju". FreeTV Garden će se zatim otvoriti preko cijelog zaslona s vašeg početnog zaslona, ​​baš kao izvorna aplikacija, bez potrebe za preuzimanjem iz Trgovine Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Otvorite freetvgarden.com u Safariju. Dodirnite ikonu Dijeli, zatim "Dodaj na početni zaslon". Time se na vaš iPhone ili iPad dodaje ikona aplikacije koja pokreće web-mjesto na cijelom zaslonu — nije potreban unos u App Storeu i ništa za ažuriranje.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Otvorite preglednik ugrađen u svoj TV i idite na freetvgarden.com. Ako vaš TV nema preglednik koji se može koristiti, emitirajte stranicu sa svog telefona ili prijenosnog računala pomoću Chromecasta ili AirPlaya da biste je gledali na velikom ekranu.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Otvorite Silk Browser (predinstaliran na Fire TV uređajima ili besplatan iz Amazon Appstorea) i idite na freetvgarden.com. Odaberite državu ili kategoriju i počnite gledati — nije potrebna pretplata ili dodatna aplikacija.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Svaki moderni stolni preglednik radi — samo posjetite freetvgarden.com. U Chromeu ili Edgeu, ikona za instalaciju pojavljuje se u adresnoj traci da biste je dodali kao aplikaciju za radnu površinu; inače dobro radi kao obična kartica preglednika.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Je li FreeTV Garden stvarno besplatan?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Da. Nema prijave, pretplate i plaćanja u bilo kojem trenutku — samo odaberite državu ili kanal i počnite gledati.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Je li tv.garden isto što i FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ne. Izvorni tv.garden preimenovan je u Famelack 2026. i više ne koristi naziv TV Garden. FreeTV Garden je zasebno, neovisno vođeno mjesto — nije povezano s Famelackom ili izvornim tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ima li FreeTV Garden iste značajke kao TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Da, plus više. FreeTV Garden ima isto iskustvo okretanja globusa, odabira zemlje, zajedno s 84+ jezičnih filtara, 25+ kategorija sadržaja, reprodukcijom slike u slici, favoritima koje možete zvjezdicama i ponovno posjećivati, gumbom za nasumične kanale i instalacijom jednim dodirom izravno iz Chromea ili Safarija — trgovina aplikacija nije potrebna.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Ima li FreeTV Garden i radio i web kamere?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Da. FreeTV Garden također ima karticu Radio sa postajama uživo u žanrovima kao što su Pop, Jazz i Talk, kao i karticu Web kamere sa live feedovima kamere iz cijelog svijeta. Promjena kartice iznad globusa.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Kako se FreeTV Garden razlikuje od radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden je zaseban, neovisno vođen projekt — nije povezan s radio.garden. Nudi jednostavnije, intuitivnije sučelje s lakšom navigacijom i nadilazi radio uz TV uživo i web kamere ugrađene u isti besplatni alat jednim dodirom.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Što se dogodilo sa starom stranicom FreeTool TV Garden na Odoou?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Ponovno je pokrenut ovdje. Stranica koja je prije živjela na freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden isti je projekt koji sada radi pod vlastitim imenom i domenom: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Račun nije potreban. FreeTV Garden ne traži e-poštu, lozinku niti bilo kakve osobne podatke za gledanje.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Da — FreeTV Garden radi u bilo kojem modernom mobilnom pregledniku na Androidu ili iPhoneu i može se dodati na vaš početni zaslon za pristup jednim dodirom (pogledajte gornji odjeljak za instalaciju).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanali su live streamovi koji potječu od javnih emitera, pa se neki privremeno isključuju zbog problema s poslužiteljem samog emitera. Pokušajte s drugim kanalom ili provjerite kasnije — većina se vrati u roku od nekoliko minuta do sati.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Jesu li streamovi legalni za gledanje?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden prikuplja javno dostupne prijenose uživo — prvenstveno iz imenika iptv-org zajednice — i sam ne hostira niti pohranjuje video datoteke. Za više pogledajte odjeljak Pravni i sigurnosni podaci u nastavku.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Odgovori na dodatna pitanja nalaze se na cijelom {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden prikuplja javno dostupne prijenose uživo iz besplatnih javnih izvora, uključujući imenik zajednice iptv-org. Ne ugošćuje niti pohranjuje video ili audio datoteke i ne zahtijeva račun za korištenje.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Pitanja, povratne informacije ili kanal za predložiti? Pošaljite e-poštu {link1}.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ja FreeTV Garden združuje kanale Free-to-Air (FTA), ki so javno dostopni na spletu. Za gledanje ni potrebna naročnina, račun ali aplikacija.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Zakaj nekateri kanali {countryName} medpomnilnik ali se ne naložijo?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Povezujete se neposredno s strežnikom izdajatelja televizijskega programa, zato sta hitrost in zanesljivost odvisni od njihove infrastrukture, ne naše. Če se en kanal ne naloži, poskusite drugega s seznama.

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Da — predvajalnik deluje v katerem koli brskalniku telefona brez prenosa aplikacije. Samo odprite to stran, tapnite kanal z novicami in uporabite celozaslonski način za najboljši pogled.

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Ne. FreeTV Garden je neodvisen imenik s povezavami do javno dostopnih tokov. Ni povezan z nobenim izdajateljem televizijskega programa, ki je naveden na tej strani, ga ne podpira ali upravlja.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Vsaka od več kot 200 držav naslovnic FreeTV Garden ima svojo namensko stran kanalov — izberite svojega spodaj ali na celotnem seznamu brskajte po celinah.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ni v Trgovini Play ali App Store – namesto tega se namesti neposredno iz vašega brskalnika v kateri koli napravi z nekaj dotiki.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Odprite Chrome (ali drug brskalnik, ki podpira spletne namestitve) in pojdite na freetvgarden.com. V naslovni vrstici poiščite ikono za namestitev ali odprite meni brskalnika in izberite »Dodaj na začetni zaslon« / »Namesti aplikacijo«. FreeTV Garden se bo nato odprl v celozaslonskem načinu z vašega začetnega zaslona, ​​tako kot domača aplikacija, brez potrebe po prenosu iz Trgovine Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Odprite freetvgarden.com v Safariju. Tapnite ikono za skupno rabo in nato »Dodaj na začetni zaslon«. To vašemu iPhonu ali iPadu doda ikono aplikacije, ki zažene spletno mesto v celozaslonskem načinu – vnos v trgovini App Store ni potreben in nič za posodabljanje.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Odprite brskalnik, vgrajen v vaš televizor, in se pomaknite do freetvgarden.com. Če vaš televizor nima uporabnega brskalnika, predvajajte stran iz telefona ali prenosnega računalnika s Chromecastom ali AirPlayom in jo raje gledajte na velikem zaslonu.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Odprite Silk Browser (prednameščen na napravah Fire TV ali brezplačen v trgovini Amazon Appstore) in pojdite na freetvgarden.com. Izberite državo ali kategorijo in začnite gledati – ni potrebna naročnina ali dodatna aplikacija.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Vsak sodoben namizni brskalnik deluje – preprosto obiščite freetvgarden.com. V Chromu ali Edge se v naslovni vrstici prikaže ikona za namestitev, da jo dodate kot namizno aplikacijo; drugače deluje kot običajen zavihek brskalnika.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ja Na nobeni točki ni nobene prijave, naročnine ali plačila – samo izberite državo ali kanal in začnite gledati.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Je tv.garden isto kot FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ne. Prvotni tv.garden se je leta 2026 preimenoval v Famelack in ne uporablja več imena TV Garden. FreeTV Garden je ločeno, neodvisno vodeno spletno mesto - ni povezano s Famelackom ali izvirnim tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ali ima FreeTV Garden enake funkcije kot TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Da, in še več. FreeTV Garden ima enako vrtenje globusa, izbiro države, skupaj s 84+ jezikovnimi filtri, 25+ kategorijami vsebine, predvajanjem slike v sliki, priljubljenimi, ki jih lahko označite z zvezdico in jih znova obiščete, gumbom za naključne kanale in namestitvijo z enim dotikom neposredno iz Chroma ali Safarija – trgovina z aplikacijami ni potrebna.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Ali ima FreeTV Garden tudi radio in spletne kamere?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ja FreeTV Garden ima tudi zavihek Radio s postajami v živo v različnih zvrsteh, kot so pop, jazz in pogovor, ter zavihek Webcam z viri kamer v živo z vsega sveta. Preklapljanje zavihkov nad globusom.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Kako se FreeTV Garden razlikuje od radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden je ločen, neodvisen projekt, ki ni povezan z radio.garden. Ponuja enostavnejši, bolj intuitiven vmesnik z lažjo navigacijo in presega radio s televizijo v živo in spletnimi kamerami, vgrajenimi v isto brezplačno orodje z enim dotikom.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kaj se je zgodilo s staro stranjo FreeTool TV Garden na Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Tukaj se je znova zagnalo. Stran, ki je prej živela na freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, je isti projekt, ki zdaj deluje pod svojim imenom in domeno: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Račun ni potreben. FreeTV Garden ne zahteva e-pošte, gesla ali kakršnih koli osebnih podatkov za gledanje.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Da — FreeTV Garden deluje v katerem koli sodobnem mobilnem brskalniku v sistemu Android ali iPhone in ga je mogoče dodati na začetni zaslon za dostop z enim dotikom (glejte razdelek Namestitev zgoraj).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Zakaj je na kanalu prikazano "Ni na voljo"?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanali so pretočna predvajanja v živo, ki izvirajo iz javnih izdajateljev televizijskih programov, zato so nekateri začasno brez povezave zaradi težav s strežnikom izdajatelja televizijskega programa. Poskusite drug kanal ali preverite znova pozneje - večina se vrne v nekaj minutah do urah.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Ali so tokovi zakoniti za gledanje?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden združuje javno dostopne tokove v živo – predvsem iz imenika skupnosti iptv-org – in sam ne gosti ali shranjuje nobenih video datotek. Za več si oglejte spodnji razdelek Pravne in varnostne informacije.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Odgovore na več vprašanj najdete na celotnem {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden združuje javno dostopne prenose v živo iz brezplačnih javnih virov, vključno z imenikom skupnosti iptv-org. Ne gosti ali shranjuje nobenih video ali zvočnih datotek in za uporabo ne potrebuje računa.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Imate vprašanja, povratne informacije ali predlagate kanal? Pošlji e-pošto {link1}.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: „FreeTV Garden“ nėra „Play Store“ ar „App Store“ – ji įdiegiama tiesiai iš jūsų naršyklės bet kuriame įrenginyje vos keliais palietimais.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Atidarykite „Chrome“ (arba kitą naršyklę, kuri palaiko žiniatinklio diegimą) ir eikite į freetvgarden.com. Adreso juostoje ieškokite diegimo piktogramos arba atidarykite naršyklės meniu ir pasirinkite „Pridėti prie pagrindinio ekrano“ / „Įdiegti programą“. Tada „FreeTV Garden“ bus atidarytas viso ekrano režimu iš pagrindinio ekrano, kaip ir vietinėje programoje, nereikia atsisiųsti iš „Play“ parduotuvės.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Atidarykite freetvgarden.com naudodami „Safari“. Bakstelėkite bendrinimo piktogramą, tada „Pridėti prie pagrindinio ekrano“. Taip prie „iPhone“ ar „iPad“ pridedama programos piktograma, kuri paleidžia svetainę visame ekrane – nereikia „App Store“ sąrašo ir nieko nereikia atnaujinti.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Atidarykite televizoriaus integruotą naršyklę ir eikite į freetvgarden.com. Jei jūsų televizoriuje nėra tinkamos naršyklės, perduokite puslapį iš telefono ar nešiojamojo kompiuterio naudodami „Chromecast“ arba „AirPlay“, kad galėtumėte žiūrėti dideliame ekrane.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Atidarykite „Silk Browser“ (iš anksto įdiegtą „Fire TV“ įrenginiuose arba nemokamai iš „Amazon Appstore“) ir eikite į freetvgarden.com. Pasirinkite šalį arba kategoriją ir pradėkite žiūrėti – nereikia prenumeratos ar papildomos programos.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Veikia bet kuri moderni darbalaukio naršyklė – tiesiog apsilankykite freetvgarden.com. Jei naudojate „Chrome“ arba „Edge“, adreso juostoje pasirodo diegimo piktograma, kad ją būtų galima pridėti kaip darbalaukio programą; kitu atveju jis veikia gerai kaip įprastas naršyklės skirtukas.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Taip. Jokiu būdu nereikia prisiregistruoti, prenumeruoti ir nemokėti – tiesiog pasirinkite šalį arba kanalą ir pradėkite žiūrėti.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Ar tv.garden yra tas pats kas FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ne. 2026 m. originalus tv.garden pavadinimas pakeistas į Famelack ir nebenaudojamas TV Garden pavadinimas. „FreeTV Garden“ yra atskira, nepriklausomai valdoma svetainė, nesusijusi su Famelack ar originaliu tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ar „FreeTV Garden“ turi tas pačias funkcijas kaip „TV Garden“?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Taip, ir dar daugiau. „FreeTV Garden“ turi tą pačią sukimosi aplinką ir pasirinkimo šalį patirtį, taip pat 84 ir daugiau kalbų filtrus, 25 ir daugiau turinio kategorijas, vaizdo vaizde atkūrimą, mėgstamiausius, kuriuos galite pažymėti žvaigždute ir peržiūrėti, atsitiktinio kanalo mygtuką ir įdiegimą vienu paspaudimu tiesiai iš „Chrome“ arba „Safari“ – nereikia programų parduotuvės.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Ar „FreeTV Garden“ taip pat turi radiją ir internetines kameras?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Taip. „FreeTV Garden“ taip pat turi skirtuką „Radio“ su tiesioginėmis stotimis įvairiuose žanruose, pvz., Pop, Jazz ir Talk, ir „Webcam“ skirtuką su tiesioginiais kamerų kanalais iš viso pasaulio. Perjunkite skirtukus virš Žemės rutulio.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Kuo „FreeTV Garden“ skiriasi nuo radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: „FreeTV Garden“ yra atskiras, nepriklausomai vykdomas projektas, nesusijęs su radio.garden. Ji siūlo paprastesnę, intuityvesnę sąsają su lengvesne naršymu ir neapsiriboja radijo ryšiu – tiesiogine televizija ir internetinėmis kameromis, integruotomis į tą patį nemokamą, vieno paspaudimo įrankį.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kas nutiko senam „FreeTool TV Garden“ puslapiui „Odoo“?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Čia jis vėl paleistas. Puslapis, kuris anksčiau gyveno adresu freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, yra tas pats projektas, dabar veikiantis savo pavadinimu ir domenu: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Paskyros nereikia. „FreeTV Garden“ neprašo el. pašto, slaptažodžio ar jokios asmeninės informacijos, kad galėtumėte žiūrėti.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Taip – ​​„FreeTV Garden“ veikia bet kurioje modernioje „Android“ arba „iPhone“ mobiliojo ryšio naršyklėje ir gali būti įtrauktas į pagrindinį ekraną, kad galėtumėte pasiekti vieną bakstelėjimą (žr. aukščiau esantį skyrių „Įdiegti“).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanalai yra tiesioginiai srautai, gaunami iš visuomeninių transliuotojų, todėl kai kurie laikinai atsijungia dėl transliuotojo serverio problemų. Išbandykite kitą kanalą arba patikrinkite vėliau – dauguma sugrįžta per kelias minutes ar valandas.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: „FreeTV Garden“ kaupia viešai prieinamas tiesiogines transliacijas – pirmiausia iš „iptv-org“ bendruomenės katalogo – ir pats nesaugo ir nesaugo jokių vaizdo failų. Daugiau informacijos rasite žemiau esančiame skyriuje Teisė ir sauga.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Daugiau klausimų rasite visame {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: „FreeTV Garden“ kaupia viešai pasiekiamus tiesioginius srautus iš nemokamų viešųjų šaltinių, įskaitant „iptv-org“ bendruomenės katalogą. Jame nėra prieglobos ir nesaugomi jokie vaizdo ar garso failai ir nereikia paskyros.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Turite klausimų, atsiliepimų ar siūlote kanalą? El. paštas {link1}.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Kā skatīties {countryName} televizoru savā ierīcē

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Lai skatītos {countryName} kanālus, nav nepieciešama lietotne vai konts. Šī lapa darbojas tieši jūsu pārlūkprogrammā jebkurā ierīcē — vienkārši pieskarieties kanālam un nospiediet atskaņot.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Atveriet šo lapu pārlūkā Chrome, pieskarieties {countryName} kanālam, lai sāktu skatīties, un pēc tam izmantojiet pilnekrāna pogu, lai iegūtu vislabāko skatu. Lai nākamajā reizē ātri piekļūtu, pieskarieties Chrome izvēlnei un izvēlieties "Pievienot sākuma ekrānam", lai izveidotu lietotnei līdzīgu ikonu.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Atveriet šo lapu pārlūkprogrammā Safari un pieskarieties jebkuram {countryName} kanālam, lai nekavējoties sāktu straumēšanu. Pieskarieties ikonai Kopīgot un atlasiet "Pievienot sākuma ekrānam", lai piekļūtu ar vienu pieskārienu, nelejupielādējot lietotni no App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Darbojas jebkurš moderns pārlūks - Chrome, Safari, Firefox vai Edge. Atveriet {countryName} kanālu un izmantojiet pilnekrāna ikonu atskaņotājā, lai bez traucēkļiem baudītu televizoram līdzīgu skatīšanās pieredzi.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden nav pieejams Play veikalā vai App Store — tā vietā tas tiek instalēts tieši no jūsu pārlūkprogrammas jebkurā ierīcē, veicot dažus pieskārienus.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Atveriet pārlūku Chrome (vai citu pārlūkprogrammu, kas atbalsta tīmekļa instalēšanu) un dodieties uz vietni freetvgarden.com. Adreses joslā meklējiet instalēšanas ikonu vai atveriet pārlūkprogrammas izvēlni un izvēlieties "Pievienot sākuma ekrānam" / "Instalēt lietotni". Pēc tam FreeTV Garden tiks atvērts pilnekrāna režīmā no sākuma ekrāna, tāpat kā vietējā lietotne, un nav nepieciešama lejupielāde no Play veikala.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari atveriet vietni freetvgarden.com. Pieskarieties ikonai Kopīgot un pēc tam — Pievienot sākuma ekrānam. Tādējādi jūsu iPhone vai iPad tiek pievienota lietotnes ikona, kas palaiž vietni pilnekrāna režīmā — nav nepieciešams App Store ieraksts un nekas nav jāatjaunina.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Atveriet televizora iebūvēto pārlūkprogrammu un dodieties uz vietni freetvgarden.com. Ja televizoram nav lietojama pārlūkprogramma, apraidiet lapu no tālruņa vai klēpjdatora, izmantojot Chromecast vai AirPlay, lai skatītos to lielajā ekrānā.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Atveriet Silk Browser (iepriekš instalēta Fire TV ierīcēs vai bez maksas no Amazon Appstore) un dodieties uz freetvgarden.com. Atlasiet valsti vai kategoriju un sāciet skatīties — nav nepieciešams abonements vai papildu lietotne.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Darbojas jebkura moderna darbvirsmas pārlūkprogramma — vienkārši apmeklējiet freetvgarden.com. Pārlūkā Chrome vai Edge adreses joslā tiek parādīta instalēšanas ikona, lai to pievienotu kā darbvirsmas lietotni; pretējā gadījumā tā darbojas labi kā parasta pārlūkprogrammas cilne.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Vai FreeTV Garden tiešām ir bezmaksas?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Jā. Nevienā brīdī nav jāreģistrējas, nav abonēšanas un nav jāmaksā — vienkārši izvēlieties valsti vai kanālu un sāciet skatīties.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Vai tv.garden ir tas pats, kas FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nē. Sākotnējais tv.garden zīmols tika mainīts uz Famelack 2026. gadā, un tajā vairs netiek izmantots nosaukums TV Garden. FreeTV Garden ir atsevišķa, neatkarīgi vadīta vietne, kas nav saistīta ar Famelack vai oriģinālo tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Vai FreeTV Garden ir tādas pašas funkcijas kā TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Jā, plus vēl vairāk. FreeTV Garden piedāvā tādas pašas iespējas, kā griezties pasaulē, izvēlēties valsti, kā arī 84+ valodu filtri, 25+ satura kategorijas, attēla atskaņošana attēlā, izlase, ko varat atzīmēt ar zvaigznīti un atkārtoti apmeklēt, nejauša kanāla poga un instalēšana ar vienu pieskārienu tieši no Chrome vai Safari — nav nepieciešams lietotņu veikals.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Vai FreeTV Garden ir arī radio un tīmekļa kameras?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Jā. FreeTV Garden ir arī cilne Radio ar tiešraides stacijām dažādos žanros, piemēram, Pop, Jazz un Talk, un cilne Webcam ar tiešraides kameru plūsmām no visas pasaules. Pārslēdziet cilnes virs zemeslodes.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Ar ko FreeTV Garden atšķiras no radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden ir atsevišķs, neatkarīgi vadīts projekts, kas nav saistīts ar radio.garden. Tas piedāvā vienkāršāku, intuitīvāku saskarni ar vieglāku navigāciju un sniedz ne tikai radio, bet arī TV tiešraidi un tīmekļa kameras, kas iebūvētas tajā pašā bezmaksas viena pieskāriena rīkā.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kas notika ar veco FreeTool TV Garden lapu vietnē Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Šeit tas tika atsākts. Lapa, kas agrāk atradās vietnē freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, ir tas pats projekts, kas tagad darbojas ar savu nosaukumu un domēnu: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Konts nav vajadzīgs. FreeTV Garden nepieprasa e-pastu, paroli vai jebkādu personisku informāciju, lai skatītos.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Jā — FreeTV Garden darbojas jebkurā modernā mobilajā pārlūkprogrammā Android vai iPhone, un to var pievienot sākuma ekrānam, lai piekļūtu ar vienu pieskārienu (skatiet iepriekš sadaļu Instalēšana).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanāli ir tiešraides straumes, ko iegūst no sabiedriskām raidorganizācijām, tāpēc daži īslaicīgi pāriet bezsaistē paša raidorganizācijas servera problēmu dēļ. Izmēģiniet citu kanālu vai pārbaudiet vēlāk — lielākā daļa atgriežas dažu minūšu vai stundu laikā.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden apkopo publiski pieejamās tiešraides straumes — galvenokārt no iptv-org kopienas direktorija — un pats neuztur un neuzglabā video failus. Plašāku informāciju skatiet zemāk esošajā sadaļā Juridiskie un drošības noteikumi.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Uz citiem jautājumiem ir atbildes uz pilnu {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden apkopo publiski pieejamas tiešraides straumes no bezmaksas publiskiem avotiem, tostarp iptv-org kopienas direktorija. Tajā netiek mitināti un neuzglabāti video vai audio faili, un tā lietošanai nav nepieciešams konts.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Vai jums ir jautājumi, atsauksmes vai kanāls, ko ieteikt? E-pasts {link1}.

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Kas {countryName} teleri vaatamine FreeTV Gardenis on tasuta?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Jah. FreeTV Garden koondab tasuta levi (FTA) kanalid, mis on veebis avalikult saadaval. Vaatamiseks pole vaja tellimust, kontot ega rakendust.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Miks mõned {countryName} kanalid puhverdavad või laadimine ebaõnnestub?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Loote ühenduse otse ringhäälinguorganisatsiooni enda serveriga, nii et kiirus ja töökindlus sõltuvad nende infrastruktuurist, mitte meie omast. Kui üks kanal ei laadi, proovige loendist teist kanalit.

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden pole Play poes ega App Store'is – see installitakse mõne puudutusega mis tahes seadmesse otse teie brauserist.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Avage Chrome (või mõni muu veebiinstallimist toetav brauser) ja minge saidile freetvgarden.com. Otsige aadressiribalt installiikooni või avage brauseri menüü ja valige "Lisa avakuvale" / "Installi rakendus". FreeTV Garden avaneb seejärel teie avakuval täisekraanil, täpselt nagu omarakendus, ilma Play poest allalaadimiseta.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Avage Safaris saidi freetvgarden.com. Puudutage ikooni Jaga ja seejärel valikut "Lisa avakuvale". See lisab teie iPhone'ile või iPadile rakenduse ikooni, mis käivitab saidi täisekraanil – pole vaja App Store'i kirjet ega midagi, mida värskendada.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Avage oma teleri sisseehitatud brauser ja navigeerige saidile freetvgarden.com. Kui teie teleril pole kasutatavat brauserit, kandke leht üle oma telefonist või sülearvutist Chromecasti või AirPlay abil, et vaadata suurel ekraanil.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Avage Silk Browser (eelinstallitud Fire TV seadmetesse või tasuta Amazon Appstore'ist) ja minge saidile freetvgarden.com. Valige riik või kategooria ja alustage vaatamist – tellimust ega täiendavat rakendust pole vaja.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Iga kaasaegne lauaarvuti brauser töötab – lihtsalt külastage saiti freetvgarden.com. Chrome'is või Edge'is kuvatakse aadressiribale installiikoon, mis lisab selle töölauarakendusena; muidu töötab see tavalise brauseri vahekaardina hästi.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Kas FreeTV Garden on tõesti tasuta?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Jah. Pole vaja registreeruda, tellida ega maksta – valige lihtsalt riik või kanal ja alustage vaatamist.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Kas tv.garden on sama mis FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ei. Algne tv.garden muudeti 2026. aastal Famelackiks ja see ei kasuta enam TV Gardeni nime. FreeTV Garden on eraldiseisev, iseseisvalt hallatav sait – ei ole seotud Famelacki ega algse tv.gardeniga.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Kas FreeTV Gardenil on samad funktsioonid kui TV Gardenil?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Jah, pluss veel. FreeTV Garden pakub sama maakera ja riigi valimise kogemust, 84+ keelefiltrit, 25+ sisukategooriat, pilt-pildis taasesitus, lemmikud, mida saate tärniga tähistada ja uuesti külastada, juhusliku kanali nupp ja ühe puudutusega installimine otse Chrome'ist või Safarist – rakenduste poodi pole vaja.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Kas FreeTV Gardenil on ka raadio ja veebikaamerad?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Jah. FreeTV Gardenil on ka vahekaart Raadio, kus on otseülekanded erinevatest žanritest, nagu Pop, Jazz ja Talk, ning veebikaamera vahekaart, millel on kaamera otseülekanded kogu maailmast. Vahetage maakera kohal olevaid vahelehti.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Mille poolest FreeTV Garden erineb radio.gardenist?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden on eraldiseisev, iseseisvalt juhitav projekt, mis ei ole seotud radio.gardeniga. See pakub lihtsamat, intuitiivsemat liidest koos lihtsama navigeerimisega ning läheb kaugemale raadiost, kuna see on samasse tasuta ühe puudutusega tööriista sisse ehitatud otsetelevisiooni ja veebikaameratega.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Mis juhtus Odoo vana FreeTool TV Gardeni lehega?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: See käivitati siin uuesti. Leht, mis varem elas aadressil freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, on sama projekt, mis töötab nüüd oma nime ja domeeni all: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Kontot pole vaja. FreeTV Garden ei küsi vaatamiseks meili, parooli ega mingeid isikuandmeid.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Jah – FreeTV Garden töötab Androidi või iPhone'i mis tahes kaasaegses mobiilibrauseris ja selle saab ühe puudutusega juurdepääsu saamiseks lisada avakuvale (vt ülaltoodud jaotist Install).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanalid on avalik-õiguslikelt ringhäälinguorganisatsioonidelt hangitud otseülekanded, nii et mõned lähevad ajutiselt võrguühenduseta ringhäälinguorganisatsiooni enda serveriprobleemide tõttu. Proovige mõnda teist kanalit või tulge hiljem tagasi – enamik naaseb mõne minuti või tunni jooksul.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden koondab avalikult kättesaadavad otseülekanded – peamiselt iptv-org kogukonna kataloogist – ega majuta ega salvesta ise ühtegi videofaili. Lisateavet leiate allolevast jaotisest Õigus ja ohutus.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Rohkem küsimustele leiate vastused täismahus {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden koondab avalikult kättesaadavad otseülekanded tasuta avalikest allikatest, sealhulgas iptv-org kogukonna kataloogist. See ei majuta ega salvesta video- ega helifaile ning selle kasutamiseks pole vaja kontot.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Kas teil on küsimusi, tagasisidet või kanalit, mida soovitada? Meil {link1}.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Як дивитися {countryName} ТБ на своєму пристрої

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Для перегляду каналів {countryName} не потрібні жодна програма чи обліковий запис. Ця сторінка працює безпосередньо у вашому браузері на будь-якому пристрої – просто торкніться каналу та натисніть «Відтворити».

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.

Щоб отримати швидкий доступ наступного разу, торкніться меню Chrome і виберіть «Додати на головний екран», щоб створити піктограму програми.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Відкрийте цю сторінку в Safari та торкніться будь-якого каналу {countryName}, щоб миттєво почати трансляцію. Торкніться значка «Поділитися» та виберіть «Додати на головний екран», щоб отримати доступ одним дотиком без завантаження програми з App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Перегляд {countryName} телевізора на FreeTV Garden безкоштовний?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: так FreeTV Garden об’єднує безкоштовні (FTA) канали, які є загальнодоступними в Інтернеті. Для перегляду не потрібна підписка, обліковий запис або програма.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Чому деякі канали {countryName} буферизують або не завантажуються?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Ви підключаєтеся безпосередньо до власного сервера мовника, тому швидкість і надійність залежать від їх інфраструктури, а не від нашої. Якщо один канал не завантажується, спробуйте інший зі списку.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Так — плеєр працює в будь-якому браузері телефону без завантаження програми. Просто відкрийте цю сторінку, торкніться каналу новин і використовуйте повноекранний режим для найкращого перегляду.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Для кожної з понад 200 країн FreeTV Garden є окрема спеціальна сторінка каналів — виберіть свій нижче або перегляньте за континентом із повного списку.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden немає в Play Store або App Store — замість цього він встановлюється просто з вашого браузера на будь-якому пристрої за кілька дотиків.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Відкрийте Chrome (або інший браузер, який підтримує веб-встановлення) і перейдіть на freetvgarden.com. Знайдіть піктограму встановлення в адресному рядку або відкрийте меню браузера та виберіть «Додати на головний екран» / «Установити програму». Після цього FreeTV Garden відкриється в повноекранному режимі з домашнього екрана, як рідна програма, без необхідності завантажувати з Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Відкрийте freetvgarden.com у Safari. Торкніться значка «Поділитися», а потім «Додати на головний екран». Це додає піктограму програми на ваш iPhone або iPad, яка запускає сайт у повноекранному режимі — не потрібен список App Store і нічого не потрібно оновлювати.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Відкрийте вбудований браузер телевізора та перейдіть на freetvgarden.com. Якщо ваш телевізор не має зручного браузера, транслюйте сторінку зі свого телефону чи ноутбука за допомогою Chromecast або AirPlay, щоб натомість дивитися на великому екрані.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Відкрийте Silk Browser (попередньо встановлений на пристроях Fire TV або безкоштовно з Amazon Appstore) і перейдіть на freetvgarden.com. Виберіть країну чи категорію та почніть перегляд — підписка чи додатковий додаток не потрібні.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Будь-який сучасний настільний браузер працює — просто відвідайте freetvgarden.com. У Chrome або Edge в адресному рядку з’являється піктограма встановлення, щоб додати його як програму для робочого столу; інакше він працює нормально як звичайна вкладка браузера.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: так Немає жодної реєстрації, підписки та оплати — просто виберіть країну чи канал і почніть дивитися.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Чи tv.garden те саме, що FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ні. У 2026 році оригінальний tv.garden змінено на Famelack і більше не використовує назву TV Garden. FreeTV Garden — це окремий незалежний сайт, не пов’язаний із Famelack чи оригінальним tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Чи має FreeTV Garden ті самі функції, що й TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Так, плюс більше. FreeTV Garden має такий самий досвід обертання глобуса, вибору країни, а також 84+ мовних фільтрів, 25+ категорій вмісту, відтворення «картинка в картинці», вибране, яке можна позначити зірочкою та повторно переглядати, кнопку випадкового вибору каналу та встановлення одним дотиком прямо з Chrome або Safari — магазин програм не потрібен.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Чи є у FreeTV Garden також радіо та веб-камери?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: так FreeTV Garden також має вкладку «Радіо» з живими станціями різних жанрів, як-от поп, джаз і розмови, а також вкладку «Веб-камера» з трансляціями з камери в прямому ефірі з усього світу. Перемикайте вкладки над глобусом.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Чим FreeTV Garden відрізняється від radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden — це окремий незалежний проект, не пов’язаний з radio.garden. Він пропонує простіший, більш інтуїтивно зрозумілий інтерфейс із зручнішою навігацією та виходить за рамки радіо з живим телебаченням і веб-камерами, вбудованими в той самий безкоштовний інструмент одним дотиком.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Що сталося зі старою сторінкою FreeTool TV Garden на Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Його перезапустили тут. Сторінка, яка раніше жила за адресою freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden, є тим самим проектом, який зараз працює під власним ім’ям і доменом: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Чи потрібно мені створювати обліковий запис?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Обліковий запис не потрібен. FreeTV Garden не запитує електронну пошту, пароль або будь-яку особисту інформацію для перегляду.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Так — FreeTV Garden працює в будь-якому сучасному мобільному браузері на Android або iPhone і може бути доданий на головний екран для доступу одним дотиком (див. розділ «Встановлення» вище).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Канали – це прямі трансляції, які надходять від громадських мовників, тому деякі тимчасово відключаються через проблеми з сервером мовника. Спробуйте інший канал або перевірте пізніше — більшість повертається протягом кількох хвилин або годин.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden об’єднує загальнодоступні прямі трансляції — переважно з каталогу спільноти iptv-org — і не розміщує та не зберігає жодних відеофайлів. Щоб дізнатися більше, перегляньте розділ «Право та безпека» нижче.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Відповіді на інші запитання можна знайти на повному {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden об’єднує загальнодоступні прямі трансляції з безкоштовних загальнодоступних джерел, включно з каталогом спільноти iptv-org. Він не розміщує та не зберігає жодних відео чи аудіофайлів і не потребує облікового запису для використання.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Запитання, відгук чи канал, який можна запропонувати? Електронна пошта {link1}.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Почему некоторые каналы {countryName} буферизуются или не загружаются?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Вы подключаетесь напрямую к собственному серверу вещательной компании, поэтому скорость и надежность зависят от их инфраструктуры, а не от нашей. Если один канал не загружается, попробуйте другой из списка.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Могу ли я смотреть новостные каналы {countryName} в прямом эфире на своем телефоне?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Да, плеер работает в любом браузере телефона без загрузки приложения. Просто откройте эту страницу, коснитесь новостного канала и используйте полноэкранный режим для наилучшего просмотра.
