seo.homeH1.en: Watch Free Live TV, Radio & Webcams From Anywhere in the World
seo.homeH1.translated: મફત લાઈવ ટીવી, રેડિયો અને amp; વિશ્વમાં ગમે ત્યાંથી વેબકૅમ્સ

seo.homeTagline.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન (અગાઉ ફ્રી ટૂલ ટીવી ગાર્ડન)

seo.homeIntroTemplate.en: FreeTV Garden is a free streaming platform: spin the globe or pick a country to stream live TV, listen to live radio, and watch live webcams — no account, no app, no cost. {learnMoreLink} or see how we {alternativesLink}.
seo.homeIntroTemplate.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન એ એક મફત સ્ટ્રીમિંગ પ્લેટફોર્મ છે: લાઈવ ટીવી સ્ટ્રીમ કરવા, લાઈવ રેડિયો સાંભળવા અને લાઈવ વેબકૅમ્સ જોવા માટે ગ્લોબ સ્પિન કરો અથવા કોઈ દેશ પસંદ કરો — કોઈ એકાઉન્ટ, કોઈ એપ, કોઈ ખર્ચ નહીં. {learnMoreLink} અથવા જુઓ કે અમે કેવી રીતે {alternativesLink} .

seo.standaloneRadioDescription.en: Listen to {channelName} live online for free on FreeTV Garden, streamed instantly in your browser with no signup, app, or subscription required.
seo.standaloneRadioDescription.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પર {channelName} ને નિઃશુલ્ક ઑનલાઇન લાઇવ સાંભળો, કોઈ સાઇનઅપ, એપ્લિકેશન અથવા સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શનની આવશ્યકતા વિના તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં તરત જ સ્ટ્રીમ કરો.

seo.standaloneWebcamDescription.en: Watch {channelName} live webcam online for free on FreeTV Garden, streamed instantly in your browser with no signup, app, or subscription required.
seo.standaloneWebcamDescription.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પર {channelName} લાઇવ વેબકૅમ ઑનલાઇન મફતમાં જુઓ, તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં કોઈ સાઇનઅપ, એપ્લિકેશન અથવા સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શનની આવશ્યકતા વિના તરત જ સ્ટ્રીમ થાય છે.

seo.standaloneIntroRadio.en: {channelName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden{fromCountry} — no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required. Just open this page in your browser and press play.
seo.standaloneIntroRadio.translated: {channelName} ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન {fromCountry} પર મફતમાં સાંભળવા માટે ઉપલબ્ધ છે — કોઈ સાઇનઅપ નથી, કોઈ એપ્લિકેશન નથી, કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન નથી અને કોઈ ક્રેડિટ કાર્ડની જરૂર નથી. ફક્ત તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં આ પૃષ્ઠ ખોલો અને પ્લે દબાવો.

seo.standaloneIntroWebcam.en: {channelName} is available to watch for free on FreeTV Garden{fromCountry} — no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required. Just open this page in your browser and press play.
seo.standaloneIntroWebcam.translated: {channelName} ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન {fromCountry} પર મફતમાં જોવા માટે ઉપલબ્ધ છે — કોઈ સાઇનઅપ નથી, કોઈ એપ્લિકેશન નથી, કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન નથી અને કોઈ ક્રેડિટ કાર્ડની જરૂર નથી. ફક્ત તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં આ પૃષ્ઠ ખોલો અને પ્લે દબાવો.

seo.faqFreeQuestionRadio.en: Is listening to {channelName} on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.faqFreeQuestionRadio.translated: શું FreeTV ગાર્ડન પર {channelName} સાંભળવું મફત છે?

seo.faqFreeQuestionWebcam.en: Is watching {channelName} on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.faqFreeQuestionWebcam.translated: શું FreeTV ગાર્ડન પર {channelName} જોવાનું મફત છે?

seo.faqFreeAnswer.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available streams. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.faqFreeAnswer.translated: હા. ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન સાર્વજનિક રૂપે ઉપલબ્ધ સ્ટ્રીમ્સને એકીકૃત કરે છે. ત્યાં કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન, એકાઉન્ટ અથવા એપ્લિકેશનની જરૂર નથી.

seo.faqOfficialQuestionRadio.en: Is this the official station for {channelName}?
seo.faqOfficialQuestionRadio.translated: શું આ {channelName} માટે અધિકૃત સ્ટેશન છે?

seo.faqOfficialQuestionWebcam.en: Is this the official webcam for {channelName}?
seo.faqOfficialQuestionWebcam.translated: શું આ {channelName} માટે સત્તાવાર વેબકેમ છે?

seo.faqOfficialAnswer.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by {channelName}.
seo.faqOfficialAnswer.translated: નં. ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન એ સાર્વજનિક રૂપે ઉપલબ્ધ સ્ટ્રીમ્સને લિંક કરતી સ્વતંત્ર ડિરેક્ટરી છે. તે {channelName} દ્વારા સંલગ્ન, સમર્થન અથવા સંચાલિત નથી.

seo.wantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse all {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.wantMoreTemplate.translated: વધુ જોઈએ છે? ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પર તમામ {link} બ્રાઉઝ કરો.

seo.hubDescription.en: {verb} thousands of free {nounLower} from 200+ countries on FreeTV Garden, streamed instantly in your browser — no signup, no subscription required.
seo.hubDescription.translated: FreeTV ગાર્ડન પર 200+ દેશોમાંથી {verb} હજારો મફત {nounLower}, તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં તરત જ સ્ટ્રીમ થાય છે — કોઈ સાઇનઅપ, કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન આવશ્યક નથી.

seo.hubIntroWithCount.en: FreeTV Garden's {sectionName} directory currently lists {count} live {nounLower} from around the world — playable instantly in your browser with no signup, no app, and no subscription.
seo.hubIntroWithCount.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનની {sectionName} ડાયરેક્ટરી હાલમાં વિશ્વભરમાંથી {count} લાઇવ {nounLower} સૂચિબદ્ધ કરે છે — તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં કોઇ સાઇનઅપ, કોઇ એપ અને કોઇ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન વિના તરત જ વગાડી શકાય છે.

seo.hubIntroNoCount.en: FreeTV Garden's {sectionName} directory pulls in live {nounLower} from around the world — playable instantly in your browser with no signup, no app, and no subscription.
seo.hubIntroNoCount.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનની {sectionName} ડિરેક્ટરી વિશ્વભરમાંથી લાઇવ {nounLower} ખેંચે છે — તમારા બ્રાઉઝરમાં કોઈ સાઇનઅપ વિના, કોઈ એપ્લિકેશન વિના અને કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન વિના તરત જ વગાડી શકાય છે.

seo.satStationTitle.en: Listen to {stationName} Live — Satellite Radio | FreeTV Garden
seo.satStationTitle.translated: {stationName} લાઇવ સાંભળો — સેટેલાઇટ રેડિયો | ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન

seo.satStationDescription.en: Listen to {stationName} live on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — completely free, with no signup or subscription required.
seo.satStationDescription.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનના ઇન્ટરેક્ટિવ સેટેલાઇટ રેડિયો ગ્લોબ પર {stationName} લાઇવ સાંભળો — સંપૂર્ણપણે મફત, કોઈ સાઇનઅપ અથવા સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શનની જરૂર નથી.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden
seo.satHubTitle.translated: સેટેલાઇટ રેડિયો - લાઈવ રેડિયો ગ્લોબ | ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: ઇન્ટરેક્ટિવ સેટેલાઇટ ગ્લોબ પર વિશ્વભરના હજારો લાઇવ રેડિયો સ્ટેશનોનું અન્વેષણ કરો. લાઈવ, મફત સાંભળવા માટે કોઈપણ સ્ટેશન પર ક્લિક કરો.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: {stationName} ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનના ઇન્ટરેક્ટિવ સેટેલાઇટ રેડિયો ગ્લોબ પર મફતમાં સાંભળવા માટે ઉપલબ્ધ છે — કોઈ સાઇનઅપ, કોઈ એપ્લિકેશન, કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શનની જરૂર નથી. ગ્લોબ સ્પિન કરો, સ્ટેશન શોધો અને પ્લે દબાવો.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: વધુ જોઈએ છે? ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પર સંપૂર્ણ {link} બ્રાઉઝ કરો.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: ઇન્ટરેક્ટિવ સેટેલાઇટ ગ્લોબ પર લાઇવ રેડિયોનું અન્વેષણ કરો

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: ફોટોરિયલિસ્ટિક 3D સેટેલાઇટ ગ્લોબ સ્પિન કરો અને વિશ્વભરના હજારો લાઇવ રેડિયો સ્ટેશનો શોધો, તેમના વાસ્તવિક પ્રસારણ સ્થાન દ્વારા રચાયેલ છે — મફત, કોઈ સાઇનઅપની જરૂર નથી.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: લાઈવ ટીવી ચેનલોને 25+ કેટેગરીમાં ગોઠવવામાં આવી છે — સમાચાર, રમતગમત, મૂવીઝ, સંગીત, બાળકો, દસ્તાવેજી અને વધુ — જેથી તમે દરેક વસ્તુમાં સ્ક્રોલ કરવાને બદલે તમે જે જોવા માંગો છો તેના દ્વારા બ્રાઉઝ કરી શકો.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: હજારો મફત લાઇવ રેડિયો સ્ટેશન, શૈલી દ્વારા આયોજિત - Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, અને વધુ. {link1} ને બ્રાઉઝ કરો અથવા વિશ્વની ઉપરના રેડિયો ટેબ પર સ્વિચ કરો.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: વિશ્વભરના શહેરો, સીમાચિહ્નો, દરિયાકિનારા અને પ્રકૃતિના સ્થળોથી લાઇવ કૅમેરા ફીડ્સ — મફત, કોઈ સાઇનઅપ નહીં. {link1} ને બ્રાઉઝ કરો અથવા વિશ્વની ઉપરના વેબકેમ ટેબ પર સ્વિચ કરો.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: દરેક ચેનલ ભાષા દ્વારા પણ ગોઠવવામાં આવે છે — કુલ 84+ — જેથી તમે જે ભાષામાં બોલો છો તેમાં જોવા માટે કંઈક શોધી શકો છો, માત્ર તમે જે દેશ બ્રાઉઝ કરી રહ્યાં છો તે જ નહીં.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન કવર કરેલા 200+ દેશોમાંથી દરેક પાસે ચેનલોનું પોતાનું સમર્પિત પૃષ્ઠ છે — નીચે તમારું પસંદ કરો અથવા સંપૂર્ણ સૂચિમાંથી ખંડ દ્વારા બ્રાઉઝ કરો.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પ્લે સ્ટોર અથવા એપ સ્ટોર પર નથી - તે તમારા બ્રાઉઝરથી સીધા જ, કોઈપણ ઉપકરણ પર, થોડા ટેપમાં ઇન્સ્ટોલ કરે છે.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: ક્રોમ ખોલો (અથવા અન્ય બ્રાઉઝર જે વેબ ઇન્સ્ટોલને સપોર્ટ કરે છે) અને freetvgarden.com પર જાઓ. સરનામાં બારમાં ઇન્સ્ટોલ આઇકન માટે જુઓ, અથવા બ્રાઉઝર મેનૂ ખોલો અને "હોમ સ્ક્રીન પર ઉમેરો" / "એપ ઇન્સ્ટોલ કરો" પસંદ કરો. ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પછી તમારી હોમ સ્ક્રીન પરથી સંપૂર્ણ સ્ક્રીન ખોલશે, જેમ કે કોઈ નેટીવ એપ, પ્લે સ્ટોરમાંથી કોઈ ડાઉનલોડની જરૂર નથી.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari માં freetvgarden.com ખોલો. શેર આયકન પર ટેપ કરો, પછી "હોમ સ્ક્રીન પર ઉમેરો." આ તમારા iPhone અથવા iPad પર એક એપ્લિકેશન આયકન ઉમેરે છે જે સાઇટને પૂર્ણ-સ્ક્રીન લૉન્ચ કરે છે — કોઈ એપ સ્ટોર સૂચિની જરૂર નથી, અને અપડેટ રાખવા માટે કંઈ નથી.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: તમારા ટીવીનું બિલ્ટ-ઇન બ્રાઉઝર ખોલો અને freetvgarden.com પર નેવિગેટ કરો. જો તમારા ટીવીમાં ઉપયોગ કરી શકાય તેવું બ્રાઉઝર નથી, તો તેના બદલે મોટી સ્ક્રીન પર જોવા માટે Chromecast અથવા AirPlay નો ઉપયોગ કરીને તમારા ફોન અથવા લેપટોપમાંથી પેજ કાસ્ટ કરો.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: સિલ્ક બ્રાઉઝર ખોલો (ફાયર ટીવી ઉપકરણો પર પહેલાથી ઇન્સ્ટોલ કરેલું, અથવા એમેઝોન એપસ્ટોરથી મફત) અને freetvgarden.com પર જાઓ. દેશ અથવા શ્રેણી પસંદ કરો અને જોવાનું શરૂ કરો — કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન અથવા વધારાની એપ્લિકેશનની જરૂર નથી.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: કોઈપણ આધુનિક ડેસ્કટોપ બ્રાઉઝર કામ કરે છે — ફક્ત freetvgarden.com ની મુલાકાત લો. ક્રોમ અથવા એજમાં, તેને ડેસ્કટોપ એપ્લિકેશન તરીકે ઉમેરવા માટે એડ્રેસ બારમાં ઇન્સ્ટોલ આઇકન દેખાય છે; અન્યથા તે નિયમિત બ્રાઉઝર ટેબ તરીકે બરાબર ચાલે છે.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: શું ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન ખરેખર મફત છે?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: હા. ત્યાં કોઈ સાઇનઅપ નથી, કોઈ સબ્સ્ક્રિપ્શન નથી, અને કોઈપણ સમયે કોઈ ચુકવણી નથી — ફક્ત એક દેશ અથવા ચેનલ પસંદ કરો અને જોવાનું શરૂ કરો.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: શું tv.garden એ FreeTV ગાર્ડન જેવું જ છે?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: નંબર. મૂળ tv.garden 2026 માં Famelack માટે રિબ્રાન્ડ કરવામાં આવ્યું હતું અને હવે તે TV Garden નામનો ઉપયોગ કરતું નથી. FreeTV ગાર્ડન એ એક અલગ, સ્વતંત્ર રીતે ચલાવવામાં આવતી સાઇટ છે — જે Famelack અથવા મૂળ tv.garden સાથે જોડાયેલી નથી.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: શું ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનમાં ટીવી ગાર્ડન જેવી જ સુવિધાઓ છે?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: હા, વત્તા વધુ. ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનમાં 84+ ભાષા ફિલ્ટર્સ, 25+ કન્ટેન્ટ કેટેગરીઝ, પિક્ચર-ઇન-પિક્ચર પ્લેબેક, તમે સ્ટાર કરી શકો છો અને ફરી જોઈ શકો છો, એક રેન્ડમ-ચેનલ બટન અને એક-ટૅપ સીધા Chrome અથવા Safari માંથી ઇન્સ્ટૉલ કરવા સાથે સમાન સ્પિન-ધ-ગ્લોબ, પિક-એ-કંટ્રી અનુભવ ધરાવે છે — કોઈ એપ સ્ટોરની જરૂર નથી.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: શું ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડનમાં રેડિયો અને વેબકૅમ્સ પણ છે?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: હા. ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન પાસે પોપ, જાઝ અને ટોક જેવી શૈલીઓમાં લાઇવ સ્ટેશનો સાથે રેડિયો ટેબ અને વિશ્વભરના લાઇવ કેમેરા ફીડ્સ સાથે વેબકેમ ટેબ પણ છે. વિશ્વની ઉપર ટેબ્સ સ્વિચ કરો.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન radio.garden થી કેવી રીતે અલગ છે?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન એ એક અલગ, સ્વતંત્ર રીતે સંચાલિત પ્રોજેક્ટ છે — જે radio.garden સાથે જોડાયેલ નથી. તે સરળ નેવિગેશન સાથે સરળ, વધુ સાહજિક ઈન્ટરફેસ પ્રદાન કરે છે અને તે જ ફ્રી, વન-ટેપ ટૂલમાં બનેલ લાઈવ ટીવી અને વેબકૅમ્સ સાથે રેડિયોથી આગળ જાય છે.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: ઓડૂ પર જૂના ફ્રીટૂલ ટીવી ગાર્ડન પૃષ્ઠનું શું થયું?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: તે અહીં ફરીથી લોંચ થયું. જે પેજ freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden પર રહેતું હતું તે જ પ્રોજેક્ટ છે, જે હવે તેના પોતાના નામ અને ડોમેન હેઠળ ચાલી રહ્યું છે: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: શું મારે એકાઉન્ટ બનાવવાની જરૂર છે?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: કોઈ ખાતાની જરૂર નથી. ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન જોવા માટે કોઈ ઈમેલ, પાસવર્ડ અથવા કોઈપણ વ્યક્તિગત વિગતો માટે પૂછતું નથી.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: શું તે મોબાઈલ પર કામ કરે છે?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: હા — ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન એન્ડ્રોઈડ અથવા આઈફોન પર કોઈપણ આધુનિક મોબાઈલ બ્રાઉઝરમાં ચાલે છે અને એક-ટેપ એક્સેસ માટે તમારી હોમ સ્ક્રીન પર ઉમેરી શકાય છે (ઉપર ઈન્સ્ટોલ વિભાગ જુઓ).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ચેનલો એ સાર્વજનિક પ્રસારણકર્તાઓ પાસેથી લાઇવ સ્ટ્રીમ્સ છે, તેથી કેટલીક બ્રોડકાસ્ટરની પોતાની સર્વર સમસ્યાઓને કારણે અસ્થાયી રૂપે ઑફલાઇન થઈ જાય છે. બીજી ચેનલ અજમાવો, અથવા પછીથી ફરી તપાસો — મોટા ભાગના થોડી મિનિટોથી કલાકોમાં પાછા આવે છે.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: શું સ્ટ્રીમ્સ જોવા માટે કાયદેસર છે?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન સાર્વજનિક રૂપે ઉપલબ્ધ લાઇવ સ્ટ્રીમ્સને એકીકૃત કરે છે — મુખ્યત્વે iptv-org સમુદાય નિર્દેશિકામાંથી — અને તે કોઈપણ વિડિયો ફાઇલોને હોસ્ટ અથવા સ્ટોર કરતું નથી. વધુ માટે નીચે કાનૂની અને સલામતી વિભાગ જુઓ.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: વધુ પ્રશ્નોના જવાબ સંપૂર્ણ {link1} પર આપવામાં આવ્યા છે.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન iptv-org સમુદાય નિર્દેશિકા સહિત મફત, સાર્વજનિક સ્ત્રોતોમાંથી સાર્વજનિક રૂપે ઉપલબ્ધ લાઇવ સ્ટ્રીમ્સને એકીકૃત કરે છે. તે કોઈપણ વિડિયો અથવા ઑડિઓ ફાઇલોને હોસ્ટ અથવા સ્ટોર કરતું નથી, અને તેનો ઉપયોગ કરવા માટે એકાઉન્ટની જરૂર નથી.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: પ્રશ્નો, પ્રતિસાદ અથવા સૂચન કરવા માટે કોઈ ચેનલ? ઈમેલ {link1} .

ui.titleLiveTVByLanguage.en: Live TV by Language - FreeTV Garden
ui.titleLiveTVByLanguage.translated: ભાષા દ્વારા લાઇવ ટીવી - ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન

ui.titleLiveRadioByLanguage.en: Live Radio by Language - FreeTV Garden
ui.titleLiveRadioByLanguage.translated: ભાષા દ્વારા લાઇવ રેડિયો - ફ્રીટીવી ગાર્ડન

ui.placeCountryUnderDot.en: Place a country under the red dot
ui.placeCountryUnderDot.translated: சிவப்பு புள்ளியின் கீழ் ஒரு நாட்டை வைக்கவும்

ui.noUpdatesYet.en: No updates yet — check back soon.
ui.noUpdatesYet.translated: இன்னும் புதுப்பிப்புகள் இல்லை - விரைவில் மீண்டும் பார்க்கவும்.

seo.homeTitle.en: FreeTV Garden - Free Live TV, Radio & Webcams
seo.homeTitle.translated: FreeTV கார்டன் - இலவச நேரடி தொலைக்காட்சி, வானொலி & ஆம்ப்; வெப்கேம்கள்

seo.homeDescription.en: Watch 1000+ free live TV channels, listen to live radio stations, and view live webcams from 200+ countries — no signup, no subscription required.
seo.homeDescription.translated: 1000+ இலவச நேரலை டிவி சேனல்களைப் பார்க்கவும், நேரலை வானொலி நிலையங்களைக் கேட்கவும் மற்றும் 200+ நாடுகளில் இருந்து லைவ் வெப்கேம்களைப் பார்க்கவும் - பதிவு இல்லை, சந்தா தேவையில்லை.

seo.channelDescription.en: {verb} {channelName} live from {countryName} on FreeTV Garden — completely free, streamed instantly in your browser with no signup or subscription required.
seo.channelDescription.translated: {verb} {channelName} ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனில் {countryName} இலிருந்து நேரலை — முற்றிலும் இலவசம், பதிவு அல்லது சந்தா தேவையில்லை.

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV கார்டன் வீடியோ ஸ்ட்ரீம்களை ஹோஸ்ட் செய்கிறதா அல்லது பதிவேற்றுகிறதா?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: இல்லை. FreeTV கார்டன் எந்த வீடியோ கோப்புகளையும் ஹோஸ்ட் செய்யவோ, பதிவேற்றவோ அல்லது சேமிக்கவோ இல்லை. இது பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் ஸ்ட்ரீம்களுடன் இணைக்கிறது, எனவே நீங்கள் ஒளிபரப்பு செய்பவரின் சொந்த சேவையகங்களிலிருந்து நேரடியாகப் பார்க்கலாம்.

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.en: Currently around {count} live channels from {countries} countries.

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: இந்தப் பக்கம் {siteLink} இன் ஒரு பகுதியாகும், 200+ நாடுகளில் இருந்து 1000+ சேனல்களை உள்ளடக்கிய எங்கள் இலவச நேரலை டிவி கருவி. இங்கே கருவி நேராக {countryName} க்கு திறக்கிறது, எனவே உங்கள் உலாவியில் உடனடியாகப் பார்க்கத் தொடங்கலாம் - பதிவு இல்லை, பயன்பாடு இல்லை, சந்தா இல்லை மற்றும் கிரெடிட் கார்டு தேவையில்லை.

As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: உங்கள் சாதனத்தில் {countryName} டிவி பார்ப்பது எப்படி

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} சேனல்களைப் பார்க்க ஆப்ஸ் அல்லது கணக்கு தேவையில்லை. இந்தப் பக்கம் எந்தச் சாதனத்திலும் உங்கள் உலாவியில் நேரடியாகச் செயல்படும் - சேனலைத் தட்டி, பிளேயை அழுத்தவும்.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைத் திறந்து, பார்க்கத் தொடங்க {countryName} சேனலைத் தட்டவும், பிறகு சிறந்த பார்வைக்கு முழுத்திரை பொத்தானைப் பயன்படுத்தவும். அடுத்த முறை விரைவான அணுகலுக்கு, ஆப்ஸ் போன்ற ஐகானை உருவாக்க, Chrome மெனுவைத் தட்டி, "முகப்புத் திரையில் சேர்" என்பதைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: சஃபாரியில் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைத் திறந்து, உடனடியாக ஸ்ட்ரீமிங்கைத் தொடங்க ஏதேனும் {countryName} சேனலைத் தட்டவும். ஆப் ஸ்டோரில் இருந்து பயன்பாட்டைப் பதிவிறக்காமல் ஒரே தட்டல் அணுகலுக்கு, பகிர் ஐகானைத் தட்டி, "முகப்புத் திரையில் சேர்" என்பதைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: எந்த நவீன உலாவியும் வேலை செய்கிறது - குரோம், சஃபாரி, பயர்பாக்ஸ் அல்லது எட்ஜ். {countryName} சேனலைத் திறந்து, ப்ளேயரில் உள்ள முழுத்திரை ஐகானைப் பயன்படுத்தி கவனச்சிதறல் இல்லாத, டிவி போன்ற பார்வை அனுபவத்தைப் பெறவும்.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: உங்கள் டிவியின் உள்ளமைக்கப்பட்ட உலாவியில் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைத் திறக்கவும் அல்லது பெரிய திரையில் {countryName} சேனல்களைப் பார்க்க Chromecast அல்லது AirPlay ஐப் பயன்படுத்தி உங்கள் ஃபோன் அல்லது லேப்டாப்பில் இருந்து அனுப்பவும்.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ஊடாடும் 3D பூகோளத்தை சுழற்ற {homeLink} க்குச் சென்று நாங்கள் ஆதரிக்கும் 200+ நாடுகளில் ஏதேனும் ஒன்றைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும் அல்லது {countriesLink} ஐ உலாவவும்.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனில் {countryName} டிவி பார்ப்பது இலவசமா?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ஆம். ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன் ஆன்லைனில் பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் ஃப்ரீ-டு-ஏர் (FTA) சேனல்களை ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது. பார்க்க சந்தா, கணக்கு அல்லது ஆப்ஸ் எதுவும் தேவையில்லை.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: தற்போது {count} நேரலை சேனல்கள், {categories} போன்ற வகைகளில் பரவி உள்ளன.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: பொது ஸ்ட்ரீம்கள் ஆன் மற்றும் ஆஃப்லைனில் இருக்கும்போது சேனல் எண்ணிக்கை அடிக்கடி மாறுகிறது — இப்போது நேரலையில் இருப்பதைக் காண மேலே உள்ள கருவியைத் திறக்கவும்.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: இந்த பட்டியல் பொது iptv-org கோப்பகத்திலிருந்து தானாகவே புதுப்பிக்கப்படும்.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: சில {countryName} சேனல்கள் ஏன் இடையகமாகின்றன அல்லது ஏற்றுவதில் தோல்வியடைகின்றன?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: நீங்கள் நேரடியாக ஒளிபரப்பாளரின் சொந்த சேவையகத்துடன் இணைக்கிறீர்கள், எனவே வேகமும் நம்பகத்தன்மையும் அவற்றின் உள்கட்டமைப்பைப் பொறுத்தது, எங்களுடையது அல்ல. ஒரு சேனல் ஏற்றப்படவில்லை என்றால், பட்டியலில் இருந்து மற்றொன்றை முயற்சிக்கவும்.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: எனது மொபைலில் {countryName} செய்தி சேனல்களை நேரலையில் பார்க்க முடியுமா?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ஆம் — ஆப்ஸ் பதிவிறக்கம் இல்லாத எந்த ஃபோன் உலாவியிலும் பிளேயர் வேலை செய்கிறது. இந்தப் பக்கத்தைத் திறந்து, செய்திச் சேனலைத் தட்டி, சிறந்த பார்வைக்கு முழுத்திரையைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: இது ஏதேனும் {countryName} ஒளிபரப்பாளரின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ இணையதளமா?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: இல்லை. FreeTV கார்டன் என்பது பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் ஸ்ட்ரீம்களுடன் இணைக்கும் ஒரு சுயாதீன கோப்பகம். இந்தப் பக்கத்தில் பட்டியலிடப்பட்டுள்ள எந்த ஒளிபரப்பாளருடனும் இது இணைக்கப்படவில்லை, அங்கீகரிக்கப்படவில்லை அல்லது இயக்கப்படவில்லை.

seo.standaloneIntroRadio.translated: {channelName} FreeTV Garden {fromCountry} இல் இலவசமாகக் கேட்கக் கிடைக்கிறது — பதிவு இல்லை, பயன்பாடு இல்லை, சந்தா இல்லை மற்றும் கிரெடிட் கார்டு தேவையில்லை. உங்கள் உலாவியில் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைத் திறந்து பிளேயை அழுத்தவும்.

seo.standaloneIntroWebcam.en: {channelName} is available to watch for free on FreeTV Garden{fromCountry} — no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required. Just open this page in your browser and press play.
seo.standaloneIntroWebcam.translated: {channelName} FreeTV Garden {fromCountry} இல் இலவசமாகப் பார்க்கக் கிடைக்கிறது — பதிவு இல்லை, பயன்பாடு இல்லை, சந்தா இல்லை மற்றும் கிரெடிட் கார்டு தேவையில்லை. உங்கள் உலாவியில் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைத் திறந்து பிளேயை அழுத்தவும்.

seo.faqFreeQuestionRadio.en: Is listening to {channelName} on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.faqFreeQuestionRadio.translated: FreeTV கார்டனில் {channelName}ஐக் கேட்பது இலவசமா?

seo.faqFreeQuestionWebcam.en: Is watching {channelName} on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.faqFreeQuestionWebcam.translated: FreeTV கார்டனில் {channelName} பார்ப்பது இலவசமா?

seo.faqFreeAnswer.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available streams. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.faqFreeAnswer.translated: ஆம். FreeTV கார்டன் பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் ஸ்ட்ரீம்களை ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது. சந்தா, கணக்கு அல்லது பயன்பாடு எதுவும் தேவையில்லை.

seo.faqOfficialQuestionRadio.en: Is this the official station for {channelName}?
seo.faqOfficialQuestionRadio.translated: இது {channelName}க்கான அதிகாரப்பூர்வ நிலையமா?

seo.faqOfficialQuestionWebcam.en: Is this the official webcam for {channelName}?
seo.faqOfficialQuestionWebcam.translated: இது {channelName}க்கான அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வெப்கேமா?

seo.faqOfficialAnswer.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by {channelName}.
seo.faqOfficialAnswer.translated: இல்லை. FreeTV கார்டன் என்பது பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் ஸ்ட்ரீம்களுடன் இணைக்கும் ஒரு சுயாதீன கோப்பகம். இது {channelName} உடன் இணைக்கப்படவில்லை, அங்கீகரிக்கப்படவில்லை அல்லது இயக்கப்படவில்லை.

seo.wantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse all {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.wantMoreTemplate.translated: இன்னும் வேண்டுமா? FreeTV கார்டனில் {link} அனைத்தையும் உலாவவும்.

seo.hubDescription.en: {verb} thousands of free {nounLower} from 200+ countries on FreeTV Garden, streamed instantly in your browser — no signup, no subscription required.
seo.hubDescription.translated: ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனில் 200+ நாடுகளில் இருந்து {verb} ஆயிரக்கணக்கான இலவச {nounLower}, உங்கள் உலாவியில் உடனடியாக ஸ்ட்ரீம் செய்யப்படுகிறது — பதிவு இல்லை, சந்தா தேவையில்லை.

seo.hubIntroWithCount.en: FreeTV Garden's {sectionName} directory currently lists {count} live {nounLower} from around the world — playable instantly in your browser with no signup, no app, and no subscription.
seo.hubIntroWithCount.translated: FreeTV கார்டனின் {sectionName} கோப்பகம் தற்போது உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து {count} நேரலை {nounLower} பட்டியலிடுகிறது — உங்கள் உலாவியில் பதிவுபெறுதல், பயன்பாடு மற்றும் சந்தா இல்லாமல் உடனடியாக இயக்கக்கூடியது.

seo.hubIntroNoCount.en: FreeTV Garden's {sectionName} directory pulls in live {nounLower} from around the world — playable instantly in your browser with no signup, no app, and no subscription.
seo.hubIntroNoCount.translated: FreeTV கார்டனின் {sectionName} கோப்பகம் உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து {nounLower} நேரலையில் இழுக்கிறது — பதிவு செய்யாமல், ஆப்ஸ் இல்லாமல், சந்தா இல்லாமல் உங்கள் உலாவியில் உடனடியாக இயக்க முடியும்.

seo.satStationTitle.en: Listen to {stationName} Live — Satellite Radio | FreeTV Garden
seo.satStationTitle.translated: {stationName} நேரலையில் கேளுங்கள் — சேட்டிலைட் ரேடியோ | ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன்

seo.satStationDescription.en: Listen to {stationName} live on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — completely free, with no signup or subscription required.
seo.satStationDescription.translated: {stationName} ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனின் இன்டராக்டிவ் சாட்டிலைட் ரேடியோ குளோப்பில் நேரலையில் கேளுங்கள் — முற்றிலும் இலவசம், பதிவு அல்லது சந்தா தேவையில்லை.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden
seo.satHubTitle.translated: சேட்டிலைட் ரேடியோ - லைவ் ரேடியோ குளோப் | ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன்

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: உலகெங்கிலும் உள்ள ஆயிரக்கணக்கான நேரடி வானொலி நிலையங்களை ஊடாடும் செயற்கைக்கோள் உலகில் ஆராயுங்கள். நேரலையில் இலவசமாகக் கேட்க எந்த நிலையத்தையும் கிளிக் செய்யவும்.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: {stationName} ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனின் ஊடாடும் செயற்கைக்கோள் ரேடியோ குளோப்பில் இலவசமாகக் கேட்கக் கிடைக்கிறது — பதிவு இல்லை, பயன்பாடு இல்லை, சந்தா தேவையில்லை. உலகத்தை சுழற்றி, நிலையத்தைக் கண்டுபிடித்து, பிளேயை அழுத்தவும்.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: இன்னும் வேண்டுமா? FreeTV கார்டனில் முழு {link} ஐ உலாவவும்.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: ஊடாடும் செயற்கைக்கோள் குளோப்பில் நேரடி வானொலியை ஆராயுங்கள்

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: ஃபோட்டோரியலிஸ்டிக் 3D செயற்கைக்கோள் உலகத்தை சுழற்றி, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து ஆயிரக்கணக்கான நேரடி வானொலி நிலையங்களைக் கண்டறியவும், அவற்றின் உண்மையான ஒளிபரப்பு இருப்பிடத்தின் மூலம் திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளது - இலவசம், பதிவுபெற தேவையில்லை.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: லைவ் டிவி சேனல்கள் 25+ வகைகளாக ஒழுங்கமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன — செய்திகள், விளையாட்டுகள், திரைப்படங்கள், இசை, குழந்தைகள், ஆவணப்படம் மற்றும் பல — எனவே எல்லாவற்றையும் ஸ்க்ரோல் செய்வதற்குப் பதிலாக நீங்கள் எதைப் பார்க்க விரும்புகிறீர்களோ அதை உலாவலாம்.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: ஆயிரக்கணக்கான இலவச நேரடி வானொலி நிலையங்கள், வகையின்படி ஒழுங்கமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன - பாப், ஜாஸ், பேச்சு, செய்திகள், பழையவை மற்றும் பல. {link1} ஐ உலாவவும் அல்லது உலகத்திற்கு மேலே உள்ள ரேடியோ தாவலுக்கு மாறவும்.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: உலகெங்கிலும் உள்ள நகரங்கள், அடையாளங்கள், கடற்கரைகள் மற்றும் இயற்கை இடங்களிலிருந்து நேரலை கேமரா ஊட்டங்கள் - இலவசம், பதிவு இல்லை. {link1} ஐ உலாவவும் அல்லது உலகத்திற்கு மேலே உள்ள வெப்கேம் தாவலுக்கு மாறவும்.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: ஒவ்வொரு சேனலும் மொழியின்படி ஒழுங்கமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது — மொத்தம் 84+ — எனவே நீங்கள் உலாவும் நாட்டில் மட்டுமின்றி நீங்கள் உண்மையில் பேசும் மொழியில் எதையாவது பார்க்கலாம்.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: 200+ நாடுகளில் உள்ள ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன் அட்டைகளில் ஒவ்வொன்றும் அதன் சொந்த பிரத்யேக சேனல்களின் பக்கத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளன - கீழே உங்களுடையதைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும் அல்லது முழு பட்டியலிலிருந்து கண்டம் வாரியாக உலாவவும்.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV கார்டன் Play Store அல்லது App Store இல் இல்லை - அது உங்கள் உலாவியில் இருந்து நேராக, எந்த சாதனத்திலும், ஒரு சில தட்டுகளில் நிறுவும்.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome (அல்லது இணைய நிறுவல்களை ஆதரிக்கும் மற்றொரு உலாவி) திறந்து freetvgarden.com க்குச் செல்லவும். முகவரிப் பட்டியில் நிறுவல் ஐகானைப் பார்க்கவும் அல்லது உலாவி மெனுவைத் திறந்து "முகப்புத் திரையில் சேர்" / "பயன்பாட்டை நிறுவு" என்பதைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும். ப்ளே ஸ்டோரிலிருந்து எந்தப் பதிவிறக்கமும் தேவையில்லாமல், சொந்த பயன்பாட்டைப் போலவே FreeTV கார்டன் உங்கள் முகப்புத் திரையில் இருந்து முழுத்திரையைத் திறக்கும்.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: சஃபாரியில் freetvgarden.comஐத் திறக்கவும். பகிர் ஐகானைத் தட்டவும், பின்னர் "முகப்புத் திரையில் சேர்" என்பதைத் தட்டவும். இது உங்கள் iPhone அல்லது iPad இல் ஆப்ஸ் ஐகானைச் சேர்க்கிறது, இது தளத்தை முழுத்திரையில் வெளியிடுகிறது - ஆப் ஸ்டோர் பட்டியல் தேவையில்லை, மேலும் புதுப்பிக்க எதுவும் இல்லை.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: உங்கள் டிவியின் உள்ளமைக்கப்பட்ட உலாவியைத் திறந்து freetvgarden.com க்கு செல்லவும். உங்கள் டிவியில் பயன்படுத்தக்கூடிய உலாவி இல்லையென்றால், பெரிய திரையில் பார்க்க Chromecast அல்லது AirPlay ஐப் பயன்படுத்தி உங்கள் ஃபோன் அல்லது லேப்டாப்பில் இருந்து பக்கத்தை அனுப்பவும்.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: சில்க் உலாவியைத் திறந்து (ஃபயர் டிவி சாதனங்களில் முன்பே நிறுவப்பட்டது அல்லது Amazon Appstore இலிருந்து இலவசம்) மற்றும் freetvgarden.com க்குச் செல்லவும். நாடு அல்லது வகையைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்து பார்க்கத் தொடங்குங்கள் - சந்தா அல்லது கூடுதல் பயன்பாடு தேவையில்லை.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: எந்த நவீன டெஸ்க்டாப் உலாவியும் வேலை செய்கிறது - freetvgarden.com ஐப் பார்வையிடவும். குரோம் அல்லது எட்ஜில், டெஸ்க்டாப் பயன்பாடாகச் சேர்க்க, முகவரிப் பட்டியில் நிறுவல் ஐகான் தோன்றும்; இல்லையெனில் அது வழக்கமான உலாவி தாவலாக நன்றாக இயங்கும்.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ஆம். பதிவு செய்யவோ, சந்தாவோ இல்லை, எந்த நேரத்திலும் பணம் செலுத்தவோ இல்லை - ஒரு நாடு அல்லது சேனலைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்து பார்க்கத் தொடங்குங்கள்.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden என்பது FreeTV கார்டன் ஒன்றா?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: இல்லை. அசல் tv.garden 2026 இல் Famelock என மறுபெயரிடப்பட்டது, இனி TV கார்டன் பெயரைப் பயன்படுத்தாது. ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன் ஒரு தனியான, சுதந்திரமாக இயங்கும் தளம் — Famelock அல்லது அசல் tv.garden உடன் இணைக்கப்படவில்லை.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனில் டிவி கார்டன் போன்ற அம்சங்கள் உள்ளதா?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: ஆம், மேலும் மேலும். 84+ மொழி வடிப்பான்கள், 25+ உள்ளடக்கப் பிரிவுகள், பிக்சர்-இன்-பிக்சர் பிளேபேக், உங்களுக்குப் பிடித்தவை மற்றும் மீண்டும் பார்க்கக்கூடியவை, ரேண்டம்-சேனல் பொத்தான் மற்றும் Chrome அல்லது Safari இலிருந்து நேராக ஒரு தட்டினால் நிறுவுதல் போன்றவற்றுடன், FreeTV Garden ஆனது அதே ஸ்பின்-தி-குளோப், பிக்-ஏ-கன்ட்ரி அனுபவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது - ஆப் ஸ்டோர் தேவையில்லை.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனில் ரேடியோ மற்றும் வெப் கேமராக்கள் உள்ளதா?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ஆம். ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டனில் பாப், ஜாஸ் மற்றும் டாக் போன்ற வகைகளில் லைவ் ஸ்டேஷன்களுடன் கூடிய ரேடியோ டேப் உள்ளது, மேலும் உலகம் முழுவதிலும் இருந்து லைவ் கேமரா ஃபீட்களுடன் கூடிய வெப்கேம் டேப் உள்ளது. பூகோளத்திற்கு மேல் தாவல்களை மாற்றவும்.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: ரேடியோ.கார்டனில் இருந்து FreeTV கார்டன் எப்படி வேறுபடுகிறது?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV கார்டன் என்பது ஒரு தனியான, சுயாதீனமாக இயங்கும் திட்டமாகும் — radio.garden உடன் இணைக்கப்படவில்லை. இது எளிதான வழிசெலுத்தலுடன் எளிமையான, மிகவும் உள்ளுணர்வு இடைமுகத்தை வழங்குகிறது, மேலும் ரேடியோவைத் தாண்டி லைவ் டிவி மற்றும் வெப்கேம்கள் ஒரே இலவச, ஒரு-தட்டல் கருவியில் கட்டமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo இல் உள்ள பழைய FreeTool TV கார்டன் பக்கத்திற்கு என்ன ஆனது?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: அது இங்கே மீண்டும் தொடங்கப்பட்டது. freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden இல் இருக்கும் பக்கம் அதே திட்டமாகும், இப்போது அதன் சொந்த பெயரிலும் டொமைனிலும் இயங்குகிறது: FreeTV கார்டன்.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: கணக்கு தேவையில்லை. FreeTV கார்டன் மின்னஞ்சல், கடவுச்சொல் அல்லது தனிப்பட்ட விவரங்களைப் பார்ப்பதற்குக் கேட்காது.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: ஆம் — ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன் ஆண்ட்ராய்டு அல்லது ஐபோனில் உள்ள எந்த நவீன மொபைல் உலாவியிலும் இயங்குகிறது, மேலும் ஒரு முறை அணுகலுக்கு உங்கள் முகப்புத் திரையில் சேர்க்கலாம் (மேலே உள்ள நிறுவல் பகுதியைப் பார்க்கவும்).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: சேனல்கள் பொது ஒளிபரப்பாளர்களிடமிருந்து பெறப்பட்ட நேரடி ஸ்ட்ரீம்கள், எனவே சில ஒளிபரப்பாளரின் சொந்த சேவையக சிக்கல்கள் காரணமாக தற்காலிகமாக ஆஃப்லைனில் செல்கின்றன. வேறொரு சேனலை முயற்சிக்கவும் அல்லது பிறகு பார்க்கவும் - பெரும்பாலானவை சில நிமிடங்கள் முதல் மணிநேரம் வரை திரும்பும்.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: ஃப்ரீடிவி கார்டன் பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் நேரடி ஸ்ட்ரீம்களை ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது - முதன்மையாக iptv-org சமூக கோப்பகத்திலிருந்து - மேலும் எந்த வீடியோ கோப்புகளையும் ஹோஸ்ட் செய்யாது அல்லது சேமிக்காது. மேலும் அறிய கீழே உள்ள சட்டம் & பாதுகாப்பு பகுதியைப் பார்க்கவும்.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: முழு {link1} இல் கூடுதல் கேள்விகளுக்கு பதிலளிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV கார்டன் iptv-org சமூக கோப்பகம் உட்பட இலவச, பொது ஆதாரங்களில் இருந்து பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் நேரடி ஸ்ட்ரீம்களை ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது. இது எந்த வீடியோ அல்லது ஆடியோ கோப்புகளையும் ஹோஸ்ட் செய்யாது அல்லது சேமிக்காது, மேலும் பயன்படுத்த கணக்கு தேவையில்லை.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: கேள்விகள், கருத்துகள் அல்லது ஒரு சேனல் பரிந்துரைக்க வேண்டுமா? மின்னஞ்சல் {link1} .

seo.countryDescriptionTV.en: Watch free {countryName} live TV channels online — news, sports and entertainment streamed in your browser. No signup, no subscription required.

seo.spokenLanguageDescription.en: Stream free live {langName} TV channels from around the world on FreeTV Garden, right in your browser — no signup, no app, no subscription required.

seo.wantCountryH2.en: Want channels from a specific country instead?
seo.wantCountryH2.translated: బదులుగా నిర్దిష్ట దేశం నుండి ఛానెల్‌లు కావాలా?

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్ వీడియో స్ట్రీమ్‌లను హోస్ట్ చేస్తుందా లేదా అప్‌లోడ్ చేస్తుందా?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: లేదు. FreeTV గార్డెన్ ఏ వీడియో ఫైల్‌లను హోస్ట్ చేయదు, అప్‌లోడ్ చేయదు లేదా నిల్వ చేయదు. ఇది పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న స్ట్రీమ్‌లకు లింక్ చేస్తుంది కాబట్టి మీరు వాటిని బ్రాడ్‌కాస్టర్ స్వంత సర్వర్‌ల నుండి నేరుగా చూడవచ్చు.

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: స్ట్రీమ్‌లు ఆన్‌లో ఉన్నప్పుడు మరియు ఆఫ్‌లైన్‌లో ఉన్నప్పుడు గణన మారుతుంది — ప్రస్తుతం ప్రత్యక్షంగా ఏమి జరుగుతుందో చూడటానికి ఎగువన ఉన్న సాధనాన్ని తెరవండి.

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.en: Currently around {count} live channels from {countries} countries.

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ఈ పేజీ {siteLink}లో భాగం, మా ఉచిత ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసార టీవీ సాధనం 200+ దేశాల నుండి 1000+ ఛానెల్‌లను కవర్ చేస్తుంది. ఇక్కడ సాధనం నేరుగా {countryName}కి తెరవబడుతుంది, కాబట్టి మీరు వెంటనే మీ బ్రౌజర్‌లో చూడటం ప్రారంభించవచ్చు - సైన్అప్ లేదు, యాప్ లేదు, సభ్యత్వం లేదు మరియు క్రెడిట్ కార్డ్ అవసరం లేదు.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: FreeTV Garden ప్రస్తుతం {names}తో సహా {count} ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసార {countryName} ఛానెల్‌లను జాబితా చేస్తుంది — పబ్లిక్ iptv-org ఛానెల్ డైరెక్టరీ నుండి ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసారం చేయబడుతుంది మరియు అదనపు సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ లేకుండా మీ బ్రౌజర్‌లో తక్షణమే ప్లే చేయబడుతుంది. ఏదైనా ఫ్రీ-టు-ఎయిర్ అగ్రిగేటర్ మాదిరిగానే, స్ట్రీమ్‌లు ఆన్‌లో మరియు ఆఫ్‌లైన్‌లో ఉన్నప్పుడు ఖచ్చితమైన ఛానెల్ జాబితా రోజురోజుకు మారవచ్చు.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: మీ పరికరంలో {countryName} టీవీని ఎలా చూడాలి

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ఛానెల్‌లను చూడటానికి యాప్ లేదా ఖాతా అవసరం లేదు. ఈ పేజీ ఏదైనా పరికరంలో నేరుగా మీ బ్రౌజర్‌లో పని చేస్తుంది - కేవలం ఛానెల్‌ని నొక్కి, ప్లే నొక్కండి.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chromeలో ఈ పేజీని తెరిచి, చూడటం ప్రారంభించడానికి {countryName} ఛానెల్‌ని నొక్కండి, ఆపై ఉత్తమ వీక్షణ కోసం పూర్తి స్క్రీన్ బటన్‌ను ఉపయోగించండి. తదుపరిసారి త్వరిత ప్రాప్యత కోసం, Chrome మెనుని నొక్కి, యాప్ లాంటి చిహ్నాన్ని సృష్టించడానికి "హోమ్ స్క్రీన్‌కి జోడించు"ని ఎంచుకోండి.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: సఫారిలో ఈ పేజీని తెరిచి, తక్షణమే స్ట్రీమింగ్ ప్రారంభించడానికి ఏదైనా {countryName} ఛానెల్‌ని నొక్కండి. యాప్ స్టోర్ నుండి యాప్‌ను డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేయకుండానే వన్-ట్యాప్ యాక్సెస్ కోసం షేర్ చిహ్నాన్ని నొక్కండి మరియు "హోమ్ స్క్రీన్‌కి జోడించు"ని ఎంచుకోండి.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ఏదైనా ఆధునిక బ్రౌజర్ పని చేస్తుంది - Chrome, Safari, Firefox లేదా Edge. {countryName} ఛానెల్‌ని తెరిచి, పరధ్యానం లేని, టీవీ లాంటి వీక్షణ అనుభవం కోసం ప్లేయర్‌లోని పూర్తి స్క్రీన్ చిహ్నాన్ని ఉపయోగించండి.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: మీ టీవీ అంతర్నిర్మిత బ్రౌజర్‌లో ఈ పేజీని తెరవండి లేదా పెద్ద స్క్రీన్‌పై {countryName} ఛానెల్‌లను చూడటానికి Chromecast లేదా AirPlayని ఉపయోగించి మీ ఫోన్ లేదా ల్యాప్‌టాప్ నుండి ప్రసారం చేయండి.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ఇంటరాక్టివ్ 3D గ్లోబ్‌ను తిప్పడానికి {homeLink}కి తిరిగి వెళ్లండి మరియు మేము మద్దతిచ్చే 200+ దేశాలలో దేనినైనా ఎంచుకోండి లేదా {countriesLink}ని బ్రౌజ్ చేయండి.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్‌లో {countryName} టీవీ చూడటం ఉచితం?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: అవును. FreeTV గార్డెన్ ఆన్‌లైన్‌లో పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉండే ఫ్రీ-టు-ఎయిర్ (FTA) ఛానెల్‌లను సమగ్రపరుస్తుంది. చూడటానికి చందా, ఖాతా లేదా యాప్ అవసరం లేదు.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: ప్రస్తుతం {count} ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసార ఛానెల్‌లు, {categories} వంటి వర్గాలను విస్తరించి ఉన్నాయి.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: పబ్లిక్ స్ట్రీమ్‌లు ఆన్‌లో మరియు ఆఫ్‌లైన్‌లో ఉన్నందున ఛానెల్ గణన తరచుగా మారుతుంది — ప్రస్తుతం ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసారంలో ఉన్న వాటిని చూడటానికి ఎగువన ఉన్న సాధనాన్ని తెరవండి.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ఈ జాబితా పబ్లిక్ iptv-org డైరెక్టరీ నుండి స్వయంచాలకంగా నవీకరించబడుతుంది.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: కొన్ని {countryName} ఛానెల్‌లు ఎందుకు బఫర్ అవుతాయి లేదా లోడ్ చేయడంలో విఫలమవుతాయి?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: మీరు నేరుగా బ్రాడ్‌కాస్టర్ స్వంత సర్వర్‌కి కనెక్ట్ చేస్తున్నారు, కాబట్టి వేగం మరియు విశ్వసనీయత మాది కాకుండా వారి మౌలిక సదుపాయాలపై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. ఒక ఛానెల్ లోడ్ కాకపోతే, జాబితా నుండి మరొకదాన్ని ప్రయత్నించండి.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: నేను నా ఫోన్‌లో {countryName} వార్తా ఛానెల్‌లను ప్రత్యక్షంగా చూడవచ్చా?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: అవును — యాప్ డౌన్‌లోడ్ లేకుండా ప్లేయర్ ఏదైనా ఫోన్ బ్రౌజర్‌లో పని చేస్తుంది. ఈ పేజీని తెరిచి, వార్తా ఛానెల్‌ని నొక్కండి మరియు ఉత్తమ వీక్షణ కోసం పూర్తి స్క్రీన్‌ని ఉపయోగించండి.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: నం. FreeTV గార్డెన్ అనేది పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న స్ట్రీమ్‌లకు లింక్ చేసే స్వతంత్ర డైరెక్టరీ. ఇది ఈ పేజీలో జాబితా చేయబడిన ఏ బ్రాడ్‌కాస్టర్‌తో అనుబంధించబడలేదు, ఆమోదించబడలేదు లేదా నిర్వహించబడదు.

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: ఇంటరాక్టివ్ శాటిలైట్ గ్లోబ్‌లో ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా ఉన్న వేలాది లైవ్ రేడియో స్టేషన్‌లను అన్వేషించండి. ఉచితంగా వినడానికి ఏదైనా స్టేషన్‌ని క్లిక్ చేయండి.

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: ఫోటోరియలిస్టిక్ 3D శాటిలైట్ గ్లోబ్‌ను స్పిన్ చేయండి మరియు ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా ఉన్న వేలాది లైవ్ రేడియో స్టేషన్‌లను కనుగొనండి, వాటి వాస్తవ ప్రసార స్థానం ద్వారా రూపొందించబడింది - ఉచితం, సైన్అప్ అవసరం లేదు.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసార టీవీ ఛానెల్‌లు 25+ కేటగిరీలుగా నిర్వహించబడ్డాయి — వార్తలు, క్రీడలు, చలనచిత్రాలు, సంగీతం, పిల్లలు, డాక్యుమెంటరీ మరియు మరిన్ని — కాబట్టి మీరు ప్రతిదానిని స్క్రోల్ చేయడానికి బదులుగా మీరు చూడాలనుకుంటున్న వాటిని బ్రౌజ్ చేయవచ్చు.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: వేలాది ఉచిత లైవ్ రేడియో స్టేషన్‌లు, కళా ప్రక్రియ ద్వారా నిర్వహించబడ్డాయి — పాప్, జాజ్, టాక్, వార్తలు, పాతవి మరియు మరిన్ని. {link1}ని బ్రౌజ్ చేయండి లేదా గ్లోబ్ పైన ఉన్న రేడియో ట్యాబ్‌కు మారండి.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా ఉన్న నగరాలు, ల్యాండ్‌మార్క్‌లు, బీచ్‌లు మరియు ప్రకృతి ప్రదేశాల నుండి ప్రత్యక్ష కెమెరా ఫీడ్‌లు — ఉచితం, సైన్అప్ లేదు. {link1}ని బ్రౌజ్ చేయండి లేదా గ్లోబ్ పైన ఉన్న వెబ్‌క్యామ్ ట్యాబ్‌కు మారండి.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: ప్రతి ఛానెల్ కూడా భాష ద్వారా నిర్వహించబడుతుంది — మొత్తంగా 84+ — కాబట్టి మీరు బ్రౌజ్ చేస్తున్న దేశంలోనే కాకుండా మీరు నిజంగా మాట్లాడే భాషలో చూడడానికి ఏదైనా కనుగొనవచ్చు.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: 200+ దేశాల FreeTV గార్డెన్ కవర్‌లలో ప్రతి దాని స్వంత ఛానెల్‌ల పేజీని కలిగి ఉంది — దిగువన ఉన్న మీదే ఎంచుకోండి లేదా పూర్తి జాబితా నుండి ఖండం వారీగా బ్రౌజ్ చేయండి.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్ Play Store లేదా App Storeలో లేదు — ఇది మీ బ్రౌజర్ నుండి నేరుగా, ఏ పరికరంలోనైనా, కొన్ని ట్యాప్‌లలో ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేస్తుంది.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chromeని తెరిచి (లేదా వెబ్ ఇన్‌స్టాల్‌లకు మద్దతు ఇచ్చే మరొక బ్రౌజర్) మరియు freetvgarden.comకి వెళ్లండి. అడ్రస్ బార్‌లో ఇన్‌స్టాల్ ఐకాన్ కోసం చూడండి లేదా బ్రౌజర్ మెనుని తెరిచి, "హోమ్ స్క్రీన్‌కి జోడించు" / "యాప్ ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేయి" ఎంచుకోండి. FreeTV గార్డెన్ ప్లే స్టోర్ నుండి డౌన్‌లోడ్ అవసరం లేకుండా స్థానిక యాప్ లాగానే మీ హోమ్ స్క్రీన్ నుండి పూర్తి స్క్రీన్‌ను తెరుస్తుంది.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safariలో freetvgarden.comని తెరవండి. భాగస్వామ్యం చిహ్నాన్ని నొక్కండి, ఆపై "హోమ్ స్క్రీన్‌కి జోడించు". ఇది మీ iPhone లేదా iPadకి సైట్‌ని పూర్తి స్క్రీన్‌లో ప్రారంభించే యాప్ చిహ్నాన్ని జోడిస్తుంది — యాప్ స్టోర్ జాబితా అవసరం లేదు మరియు అప్‌డేట్ చేయడానికి ఏమీ లేదు.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: మీ టీవీ అంతర్నిర్మిత బ్రౌజర్‌ని తెరిచి freetvgarden.comకి నావిగేట్ చేయండి. మీ టీవీకి ఉపయోగించదగిన బ్రౌజర్ లేకపోతే, బదులుగా పెద్ద స్క్రీన్‌పై చూడటానికి Chromecast లేదా AirPlayని ఉపయోగించి మీ ఫోన్ లేదా ల్యాప్‌టాప్ నుండి పేజీని ప్రసారం చేయండి.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: సిల్క్ బ్రౌజర్‌ను తెరిచి (ఫైర్ టీవీ పరికరాలలో ముందే ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేయబడింది లేదా Amazon Appstore నుండి ఉచితం) మరియు freetvgarden.comకి వెళ్లండి. దేశం లేదా వర్గాన్ని ఎంచుకుని, చూడటం ప్రారంభించండి — సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ లేదా అదనపు యాప్ అవసరం లేదు.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: ఏదైనా ఆధునిక డెస్క్‌టాప్ బ్రౌజర్ పని చేస్తుంది — freetvgarden.comని సందర్శించండి. Chrome లేదా ఎడ్జ్‌లో, డెస్క్‌టాప్ యాప్‌గా జోడించడానికి అడ్రస్ బార్‌లో ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చిహ్నం కనిపిస్తుంది; లేకుంటే అది సాధారణ బ్రౌజర్ ట్యాబ్‌గా బాగా నడుస్తుంది.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: అవును. ఏ సమయంలోనూ సైన్అప్ లేదు, సభ్యత్వం లేదు మరియు చెల్లింపు ఉండదు — దేశం లేదా ఛానెల్‌ని ఎంచుకొని చూడటం ప్రారంభించండి.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden మరియు FreeTV గార్డెన్ ఒకటేనా?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: లేదు. అసలు tv.garden 2026లో Famelockకి రీబ్రాండ్ చేయబడింది మరియు ఇకపై TV గార్డెన్ పేరును ఉపయోగించదు. FreeTV గార్డెన్ అనేది ప్రత్యేకమైన, స్వతంత్రంగా నడిచే సైట్ — Famelock లేదా అసలు tv.gardenతో అనుబంధించబడలేదు.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: ఫ్రీటీవీ గార్డెన్‌లో టీవీ గార్డెన్‌లో ఉన్న ఫీచర్లు ఉన్నాయా?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: అవును, ఇంకా ఎక్కువ. FreeTV Garden 84+ భాషా ఫిల్టర్‌లు, 25+ కంటెంట్ కేటగిరీలు, పిక్చర్‌లో ప్లేబ్యాక్, మీరు స్టార్ చేయగల మరియు మళ్లీ సందర్శించగల ఇష్టమైనవి, యాదృచ్ఛిక-ఛానల్ బటన్ మరియు Chrome లేదా Safari నుండి నేరుగా ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేయడంతో పాటు స్పిన్-ది-గ్లోబ్, పిక్-ఎ-కంట్రీ అనుభవాన్ని కలిగి ఉంది — యాప్ స్టోర్ అవసరం లేదు.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్‌లో రేడియో మరియు వెబ్‌క్యామ్‌లు కూడా ఉన్నాయా?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: అవును. FreeTV గార్డెన్‌లో పాప్, జాజ్ మరియు టాక్ వంటి శైలులలో ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసార స్టేషన్‌లతో కూడిన రేడియో ట్యాబ్ మరియు ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా ఉన్న లైవ్ కెమెరా ఫీడ్‌లతో కూడిన వెబ్‌క్యామ్ ట్యాబ్ కూడా ఉన్నాయి. గ్లోబ్ పైన ట్యాబ్‌లను మార్చండి.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్ రేడియో.గార్డెన్ నుండి ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్ అనేది రేడియో.గార్డెన్‌తో అనుబంధించబడని ఒక ప్రత్యేక, స్వతంత్రంగా అమలు చేయబడిన ప్రాజెక్ట్. ఇది సులభమైన నావిగేషన్‌తో సరళమైన, మరింత స్పష్టమైన ఇంటర్‌ఫేస్‌ను అందిస్తుంది మరియు లైవ్ టీవీ మరియు వెబ్‌క్యామ్‌లతో అదే ఉచిత, వన్-ట్యాప్ సాధనంతో రేడియోను మించి ఉంటుంది.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odooలో పాత FreeTool TV గార్డెన్ పేజీకి ఏమైంది?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: ఇది ఇక్కడ పునఃప్రారంభించబడింది. freetool.odoo.com/tv-gardenలో నివసించే పేజీ అదే ప్రాజెక్ట్, ఇప్పుడు దాని స్వంత పేరు మరియు డొమైన్‌తో నడుస్తోంది: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: ఖాతా అవసరం లేదు. FreeTV గార్డెన్ చూడటానికి ఇమెయిల్, పాస్‌వర్డ్ లేదా ఏదైనా వ్యక్తిగత వివరాలను అడగదు.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: అవును — FreeTV గార్డెన్ Android లేదా iPhoneలో ఏదైనా ఆధునిక మొబైల్ బ్రౌజర్‌లో నడుస్తుంది మరియు వన్-ట్యాప్ యాక్సెస్ కోసం మీ హోమ్ స్క్రీన్‌కి జోడించబడుతుంది (పైన ఇన్‌స్టాల్ విభాగాన్ని చూడండి).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ఛానెల్‌లు పబ్లిక్ బ్రాడ్‌కాస్టర్‌ల నుండి పొందిన లైవ్ స్ట్రీమ్‌లు, కాబట్టి బ్రాడ్‌కాస్టర్ యొక్క స్వంత సర్వర్ సమస్యల కారణంగా కొన్ని తాత్కాలికంగా ఆఫ్‌లైన్‌కి వెళ్తాయి. మరొక ఛానెల్‌ని ప్రయత్నించండి లేదా తర్వాత తిరిగి తనిఖీ చేయండి — చాలా వరకు కొన్ని నిమిషాల నుండి గంటల వరకు తిరిగి వస్తాయి.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్ పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసారాలను - ప్రధానంగా iptv-org కమ్యూనిటీ డైరెక్టరీ నుండి - మరియు ఏ వీడియో ఫైల్‌లను హోస్ట్ చేయదు లేదా నిల్వ చేయదు. మరిన్ని వివరాల కోసం దిగువన ఉన్న చట్టపరమైన & భద్రత విభాగాన్ని చూడండి.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: పూర్తి {link1}లో మరిన్ని ప్రశ్నలకు సమాధానాలు ఇవ్వబడ్డాయి.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV గార్డెన్ iptv-org కమ్యూనిటీ డైరెక్టరీతో సహా ఉచిత, పబ్లిక్ సోర్స్‌ల నుండి పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉండే ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రసారాలను సమగ్రపరుస్తుంది. ఇది ఏ వీడియో లేదా ఆడియో ఫైల్‌లను హోస్ట్ చేయదు లేదా నిల్వ చేయదు మరియు ఉపయోగించడానికి ఖాతా అవసరం లేదు.

seo.wantCountryH2.en: Want channels from a specific country instead?
seo.wantCountryH2.translated: ಬದಲಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳು ಬೇಕೇ?

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ವೀಡಿಯೊ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆಯೇ?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: ಇಲ್ಲ. FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಯಾವುದೇ ವೀಡಿಯೊ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನೀವು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಸಾರಕರ ಸ್ವಂತ ಸರ್ವರ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದು.

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.faqCountNoneA.translated: ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಣಿಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ - ಇದೀಗ ಏನು ಲೈವ್ ಆಗಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಮೇಲಿನ ಉಪಕರಣವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ.

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.en: Currently around {count} live channels from {countries} countries.
seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.translated: ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ {countries} ದೇಶಗಳಿಂದ ಸುಮಾರು {count} ಲೈವ್ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳು.

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ಈ ಪುಟವು {siteLink} ನ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿದೆ, 200+ ದೇಶಗಳಿಂದ 1000+ ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುವ ನಮ್ಮ ಉಚಿತ ಲೈವ್ ಟಿವಿ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪಕರಣವು ನೇರವಾಗಿ {countryName} ಗೆ ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನೀವು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಬಹುದು - ಯಾವುದೇ ಸೈನ್ ಅಪ್, ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್, ಯಾವುದೇ ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: {countryName} ನ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಸಾರ ಟಿವಿ ಚಾನೆಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಚಾನೆಲ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಲೈವ್ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಮನರಂಜನೆ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗೀತದಂತಹ ವರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುವಂತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾಗಿದೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಗೇಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಚಾನಲ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು.

As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: FreeTV Garden ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ {count} ಲೈವ್ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, {names} ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ — ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಚಾನಲ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಲೈವ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಗೇಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಚಾನಲ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: FreeTV Garden ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ {names} ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ {count} ಲೈವ್ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ — ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ iptv-org ಚಾನೆಲ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಲೈವ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಪ್ಲೇ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಗೇಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳು ಆನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಫ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಚಾನಲ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ {countryName} ಟಿವಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತೆಯ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಪುಟವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ - ಕೇವಲ ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ಲೇ ಒತ್ತಿರಿ.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome ನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ, ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಂತರ ಉತ್ತಮ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಪರದೆ ಬಟನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಬಾರಿ ತ್ವರಿತ ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ, ಕ್ರೋಮ್ ಮೆನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್-ರೀತಿಯ ಐಕಾನ್ ರಚಿಸಲು "ಹೋಮ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್‌ಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸು" ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: ಸಫಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮಿಂಗ್ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಐಕಾನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಪ್ ಸ್ಟೋರ್‌ನಿಂದ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡದೆಯೇ ಒಂದು-ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ "ಹೋಮ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್‌ಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸು" ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ಯಾವುದೇ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ಅಥವಾ Edge. {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಾಕುಲತೆ-ಮುಕ್ತ, ಟಿವಿ ತರಹದ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಅನುಭವಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಪರದೆ ಐಕಾನ್ ಬಳಸಿ.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಟಿವಿಯ ಅಂತರ್ನಿರ್ಮಿತ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ ಅಥವಾ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪರದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು Chromecast ಅಥವಾ AirPlay ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಲ್ಯಾಪ್‌ಟಾಪ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬಿತ್ತರಿಸಿ.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ಸಂವಾದಾತ್ಮಕ 3D ಗ್ಲೋಬ್ ಅನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಲು {homeLink} ಗೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಾವು ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸುವ 200+ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದನ್ನಾದರೂ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ ಅಥವಾ {countriesLink} ಬ್ರೌಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ {countryName} ಟಿವಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಉಚಿತವೇ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ಹೌದು. FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಫ್ರೀ-ಟು-ಏರ್ (FTA) ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆ, ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ಕೆಲವು {countryName} ಚಾನಲ್‌ಗಳು ಏಕೆ ಬಫರ್ ಆಗುತ್ತವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗಲು ವಿಫಲವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: ನೀವು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಕಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಸರ್ವರ್‌ಗೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೀರಿ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆಯು ಅವರ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ನಮ್ಮದಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ಚಾನಲ್ ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ಹೌದು — ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡದೆಯೇ ಯಾವುದೇ ಫೋನ್ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ, ಸುದ್ದಿ ಚಾನಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಟ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಪರದೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ಇದು ಯಾವುದೇ {countryName} ಪ್ರಸಾರಕರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆಯೇ?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ಇಲ್ಲ. FreeTV ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಲಾದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಕಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇದು ಸಂಯೋಜಿತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ, ಅನುಮೋದಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿಲ್ಲ ಅಥವಾ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
