seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: අන්තර්ක්‍රියාකාරී චන්ද්‍රිකා ගෝලයක් මත ලොව පුරා සජීවී ගුවන් විදුලි මධ්‍යස්ථාන දහස් ගණනක් ගවේෂණය කරන්න. සජීවීව, නොමිලේ සවන් දීමට ඕනෑම ස්ථානයක් ක්ලික් කරන්න.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: {stationName} FreeTV Garden හි අන්තර්ක්‍රියාකාරී චන්ද්‍රිකා ගුවන්විදුලි ගෝලයේ නොමිලේ සවන් දීමට තිබේ - ලියාපදිංචි වීම, යෙදුමක්, දායකත්වයක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ. ලෝක ගෝලය කරකවන්න, දුම්රිය ස්ථානය සොයා, සහ Play ඔබන්න.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: තවත් අවශ්‍යද? FreeTV Garden හි සම්පූර්ණ {link} බ්‍රවුස් කරන්න.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: අන්තර්ක්‍රියාකාරී චන්ද්‍රිකා ගෝලයක් මත සජීවී ගුවන් විදුලිය ගවේෂණය කරන්න

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: ඡායාරූප යථාර්ථවාදී ත්‍රිමාණ චන්ද්‍රිකා ගෝලයක් කරකවන්න සහ ලොව පුරා සජීවී ගුවන්විදුලි මධ්‍යස්ථාන දහස් ගණනක් සොයා ගන්න, ඒවායේ සැබෑ විකාශන ස්ථානය අනුව සැලසුම් කර ඇත - නොමිලේ, ලියාපදිංචි වීම අවශ්‍ය නොවේ.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: සජීවී රූපවාහිනී නාලිකා ප්‍රවර්ග 25+කට සංවිධානය කර ඇත — පුවත්, ක්‍රීඩා, චිත්‍රපට, සංගීතය, ළමයින්, වාර්තා චිත්‍රපට, සහ තවත් — එබැවින් ඔබට සියල්ල හරහා අනුචලනය කරනවා වෙනුවට ඔබට නැරඹීමට අවශ්‍ය දේ අනුව බ්‍රවුස් කළ හැක.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: ප්‍රභේදය අනුව සංවිධානය කරන ලද නොමිලේ සජීවී ගුවන් විදුලි මධ්‍යස්ථාන දහස් ගණනක් - Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, සහ තවත්. {link1} බ්‍රවුස් කරන්න නැතහොත් ලෝක ගෝලයට ඉහළින් ඇති රේඩියෝ ටැබ් වෙත මාරු වන්න.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: ලොව පුරා නගර, බිම් සලකුණු, වෙරළ සහ ස්වභාවික ස්ථාන වලින් සජීවී කැමරා සංග්‍රහ - නොමිලේ, ලියාපදිංචි වීම නැත. {link1} බ්‍රවුස් කරන්න හෝ ලෝක ගෝලයට ඉහළින් ඇති වෙබ් කැමරාව ටැබයට මාරු වන්න.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: සෑම නාලිකාවක්ම භාෂාවෙන් ද සංවිධානය කර ඇත — සමස්තයක් ලෙස 84+ — එබැවින් ඔබට ඔබ බ්‍රවුස් කරන රට පමණක් නොව ඔබ සැබවින්ම කතා කරන භාෂාවෙන් නැරඹීමට යමක් සොයා ගත හැක.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: 200+ රටවල් 200+ කින් යුත් FreeTV උද්‍යාන කවරයකටම තමන්ගේම කැපවූ නාලිකා පිටුවක් ඇත - ඔබගේ පහතින් තෝරන්න, නැතහොත් සම්පූර්ණ ලැයිස්තුවෙන් මහාද්වීපය අනුව බ්‍රවුස් කරන්න.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden Play Store හෝ App Store මත නැත - එය ඔබගේ බ්‍රවුසරයෙන් කෙලින්ම, ඕනෑම උපාංගයක, තට්ටු කිහිපයකින් ස්ථාපනය කරයි.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: ක්‍රෝම් (හෝ වෙබ් ස්ථාපනය සඳහා සහය දක්වන වෙනත් බ්‍රවුසරයක්) විවෘත කර freetvgarden.com වෙත යන්න. ලිපින තීරුවේ ස්ථාපන නිරූපකය සොයන්න, නැතහොත් බ්‍රවුසර මෙනුව විවෘත කර "මුල් තිරයට එක් කරන්න" / "යෙදුම ස්ථාපනය කරන්න" තෝරන්න. FreeTV උද්‍යානය පසුව Play Store වෙතින් බාගැනීමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවන පරිදි, ස්වදේශීය යෙදුමක් මෙන් ඔබේ මුල් තිරයෙන් සම්පූර්ණ තිරය විවෘත කරනු ඇත.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari හි freetvgarden.com විවෘත කරන්න. බෙදාගැනීමේ නිරූපකය තට්ටු කරන්න, ඉන්පසු "මුල් තිරයට එක් කරන්න." මෙය ඔබගේ iPhone හෝ iPad වෙත යෙදුම් නිරූපකයක් එක් කරයි, එය වෙබ් අඩවිය සම්පූර්ණ තිරයෙන් දියත් කරයි — App Store ලැයිස්තුගත කිරීමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ, සහ යාවත්කාලීනව තබා ගැනීමට කිසිවක් නැත.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: ඔබගේ රූපවාහිනියේ ඇති බ්‍රවුසරය විවෘත කර freetvgarden.com වෙත සංචාලනය කරන්න. ඔබේ රූපවාහිනියට භාවිත කළ හැකි බ්‍රවුසරයක් නොමැති නම්, ඒ වෙනුවට විශාල තිරයේ නැරඹීමට Chromecast හෝ AirPlay භාවිතයෙන් ඔබේ දුරකථනයෙන් හෝ ලැප්ටොප් පරිගණකයෙන් පිටුව විකාශය කරන්න.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: සිල්ක් බ්‍රව්සරය විවෘත කරන්න (ෆයර් ටීවී උපාංගවල පෙර ස්ථාපනය කර ඇත, හෝ Amazon Appstore වෙතින් නොමිලේ) සහ freetvgarden.com වෙත යන්න. රටක් හෝ ප්‍රවර්ගයක් තෝරා නැරඹීම ආරම්භ කරන්න — දායකත්වයක් හෝ අමතර යෙදුමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: ඕනෑම නවීන ඩෙස්ක්ටොප් බ්‍රවුසරයක් ක්‍රියා කරයි - freetvgarden.com වෙත පිවිසෙන්න. Chrome හෝ Edge හි, එය ඩෙස්ක්ටොප් යෙදුමක් ලෙස එක් කිරීමට ලිපින තීරුවේ ස්ථාපන නිරූපකයක් දිස්වේ; එසේ නොමැතිනම් එය සාමාන්‍ය බ්‍රව්සර් ටැබ් එකක් ලෙස හොඳින් ක්‍රියාත්මක වේ.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ඔව්. ලියාපදිංචි වීමක් නැත, දායකත්වයක් නැත, සහ කිසිම අවස්ථාවක ගෙවීමක් නැත - රටක් හෝ නාලිකාවක් තෝරාගෙන නැරඹීම ආරම්භ කරන්න.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden යනු FreeTV උද්‍යානය හා සමානද?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: නැත. මුල් tv.garden 2026 දී Famelock ලෙස නැවත හංවඩු ගසා ඇති අතර තවදුරටත් TV Garden නම භාවිත නොකරයි. FreeTV උද්‍යානය යනු වෙනම, ස්වාධීනව ක්‍රියාත්මක වන අඩවියකි — Famelock හෝ මුල් tv.garden සමඟ අනුබද්ධ නොවේ.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden හි TV උද්‍යානයට සමාන විශේෂාංග තිබේද?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: ඔව්, ඊට අමතරව තවත්. FreeTV Garden සතුව 84+ භාෂා පෙරහන්, 25+ අන්තර්ගත ප්‍රවර්ග, පින්තූර තුළ නැවත ධාවනය, ඔබට තරු සහ නැවත නැරඹිය හැකි ප්‍රියතමයන්, සසම්භාවී-නාලිකා බොත්තමක්, සහ Chrome හෝ Safari වෙතින් කෙළින්ම ස්ථාපන එක්-තට්ටුවක් සමඟින්, ලොව පුරා පික්-ඒ-කන්ට්‍රි අත්දැකීමක් ඇත - යෙදුම් ගබඩාවක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV උද්‍යානයේ රේඩියෝ සහ වෙබ් කැමරා ද තිබේද?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ඔව්. FreeTV Garden සතුව Pop, Jazz, සහ Talk වැනි ප්‍රභේද හරහා සජීවී ස්ථාන සහිත Radio ටැබ් එකක් සහ ලොව පුරා සජීවී කැමරා සංග්‍රහ සහිත Webcam ටැබ් එකක් ද ඇත. ලෝක ගෝලයට ඉහලින් ටැබ් මාරු කරන්න.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV උද්‍යානය radio.garden වලට වඩා වෙනස් වන්නේ කෙසේද?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV උද්‍යානය වෙනම, ස්වාධීනව ක්‍රියාත්මක වන ව්‍යාපෘතියකි — radio.garden සමඟ අනුබද්ධ නොවේ. එය පහසු සංචාලනයක් සහිත සරල, වඩාත් අවබෝධාත්මක අතුරු මුහුණතක් ලබා දෙන අතර, එකම නොමිලේ, එක්-ටැප් මෙවලමක් තුළ ගොඩනගා ඇති සජීවී රූපවාහිනිය සහ වෙබ් කැමරා සමඟ රේඩියෝවෙන් ඔබ්බට යයි.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo හි පැරණි FreeTool TV Garden පිටුවට සිදු වූයේ කුමක්ද?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: එය මෙහි නැවත ආරම්භ විය. freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden හි ජීවත් වූ පිටුව එකම ව්‍යාපෘතියකි, දැන් එහි නම සහ වසම යටතේ ධාවනය වේ: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: ගිණුමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ. FreeTV උද්‍යානය නැරඹීමට විද්‍යුත් තැපෑලක්, මුරපදයක් හෝ පුද්ගලික තොරතුරු කිසිවක් ඉල්ලන්නේ නැත.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: ඔව් — FreeTV Garden Android හෝ iPhone හි ඕනෑම නවීන ජංගම බ්‍රව්සරයක ධාවනය වන අතර, එක්-තට්ටු ප්‍රවේශයක් සඳහා ඔබගේ මුල් තිරයට එක් කළ හැක (ඉහත ස්ථාපන කොටස බලන්න).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: නාලිකා යනු පොදු විකාශකයන්ගෙන් සජීවී ප්‍රවාහයන් වන අතර, සමහරක් විකාශකයාගේම සේවාදායක ගැටළු හේතුවෙන් තාවකාලිකව නොබැඳි වේ. වෙනත් නාලිකාවක් උත්සාහ කරන්න, නැතහොත් පසුව නැවත පරීක්ෂා කරන්න - බොහෝමයක් මිනිත්තු කිහිපයක් හෝ පැය කිහිපයක් ඇතුළත ආපසු පැමිණේ.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden ප්‍රසිද්ධියේ ලබා ගත හැකි සජීවී ප්‍රවාහයන් එකතු කරයි - මූලික වශයෙන් iptv-org ප්‍රජා නාමාවලියෙන් - සහ කිසිදු වීඩියෝ ගොනු සත්කාරක හෝ ගබඩා නොකරයි. වැඩි විස්තර සඳහා පහත නීති සහ ආරක්‍ෂාව කොටස බලන්න.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: සම්පූර්ණ {link1} හි තවත් ප්‍රශ්නවලට පිළිතුරු ලැබේ.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden iptv-org ප්‍රජා නාමාවලිය ඇතුළුව නොමිලේ, පොදු මූලාශ්‍රවලින් ප්‍රසිද්ධියේ ලබා ගත හැකි සජීවී ප්‍රවාහයන් එකතු කරයි. එය කිසිදු වීඩියෝ හෝ ශ්‍රව්‍ය ගොනු සත්කාරක හෝ ගබඩා නොකරන අතර භාවිත කිරීමට ගිණුමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: ප්‍රශ්න, ප්‍රතිපෝෂණ, හෝ යෝජනා කිරීමට නාලිකාවක් ද? විද්‍යුත් තැපෑල {link1} .

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: आफ्नो यन्त्रमा {countryName} TV कसरी हेर्ने

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} च्यानलहरू हेर्नको लागि कुनै एप वा खाता आवश्यक पर्दैन। यो पृष्ठले कुनै पनि यन्त्रमा तपाईंको ब्राउजरमा सीधै काम गर्छ - केवल च्यानल ट्याप गर्नुहोस् र प्ले थिच्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: यो पृष्ठलाई Chrome मा खोल्नुहोस्, हेर्न सुरु गर्नको लागि {countryName} च्यानल ट्याप गर्नुहोस्, त्यसपछि उत्कृष्ट दृश्यको लागि फुलस्क्रिन बटन प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। अर्को पटक द्रुत पहुँचको लागि, Chrome मेनुमा ट्याप गर्नुहोस् र एप जस्तो आइकन सिर्जना गर्न "गृह स्क्रिनमा थप्नुहोस्" छनौट गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: यो पृष्ठ सफारीमा खोल्नुहोस् र तुरुन्तै स्ट्रिमिङ सुरु गर्न कुनै पनि {countryName} च्यानलमा ट्याप गर्नुहोस्। सेयर आइकनमा ट्याप गर्नुहोस् र एप स्टोरबाट एप डाउनलोड नगरिकनै एक-ट्याप पहुँचको लागि "गृह स्क्रिनमा थप्नुहोस्" चयन गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: कुनै पनि आधुनिक ब्राउजरले काम गर्दछ - क्रोम, सफारी, फायरफक्स वा एज। एउटा {countryName} च्यानल खोल्नुहोस् र व्याकुलता-रहित, TV-जस्तो हेर्ने अनुभवको लागि प्लेयरमा फुलस्क्रिन आइकन प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: यो पृष्ठ आफ्नो टिभीको निर्मित ब्राउजरमा खोल्नुहोस्, वा ठूलो स्क्रिनमा {countryName} च्यानलहरू हेर्नको लागि Chromecast वा AirPlay प्रयोग गरेर यसलाई आफ्नो फोन वा ल्यापटपबाट कास्ट गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: अन्तरक्रियात्मक थ्रीडी ग्लोब घुमाउन {homeLink} मा फर्कनुहोस् र हामीले समर्थन गर्ने 200+ देशहरू मध्ये कुनै पनि छान्नुहोस्, वा {countriesLink} ब्राउज गर्नुहोस्।

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: सार्वजनिक स्ट्रिमहरू र अफलाइन हुँदा च्यानल गणना बारम्बार परिवर्तन हुन्छ — अहिले लाइभ के छ हेर्न माथिको उपकरण खोल्नुहोस्।

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV गार्डेन प्ले स्टोर वा एप स्टोरमा छैन — यो सिधै तपाईंको ब्राउजरबाट स्थापना हुन्छ, कुनै पनि यन्त्रमा, केही ट्यापहरूमा।

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome खोल्नुहोस् (वा वेब स्थापनाहरूलाई समर्थन गर्ने अर्को ब्राउजर) र freetvgarden.com मा जानुहोस्। ठेगाना पट्टीमा स्थापना आइकन खोज्नुहोस्, वा ब्राउजर मेनु खोल्नुहोस् र "गृह स्क्रिनमा थप्नुहोस्" / "अनुप्रयोग स्थापना गर्नुहोस्" छनौट गर्नुहोस्। FreeTV Garden त्यसपछि प्ले स्टोरबाट कुनै डाउनलोड आवश्यक पर्दैन, एक नेटिभ एप जस्तै, तपाईंको गृह स्क्रिनबाट पूर्ण-स्क्रिन खोल्नेछ।

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: सफारीमा freetvgarden.com खोल्नुहोस्। साझा आइकन ट्याप गर्नुहोस्, त्यसपछि "गृह स्क्रिनमा थप्नुहोस्।" यसले तपाइँको आईफोन वा आईप्याडमा एउटा एप आइकन थप्छ जसले साइटलाई पूर्ण-स्क्रिन सुरु गर्छ — कुनै एप स्टोर सूची आवश्यक पर्दैन, र अद्यावधिक राख्नको लागि केहि पनि छैन।

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: आफ्नो TV को बिल्ट-इन ब्राउजर खोल्नुहोस् र freetvgarden.com मा नेभिगेट गर्नुहोस्। यदि तपाईंको टिभीमा प्रयोगयोग्य ब्राउजर छैन भने, यसको सट्टा ठूलो स्क्रिनमा हेर्नको लागि Chromecast वा AirPlay प्रयोग गरेर आफ्नो फोन वा ल्यापटपबाट पृष्ठ कास्ट गर्नुहोस्।

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: सिल्क ब्राउजर खोल्नुहोस् (फायर टिभी उपकरणहरूमा पूर्व-स्थापित, वा अमेजन एपस्टोरबाट निःशुल्क) र freetvgarden.com मा जानुहोस्। एउटा देश वा कोटी चयन गर्नुहोस् र हेर्न सुरु गर्नुहोस् — कुनै सदस्यता वा अतिरिक्त एप आवश्यक छैन।

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: कुनै पनि आधुनिक डेस्कटप ब्राउजरले काम गर्दछ - केवल freetvgarden.com मा जानुहोस्। क्रोम वा एजमा, डेस्कटप एपको रूपमा थप्नको लागि ठेगाना पट्टीमा स्थापना आइकन देखिन्छ; अन्यथा यो नियमित ब्राउजर ट्याबको रूपमा राम्रो चल्छ।

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: के FreeTV गार्डन साँच्चै नि: शुल्क छ?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: हो। त्यहाँ कुनै साइनअप छैन, कुनै सदस्यता छैन, र कुनै पनि बिन्दुमा कुनै भुक्तानी छैन - केवल एउटा देश वा च्यानल छान्नुहोस् र हेर्न सुरु गर्नुहोस्।

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: के tv.garden FreeTV गार्डेन जस्तै हो?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: होइन। मूल tv.garden २०२६ मा Famelack मा पुन: ब्रान्ड गरियो र अब TV Garden नाम प्रयोग गर्दैन। FreeTV Garden एउटा छुट्टै, स्वतन्त्र रूपमा सञ्चालित साइट हो — Famelack वा मूल tv.garden सँग सम्बद्ध छैन।

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: के FreeTV गार्डेनमा टिभी गार्डेन जस्ता सुविधाहरू छन्?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: हो, थप थप। FreeTV Garden सँग समान स्पिन-द-ग्लोब, पिक-ए-कन्ट्री अनुभव छ, 84+ भाषा फिल्टरहरू, 25+ सामग्री कोटीहरू, चित्र-भित्र-चित्र प्लेब्याक, तपाईंले तारा र पुन: भ्रमण गर्न सक्ने मनपर्नेहरू, अनियमित च्यानल बटन, र एक-ट्याप सीधा Chrome वा Safari बाट स्थापना गर्नुहोस् — कुनै एप स्टोर आवश्यक पर्दैन।

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: के FreeTV गार्डनमा रेडियो र वेबक्यामहरू पनि छन्?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: हो। FreeTV गार्डेनसँग पप, ज्याज र टक जस्ता विधाहरूमा लाइभ स्टेसनहरू भएको रेडियो ट्याब र विश्वभरका लाइभ क्यामेरा फिडहरू सहितको वेबक्याम ट्याब पनि छ। विश्व माथि ट्याबहरू स्विच गर्नुहोस्।

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV गार्डेन radio.garden बाट कसरी फरक छ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden एउटा छुट्टै, स्वतन्त्र रूपमा सञ्चालित परियोजना हो — radio.garden सँग सम्बद्ध छैन। यसले सजिलो नेभिगेसनको साथ एक सरल, थप सहज इन्टरफेस प्रदान गर्दछ, र लाइभ टिभी र एउटै नि: शुल्क, एक-ट्याप उपकरणमा निर्मित वेबक्यामहरूसँग रेडियोभन्दा बाहिर जान्छ।

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo मा पुरानो FreeTool TV गार्डन पृष्ठ के भयो?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: यहाँ पुन: लन्च गरियो। freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden मा बस्ने पृष्ठ उही परियोजना हो, अहिले आफ्नै नाम र डोमेन अन्तर्गत चलिरहेको छ: FreeTV Garden।

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: कुनै खाता आवश्यक छैन। FreeTV Garden ले हेर्नको लागि इमेल, पासवर्ड, वा कुनै पनि व्यक्तिगत विवरणहरू सोध्दैन।

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: हो — FreeTV गार्डन एन्ड्रोइड वा आईफोनमा कुनै पनि आधुनिक मोबाइल ब्राउजरमा चल्छ, र एक-ट्याप पहुँचको लागि तपाईंको गृह स्क्रिनमा थप्न सकिन्छ (माथिको स्थापना खण्ड हेर्नुहोस्)।

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: च्यानलहरू सार्वजनिक प्रसारणकर्ताहरूबाट प्राप्त गरिएका लाइभ स्ट्रिमहरू हुन्, त्यसैले केही प्रसारणकर्ताको आफ्नै सर्भर समस्याहरूको कारणले अस्थायी रूपमा अफलाइन जान्छन्। अर्को च्यानल चलाएर हेर्नुहोस्, वा पछि फेरि जाँच गर्नुहोस् — धेरैजसो केही मिनेटदेखि घन्टा भित्र फिर्ता आउँछन्।

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: के स्ट्रिमहरू हेर्नको लागि कानूनी छन्?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden ले सार्वजनिक रूपमा उपलब्ध लाइभ स्ट्रिमहरू - मुख्य रूपमा iptv-org सामुदायिक डाइरेक्टरीबाट एकत्रित गर्दछ - र कुनै पनि भिडियो फाइलहरू होस्ट वा भण्डार गर्दैन। थपका लागि तलको कानुनी र सुरक्षा खण्ड हेर्नुहोस्।

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: थप प्रश्नहरूको जवाफ पूर्ण {link1} मा दिइन्छ।

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden ले iptv-org सामुदायिक डाइरेक्टरी सहित नि:शुल्क, सार्वजनिक स्रोतहरूबाट सार्वजनिक रूपमा उपलब्ध लाइभ स्ट्रिमहरू जम्मा गर्छ। यसले कुनै पनि भिडियो वा अडियो फाइलहरू होस्ट वा भण्डार गर्दैन, र प्रयोग गर्न खाताको आवश्यकता पर्दैन।

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: प्रश्न, प्रतिक्रिया, वा सुझाव दिन एक च्यानल? इमेल {link1}।

seo.satHubDescription.translated: এটা ইন্টাৰেক্টিভ চেটেলাইট গ্ল'বত বিশ্বৰ হাজাৰ হাজাৰ লাইভ ৰেডিঅ' ষ্টেচন অন্বেষণ কৰক। লাইভ, বিনামূলীয়াকৈ শুনিবলৈ যিকোনো ষ্টেচনত ক্লিক কৰক।

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: {stationName} FreeTV Garden ৰ ইন্টাৰেক্টিভ চেটেলাইট ৰেডিঅ' গ্ল'বত বিনামূলীয়াকৈ শুনিবলৈ উপলব্ধ — কোনো চাইনআপ, কোনো এপ, কোনো চাবস্ক্ৰিপচনৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই। গ্ল'বটো ঘূৰাই দিয়ক, ষ্টেচনটো বিচাৰি উলিয়াওক, আৰু play টিপক।

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: আৰু বিচাৰেনে? FreeTV Garden ত সম্পূৰ্ণ {link} ব্ৰাউজ কৰক।

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: এটা ইন্টাৰেক্টিভ চেটেলাইট গ্ল'বত লাইভ ৰেডিঅ' অন্বেষণ কৰক

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: এটা ফটোৰিয়েলিষ্টিক 3D উপগ্ৰহ গ্ল'ব ঘূৰাই দিয়ক আৰু বিশ্বৰ হাজাৰ হাজাৰ লাইভ ৰেডিঅ' ষ্টেচন আৱিষ্কাৰ কৰক, যিবোৰৰ প্ৰকৃত সম্প্ৰচাৰ স্থানৰ দ্বাৰা প্লট কৰা হৈছে — বিনামূলীয়া, কোনো চাইনআপৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই।

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: লাইভ টিভি চেনেলসমূহ ২৫+ শিতানত সংগঠিত কৰা হৈছে — বাতৰি, ক্ৰীড়া, চলচ্চিত্ৰ, সংগীত, শিশু, তথ্যচিত্ৰ, আৰু অধিক — যাতে আপুনি সকলো স্ক্ৰল কৰাৰ পৰিৱৰ্তে আপুনি কি চাব বিচাৰে তাৰ দ্বাৰা ব্ৰাউজ কৰিব পাৰে।

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: হাজাৰ হাজাৰ বিনামূলীয়া লাইভ ৰেডিঅ' ষ্টেচন, ধাৰা অনুসৰি সংগঠিত — পপ, জাজ, টক, নিউজ, অল্ডিজ, আৰু অধিক। {link1} ব্ৰাউজ কৰক বা গ্ল'বৰ ওপৰৰ ৰেডিঅ' টেবলৈ সলনি কৰক।

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: বিশ্বজুৰি চহৰ, লেণ্ডমাৰ্ক, বিচ, আৰু প্ৰকৃতিৰ স্থানৰ পৰা লাইভ কেমেৰা ফিড — বিনামূলীয়া, কোনো চাইনআপ নাই। {link1} ব্ৰাউজ কৰক বা গ্ল'বৰ ওপৰৰ ৱেবকেম টেবলৈ সলনি কৰক।

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: প্ৰতিটো চেনেল ভাষা অনুসৰিও সংগঠিত কৰা হৈছে — মুঠতে ৮৪+ — যাতে আপুনি কেৱল আপুনি ব্ৰাউজ কৰা দেশখনতে নহয়, আপুনি প্ৰকৃততে কোৱা ভাষাটোত চাবলৈ কিবা এটা বিচাৰি পাব পাৰে।

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: 200+ দেশ FreeTV Garden কভাৰৰ প্ৰতিখনেই চেনেলৰ নিজস্ব নিৰ্দিষ্ট পৃষ্ঠা আছে — তলত আপোনাৰটো বাছক, বা সম্পূৰ্ণ তালিকাৰ পৰা মহাদেশ অনুসৰি ব্ৰাউজ কৰক।

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden প্লে ষ্ট'ৰ বা এপ ষ্ট'ৰত নাই — ই আপোনাৰ ব্ৰাউজাৰৰ পৰা পোনপটীয়াকৈ ইনষ্টল হয় ইয়াৰ পৰিৱৰ্তে, যিকোনো ডিভাইচত, কেইটামান টেপত।

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome খোলক (বা ৱেব ইনষ্টল সমৰ্থন কৰা অন্য ব্ৰাউজাৰ) আৰু freetvgarden.com লৈ যাওক। ঠিকনা বাৰত ইনষ্টল আইকন বিচাৰক, বা ব্ৰাউজাৰ মেনু খোলক আৰু "হোম স্ক্ৰীণত যোগ কৰক" / "এপ ইনষ্টল কৰক" বাছক। তাৰ পিছত FreeTV Garden আপোনাৰ হোম স্ক্ৰীণৰ পৰা সম্পূৰ্ণ পৰ্দা খোল খাব, ঠিক এটা নেটিভ এপৰ দৰেই, প্লে ষ্ট’ৰৰ পৰা কোনো ডাউনলোডৰ প্ৰয়োজন নহ’ব।

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: ছাফাৰীত freetvgarden.com খোলক। অংশীদাৰী আইকন টেপ কৰক, তাৰ পিছত "হোম পৰ্দাত যোগ কৰক।" ই আপোনাৰ আইফোন বা আইপেডত এটা এপ আইকন যোগ কৰে যিয়ে চাইটটো সম্পূৰ্ণ পৰ্দাত আৰম্ভ কৰে — কোনো এপ ষ্ট'ৰ তালিকাৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই, আৰু আপডেট কৰি ৰাখিবলৈ একো নাই।

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: আপোনাৰ টিভিৰ বিল্ট-ইন ব্ৰাউজাৰ খোলক আৰু freetvgarden.com লৈ নেভিগেট কৰক। যদি আপোনাৰ টিভিত ব্যৱহাৰযোগ্য ব্ৰাউজাৰ নাই, তেন্তে ইয়াৰ পৰিৱৰ্তে ডাঙৰ পৰ্দাত চাবলৈ Chromecast বা AirPlay ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি আপোনাৰ ফোন বা লেপটপৰ পৰা পৃষ্ঠাটো কাষ্ট কৰক।

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Silk Browser খোলক (Fire TV ডিভাইচসমূহত পূৰ্ব-ইনষ্টল কৰা, বা Amazon Appstore ৰ পৰা বিনামূলীয়া) আৰু freetvgarden.com লৈ যাওক। এটা দেশ বা শ্ৰেণী নিৰ্বাচন কৰক আৰু চাবলৈ আৰম্ভ কৰক — কোনো চাবস্ক্ৰিপচন বা অতিৰিক্ত এপৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই।

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: যিকোনো আধুনিক ডেস্কটপ ব্ৰাউজাৰে কাম কৰে — মাত্ৰ freetvgarden.com চাওক। Chrome বা Edge ত, এটা ইনষ্টল আইকন ঠিকনা বাৰত দেখা দিয়ে ইয়াক এটা ডেস্কটপ এপ হিচাপে যোগ কৰিবলৈ; অন্যথা ই এটা নিয়মীয়া ব্ৰাউজাৰ টেব হিচাপে ভালদৰে চলি থাকে।

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: হয়। কোনো চাইনআপ নাই, কোনো চাবস্ক্ৰিপচন নাই, আৰু কোনো ধৰণৰ পেমেণ্ট নাই — মাত্ৰ এটা দেশ বা চেনেল বাছি লওক আৰু চাবলৈ আৰম্ভ কৰক।

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden আৰু FreeTV Garden একে নেকি?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: নহয়, মূল tv.garden য়ে ২০২৬ চনত Famelack লৈ পুনৰ ব্ৰেণ্ড কৰা হয় আৰু এতিয়া TV Garden নাম ব্যৱহাৰ নকৰে। FreeTV Garden এটা পৃথক, স্বতন্ত্ৰভাৱে পৰিচালিত চাইট — Famelack বা মূল tv.garden ৰ সৈতে জড়িত নহয়।

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ত TV Garden ৰ দৰে একে বৈশিষ্ট্য আছেনে?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: হয়, প্লাছ আৰু বেছি। FreeTV Garden ৰ একেটা স্পিন-দ্য-গ্লব, পিক-এ-কান্ট্ৰী অভিজ্ঞতা আছে, লগতে 84+ ভাষা ফিল্টাৰ, 25+ কন্টেন্ট কেটেগৰী, ছবি-ইন-পিকচাৰ প্লেবেক, আপুনি ষ্টাৰ আৰু পুনৰ চাব পৰা প্ৰিয়, এটা ৰেণ্ডম-চেনেল বুটাম, আৰু Chrome বা Safari ৰ পৰা পোনপটীয়াকৈ ৱান-টেপ ইনষ্টল — কোনো এপ ষ্ট'ৰৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই।

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: ফ্ৰীটিভি গাৰ্ডেনত ৰেডিঅ’ আৰু ৱেবকেমও আছেনে?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: হয়। ফ্ৰীটিভি গাৰ্ডেনত পপ, জাজ, আৰু টকৰ দৰে ধাৰাসমূহৰ লাইভ ষ্টেচনৰ সৈতে এটা ৰেডিঅ' টেব আৰু বিশ্বৰ বিভিন্ন প্ৰান্তৰ পৰা লাইভ কেমেৰা ফিডৰ সৈতে এটা ৱেবকেম টেবও আছে। গ্ল'বৰ ওপৰত টেব সলনি কৰক।

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Radio.garden ৰ পৰা FreeTV Garden কেনেকৈ পৃথক?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden এটা পৃথক, স্বতন্ত্ৰভাৱে পৰিচালিত প্ৰকল্প — radio.garden ৰ সৈতে জড়িত নহয়। ই সহজ নেভিগেচনৰ সৈতে এটা সহজ, অধিক স্বজ্ঞাত আন্তঃপৃষ্ঠ প্ৰদান কৰে, আৰু একেটা বিনামূলীয়া, এক-টেপ সঁজুলিত নিৰ্মিত লাইভ টিভি আৰু ৱেবকেমৰ সৈতে ৰেডিঅ'ৰ বাহিৰলৈ যায়।

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo ৰ পুৰণি FreeTool TV Garden পেজটোৰ কি হ’ল?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: ইয়াত পুনৰ আৰম্ভ হ’ল। আগতে freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden ত বাস কৰা পৃষ্ঠাটো একেটা প্ৰকল্প, এতিয়া নিজৰ নাম আৰু ডমেইনৰ অধীনত চলি আছে: FreeTV Garden।

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: মই এটা একাউণ্ট বনাব লাগিব নেকি?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: কোনো একাউণ্টৰ প্ৰয়োজন নাই। FreeTV Garden এ চাবলৈ ইমেইল, পাছৱৰ্ড, বা কোনো ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য বিচৰা নাই।

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: হয় — FreeTV Garden Android বা iPhone ত যিকোনো আধুনিক মোবাইল ব্ৰাউজাৰত চলি থাকে, আৰু এটা-টেপ অভিগমৰ বাবে আপোনাৰ হোম পৰ্দাত যোগ কৰিব পাৰি (ওপৰৰ ইনষ্টল অংশ চাওক)।

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden 不在 Play 商店或 App Store 上 - 它可以直接从您的浏览器安装，只需点击几下即可在任何设备上安装。

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: 打开 Chrome（或其他支持网络安装的浏览器）并访问 freetvgarden.com。 在地址栏中查找安装图标，或打开浏览器菜单并选择“添加到主屏幕”/“安装应用程序”。 然后，FreeTV Garden 将从主屏幕全屏打开，就像本机应用程序一样，无需从 Play 商店下载。

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: 在 Safari 中打开 freetvgarden.com。 点击“共享”图标，然后点击“添加到主屏幕”。 这会在您的 iPhone 或 iPad 上添加一个应用程序图标，用于全屏启动该网站 - 不需要 App Store 列表，也不需要保持更新。

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: 打开电视的内置浏览器并导航至 freetvgarden.com。 如果您的电视没有可用的浏览器，请使用 Chromecast 或 AirPlay 从手机或笔记本电脑投射页面，以便在大屏幕上观看。

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: 打开 Silk 浏览器（预装在 Fire TV 设备上，或从 Amazon Appstore 免费下载）并访问 freetvgarden.com。 选择一个国家或类别并开始观看 - 无需订阅或额外的应用程序。

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: 任何现代桌面浏览器都可以使用——只需访问 freetvgarden.com 即可。 在 Chrome 或 Edge 中，地址栏中会出现一个安装图标，可将其添加为桌面应用程序； 否则它可以像常规浏览器选项卡一样运行良好。

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: 免费电视花园真的免费吗？

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: 是的。 任何时候都无需注册、订阅和付款——只需选择一个国家或频道即可开始观看。

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden 和 FreeTV Garden 一样吗？

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: 不会。原来的 tv.garden 于 2026 年更名为 Famelack，并且不再使用 TV Garden 名称。 FreeTV Garden 是一个独立、独立运营的网站 — 不隶属于 Famelack 或原来的 tv.garden。

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden与TV Garden有相同的功能吗？

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: 是的，还有更多。 FreeTV Garden 具有相同的旋转地球仪、选择国家/地区的体验，以及超过 84 种语言过滤器、超过 25 种内容类别、画中画播放、可以加星标和重新访问的收藏夹、随机频道按钮以及直接从 Chrome 或 Safari 中一键安装 - 无需应用程序商店。

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden 也有收音机和网络摄像头吗？

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: 是的。 FreeTV Garden 还有一个“广播”选项卡，其中包含流行、爵士和谈话等流派的现场电台，以及一个“网络摄像头”选项卡，其中包含来自世界各地的实时摄像机源。 在地球上方切换选项卡。

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden 与 radio.garden 有何不同？

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden 是一个独立运行的项目，不隶属于 radio.garden。 它提供了更简单、更直观的界面和更轻松的导航，并且超越了广播，将直播电视和网络摄像头内置于同一个免费的一键式工具中。

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo 上的旧 FreeTool TV Garden 页面发生了什么？

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: 在这里又重新启动了。 以前位于 freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden 的页面是同一个项目，现在以自己的名称和域运行：FreeTV Garden。

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: 我需要创建一个帐户吗？

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: 无需帐户。 FreeTV Garden 不需要电子邮件、密码或任何个人详细信息即可观看。

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: 它可以在手机上使用吗？

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: 是的 — FreeTV Garden 可在 Android 或 iPhone 上的任何现代移动浏览器中运行，并且可以添加到主屏幕以进行一键访问（请参阅上面的安装部分）。

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: 为什么频道显示“不可用”？

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: 频道是来自公共广播公司的直播，因此由于广播公司自身的服务器问题，有些频道会暂时离线。 尝试其他频道，或稍后再回来查看——大多数会在几分钟到几小时内返回。

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: 这些直播是否合法观看？

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden 聚合了公开可用的直播流（主要来自 iptv-org 社区目录），并且本身不托管或存储任何视频文件。 有关更多信息，请参阅下面的法律与安全部分。

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: 更多问题可在完整的 {link1} 上得到解答。

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden 聚合了来自免费公共来源（包括 iptv-org 社区目录）的公开直播流。 它不托管或存储任何视频或音频文件，并且不需要帐户即可使用。

seo.faqHostQ.en: Does FreeTV Garden host or upload the video streams?
seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV Garden はビデオ ストリームをホストまたはアップロードしますか?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: いいえ、FreeTV Garden はビデオ ファイルをホスト、アップロード、または保存しません。 公開されているストリームにリンクしているので、放送局独自のサーバーから直接視聴できます。

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: このページは、200 か国以上の 1000 以上のチャンネルをカバーする無料のライブ TV ツール {siteLink} の一部です。 ここでは、ツールが {countryName} に直接開くため、サインアップ、アプリ、サブスクリプション、クレジット カードは必要なく、ブラウザーですぐに視聴を開始できます。

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: デバイスで {countryName} テレビを視聴する方法

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} チャンネルを視聴するのにアプリやアカウントは必要ありません。 このページは、どのデバイスのブラウザでも直接動作します。チャンネルをタップして再生を押すだけです。

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome でこのページを開き、{countryName} チャンネルをタップして視聴を開始し、最適な表示を得るには全画面ボタンを使用してください。 次回からすばやくアクセスするには、Chrome メニューをタップし、[ホーム画面に追加] を選択してアプリのようなアイコンを作成します。

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Safari でこのページを開き、任意の {countryName} チャンネルをタップすると、すぐにストリーミングを開始できます。 共有アイコンをタップし、「ホーム画面に追加」を選択すると、App Store からアプリをダウンロードすることなく、ワンタップでアクセスできます。

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Chrome、Safari、Firefox、Edge など、最新のブラウザであればどれでも動作します。 {countryName} チャンネルを開き、プレーヤーの全画面アイコンを使用すると、気を散らすことなくテレビのような視聴体験ができます。

seo.platformSmartTV.translated: スマートテレビとFire Stick:

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: このページをテレビの内蔵ブラウザで開くか、Chromecast または AirPlay を使用して携帯電話やラップトップからキャストして、大画面で {countryName} チャンネルを視聴してください。

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV Garden で {countryName} TV を視聴するのは無料ですか?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: はい。 FreeTV Garden は、オンラインで公開されている Free-to-Air (FTA) チャンネルを集約します。 視聴するためにサブスクリプション、アカウント、アプリは必要ありません。

seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: FreeTV Garden には {countryName} チャンネルがいくつありますか?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: 現在、 {count} ライブ チャンネルが中心で、 {categories} などのカテゴリにまたがっています。

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: チャンネル数は、パブリック ストリームがオンまたはオフラインになるにつれて頻繁に変化します。上のツールを開いて、現在のライブを確認してください。

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: このリストは、パブリック iptv-org ディレクトリから自動的に更新されます。

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: 一部の {countryName} チャネルがバッファリングされたり、ロードに失敗したりするのはなぜですか?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: 放送局自身のサーバーに直接接続しているため、速度と信頼性は私たちのインフラストラクチャではなく、放送局のインフラストラクチャに依存します。 1 つのチャンネルが読み込まれない場合は、リストから別のチャンネルを試してください。

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: はい - プレーヤーはアプリをダウンロードしなくても、どの携帯電話のブラウザでも動作します。 このページを開いてニュース チャンネルをタップし、全画面表示を使用すると最適な表示が得られます。

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: これは {countryName} 放送局の公式 Web サイトですか?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: いいえ、FreeTV Garden は、公開されているストリームにリンクする独立したディレクトリです。 このページにリストされている放送局と提携、承認、または運営されているわけではありません。

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden は Play ストアや App Store にはありません。代わりに、ブラウザから直接、任意のデバイスに数回タップするだけでインストールされます。

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome (または Web インストールをサポートする別のブラウザ) を開き、freetvgarden.com にアクセスします。 アドレスバーでインストールアイコンを探すか、ブラウザメニューを開いて「ホーム画面に追加」/「アプリをインストール」を選択します。 FreeTV Garden はネイティブ アプリと同じようにホーム画面から全画面で開き、Play ストアからダウンロードする必要はありません。

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari で freetvgarden.com を開きます。 「共有」アイコンをタップし、「ホーム画面に追加」をタップします。 これにより、iPhone または iPad にアプリ アイコンが追加され、サイトが全画面で起動します。App Store のリストは必要なく、更新し続ける必要もありません。

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: テレビの内蔵ブラウザを開き、freetvgarden.com に移動します。 テレビに使用可能なブラウザがない場合は、代わりに Chromecast または AirPlay を使用して携帯電話またはラップトップからページをキャストし、大画面で視聴します。

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Silk ブラウザ (Fire TV デバイスにプリインストールされているか、Amazon アプリストアから無料) を開き、freetvgarden.com にアクセスします。 国またはカテゴリを選択して視聴を開始してください。購読や追加のアプリは必要ありません。

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: 最新のデスクトップ ブラウザであればどれでも動作します。freetvgarden.com にアクセスするだけです。 Chrome または Edge では、デスクトップ アプリとして追加するためのインストール アイコンがアドレス バーに表示されます。 それ以外の場合は、通常のブラウザタブとして正常に動作します。

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Gardenは本当に無料ですか?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: はい。 サインアップやサブスクリプション、支払いは一切必要ありません。国またはチャンネルを選択するだけで視聴を開始できます。

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden は FreeTV Garden と同じですか?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: いいえ。元の tv.garden は 2026 年に Famelack にブランド変更され、TV Garden の名前は使用されなくなりました。 FreeTV Garden は独立して運営されている独立したサイトであり、Famelack やオリジナルの tv.garden とは提携していません。

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden には TV Garden と同じ機能がありますか?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: はい、さらに追加です。 FreeTV Garden には、84 を超える言語フィルター、25 を超えるコンテンツ カテゴリ、ピクチャ イン ピクチャの再生、スターを付けて再訪問できるお気に入り、ランダム チャンネル ボタン、Chrome または Safari から直接ワンタップでインストールできるほか、同じ地球儀を回転させ、国を選択するエクスペリエンスがあり、アプリ ストアは必要ありません。

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden にはラジオやウェブカメラもありますか?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: はい。 FreeTV Garden には、ポップ、ジャズ、トークなどのジャンルのライブ ステーションを含む [ラジオ] タブと、世界中からのライブ カメラ フィードを含む [ウェブカメラ] タブもあります。 地球の上のタブを切り替えます。

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden は radio.garden とどう違うのですか?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden は独立して運営される独立したプロジェクトであり、radio.garden とは提携していません。 これは、より簡単なナビゲーションを備えたよりシンプルで直感的なインターフェイスを提供し、同じ無料のワンタップ ツールに組み込まれたライブ TV や Web カメラにより、ラジオを超えています。

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo の古い FreeTool TV Garden ページはどうなりましたか?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: ここで再開されました。 以前は freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden にあったページは同じプロジェクトで、現在は独自の名前とドメイン、FreeTV Garden で実行されています。

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: アカウントを作成する必要がありますか?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: アカウントは必要ありません。 FreeTV Garden は、視聴するために電子メール、パスワード、その他の個人情報を要求しません。

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: モバイルでも機能しますか?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: はい — FreeTV Garden は Android または iPhone 上の最新のモバイル ブラウザで実行でき、ホーム画面に追加してワンタップでアクセスできます (上記の「インストール」セクションを参照)。

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: チャンネルに「利用不可」と表示されるのはなぜですか?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: チャンネルは公共放送局から配信されたライブ ストリームであるため、放送局自体のサーバーの問題により、一部のチャンネルは一時的にオフラインになります。 別のチャンネルを試すか、後でもう一度確認してください。ほとんどの場合、数分から数時間以内に戻ってきます。

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: ストリームの視聴は合法ですか?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden は、主に iptv-org コミュニティ ディレクトリから公開されているライブ ストリームを集約し、ビデオ ファイル自体をホストしたり保存したりしません。 詳細については、以下の「法的および安全性」セクションを参照してください。

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: その他の質問については、 {link1} 完全版をご覧ください。

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden は、iptv-org コミュニティ ディレクトリなどの無料の公開ソースから公開されているライブ ストリームを集約します。 ビデオやオーディオ ファイルをホストしたり保存したりすることはなく、使用するのにアカウントは必要ありません。

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: 質問、フィードバック、または提案するチャネルがありますか? {link1} に電子メールを送信してください。

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: 기기에서 {countryName} TV를 시청하는 방법

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} 채널을 시청하는 데는 앱이나 계정이 필요하지 않습니다. 이 페이지는 모든 기기의 브라우저에서 직접 작동합니다. 채널을 탭하고 재생을 누르기만 하면 됩니다.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Chrome에서 이 페이지를 열고 {countryName} 채널을 탭하여 시청을 시작한 다음 전체 화면 버튼을 사용하여 가장 잘 볼 수 있습니다. 다음에 빠르게 액세스하려면 Chrome 메뉴를 탭하고 '홈 화면에 추가'를 선택하여 앱과 같은 아이콘을 만드세요.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Safari에서 이 페이지를 열고 {countryName} 채널을 탭하면 즉시 스트리밍이 시작됩니다. 공유 아이콘을 누르고 "홈 화면에 추가"를 선택하면 App Store에서 앱을 다운로드하지 않고도 한 번의 탭으로 액세스할 수 있습니다.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge 등 모든 최신 브라우저가 작동합니다. {countryName} 채널을 열고 플레이어의 전체 화면 아이콘을 사용하면 TV와 같은 시청 환경을 방해받지 않고 즐길 수 있습니다.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: TV에 내장된 브라우저에서 이 페이지를 열거나 Chromecast 또는 AirPlay를 사용하여 휴대폰이나 노트북에서 전송하여 큰 화면에서 {countryName} 채널을 시청하세요.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: {homeLink}로 돌아가 대화형 3D 지구본을 돌려 우리가 지원하는 200개 이상의 국가 중 하나를 선택하거나 {countriesLink}을 탐색하세요.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: FreeTV Garden에서 {countryName} TV를 무료로 시청할 수 있나요?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: 예. FreeTV Garden은 온라인에서 공개적으로 이용 가능한 무료 방송(FTA) 채널을 모은 것입니다. 시청하는 데 구독, 계정 또는 앱이 필요하지 않습니다.

seo.hubIntroWithCount.en: FreeTV Garden's {sectionName} directory currently lists {count} live {nounLower} from around the world — playable instantly in your browser with no signup, no app, and no subscription.

seo.satStationTitle.en: Listen to {stationName} Live — Satellite Radio | FreeTV Garden

seo.satStationDescription.en: Listen to {stationName} live on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — completely free, with no signup or subscription required.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: 더 원하시나요? FreeTV Garden에서 전체 {link}을 찾아보세요.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: 대화형 위성 지구본에서 라이브 라디오 탐색

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: 사실적인 3D 위성 지구본을 돌려 실제 방송 위치를 기준으로 구성된 전 세계 수천 개의 라이브 라디오 방송국을 무료로 찾아보세요. 가입이 필요하지 않습니다.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: 라이브 TV 채널은 뉴스, 스포츠, 영화, 음악, 어린이, 다큐멘터리 등 25개 이상의 카테고리로 구성되어 있으므로 모든 항목을 스크롤하는 대신 시청하고 싶은 항목별로 찾아볼 수 있습니다.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: 팝, 재즈, 토크, 뉴스, 옛날 음악 등 장르별로 구성된 수천 개의 무료 라이브 라디오 방송국. {link1}을(를) 찾아보거나 지구본 위의 라디오 탭으로 전환하세요.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: 전 세계 도시, 랜드마크, 해변, 자연 명소의 라이브 카메라 피드를 무료로 받아보세요. 가입도 필요하지 않습니다. {link1}을(를) 찾아보거나 지구본 위의 웹캠 탭으로 전환하세요.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: 모든 채널은 총 84개 이상의 언어별로 구성되어 있으므로 탐색 중인 국가뿐만 아니라 실제로 사용하는 언어로 시청할 콘텐츠를 찾을 수 있습니다.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: 200개가 넘는 국가의 FreeTV Garden에는 각각 전용 채널 페이지가 있습니다. 아래에서 원하는 채널을 선택하거나 전체 목록에서 대륙별로 찾아보세요.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden은 Play Store나 App Store에 없습니다. 대신 몇 번의 탭만으로 브라우저에서 바로 설치됩니다.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome(또는 웹 설치를 지원하는 다른 브라우저)을 열고 freetvgarden.com으로 이동하세요. 주소 표시줄에서 설치 아이콘을 찾거나 브라우저 메뉴를 열고 "홈 화면에 추가" / "앱 설치"를 선택하세요. 그러면 FreeTV Garden이 기본 앱처럼 홈 화면에서 전체 화면으로 열리며 Play 스토어에서 다운로드할 필요가 없습니다.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari에서 freetvgarden.com을 엽니다. 공유 아이콘을 탭한 다음 '홈 화면에 추가'를 탭하세요. 이렇게 하면 사이트를 전체 화면으로 실행하는 앱 아이콘이 iPhone 또는 iPad에 추가됩니다. App Store 목록이 필요하지 않으며 계속 업데이트할 것도 없습니다.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: TV에 내장된 브라우저를 열고 freetvgarden.com으로 이동하세요. TV에 사용 가능한 브라우저가 없는 경우 Chromecast나 AirPlay를 사용하여 휴대폰이나 노트북에서 페이지를 전송하여 대신 큰 화면에서 시청하세요.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: 실크 브라우저(Fire TV 장치에 사전 설치되어 있거나 Amazon Appstore에서 무료)를 열고 freetvgarden.com으로 이동합니다. 국가나 카테고리를 선택하고 시청을 시작하세요. 구독이나 추가 앱이 필요하지 않습니다.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: 최신 데스크톱 브라우저는 모두 작동합니다. freetvgarden.com을 방문하세요. Chrome이나 Edge에서는 주소 표시줄에 설치 아이콘이 나타나 데스크톱 앱으로 추가할 수 있습니다. 그렇지 않으면 일반 브라우저 탭처럼 잘 실행됩니다.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: 예. 가입, 구독, 결제가 필요하지 않습니다. 국가나 채널을 선택하고 시청을 시작하세요.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden은 FreeTV Garden과 동일합니까?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: 아니요. 원래 tv.garden은 2026년에 Famelack으로 브랜드가 변경되었으며 더 이상 TV Garden 이름을 사용하지 않습니다. FreeTV Garden은 Famelack이나 원래 tv.garden과 제휴하지 않은 별도의 독립적으로 운영되는 사이트입니다.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden에는 TV Garden과 동일한 기능이 있나요?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: 예, 그 이상입니다. FreeTV Garden은 84개 이상의 언어 필터, 25개 이상의 콘텐츠 카테고리, PIP(Picture-in-Picture) 재생, 별표 표시하고 다시 방문할 수 있는 즐겨찾기, 무작위 채널 버튼, 앱 스토어 없이 Chrome 또는 Safari에서 바로 원탭 설치와 함께 동일한 지구 회전, 국가 선택 경험을 제공합니다.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden에는 라디오와 웹캠도 있나요?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: 예. FreeTV Garden에는 팝, 재즈, 토크와 같은 장르의 라이브 방송이 포함된 라디오 탭과 전 세계의 라이브 카메라 피드가 포함된 웹캠 탭도 있습니다. 지구본 위의 탭을 전환하세요.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden은 radio.garden과 어떻게 다릅니까?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden은 radio.garden과 제휴하지 않고 독립적으로 운영되는 별도의 프로젝트입니다. 탐색이 더 간편하고 더 간단하고 직관적인 인터페이스를 제공하며 동일한 무료 원탭 도구에 내장된 라이브 TV와 웹캠을 통해 라디오를 뛰어넘습니다.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo의 이전 FreeTool TV Garden 페이지는 어떻게 되었나요?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: 여기에서 다시 시작되었습니다. freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden에 있던 페이지는 동일한 프로젝트이며 이제는 자체 이름과 도메인인 FreeTV Garden으로 실행됩니다.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: 계정이 필요하지 않습니다. FreeTV Garden은 시청을 위해 이메일, 비밀번호 또는 개인 정보를 요구하지 않습니다.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: 예 — FreeTV Garden은 Android 또는 iPhone의 모든 최신 모바일 브라우저에서 실행되며 한 번의 탭으로 액세스할 수 있도록 홈 화면에 추가할 수 있습니다(위의 설치 섹션 참조).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: 채널에 '사용할 수 없음'이 표시되는 이유는 무엇인가요?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: 채널은 공영 방송사에서 제공하는 라이브 스트림이므로 방송사 자체 서버 문제로 인해 일부 채널이 일시적으로 오프라인 상태가 됩니다. 다른 채널을 시도하거나 나중에 다시 확인하세요. 대부분은 몇 분에서 몇 시간 내에 돌아옵니다.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden은 주로 iptv-org 커뮤니티 디렉터리에서 공개적으로 사용 가능한 라이브 스트림을 집계하며 비디오 파일 자체를 호스팅하거나 저장하지 않습니다. 자세한 내용은 아래 법률 및 안전 섹션을 참조하세요.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: 더 많은 질문에 대한 답변은 {link1} 전체에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden은 iptv-org 커뮤니티 디렉토리를 포함하여 무료 공개 소스에서 공개적으로 사용 가능한 라이브 스트림을 집계합니다. 비디오 또는 오디오 파일을 호스팅하거나 저장하지 않으며 사용하는 데 계정이 필요하지 않습니다.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: 200 гаруй улс орны FreeTV Garden бүрхэвч нь өөрийн гэсэн сувгуудын хуудастай байдаг - доороосоо сонгох эсвэл бүрэн жагсаалтаас тивээр нь үзэх боломжтой.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden нь Play Store эсвэл App Store-д байдаггүй. Энэ нь хэдхэн товшилтоор дурын төхөөрөмж дээр таны хөтчөөс шууд суулгадаг.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome (эсвэл вэб суулгацыг дэмждэг өөр хөтөч) нээгээд freetvgarden.com руу очно уу. Хаягийн талбараас суулгах дүрсийг хайж олох эсвэл хөтчийн цэсийг нээгээд "Үндсэн дэлгэц рүү нэмэх" / "Апп суулгах" гэснийг сонгоно уу. Дараа нь FreeTV Garden нь Play Store-оос татаж авах шаардлагагүй, үндсэн програм шиг таны үндсэн дэлгэцээс бүтэн дэлгэцээр нээгдэнэ.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari дээр freetvgarden.com нээнэ үү. Хуваалцах дүрс дээр товшоод "Үндсэн дэлгэц рүү нэмэх" гэснийг товшино уу. Энэ нь таны iPhone эсвэл iPad-д програмын дүрсийг нэмдэг бөгөөд энэ нь сайтыг бүтэн дэлгэцээр ажиллуулдаг бөгөөд энэ нь App Store-ын жагсаалт шаардлагагүй бөгөөд шинэчлэгдэх зүйл байхгүй.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: ТВ-ийнхээ суулгасан хөтчийг нээж, freetvgarden.com руу очно уу. Хэрэв таны зурагт ашиглах боломжтой хөтөч байхгүй бол Chromecast эсвэл AirPlay ашиглан гар утас эсвэл зөөврийн компьютерээсээ хуудсаа дамжуулж, оронд нь том дэлгэц дээр үзээрэй.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Silk Browser (Fire TV төхөөрөмж дээр урьдчилан суулгасан эсвэл Amazon Appstore-с үнэгүй) нээж, freetvgarden.com руу очно уу. Улс эсвэл ангиллыг сонгоод үзэж эхлээрэй - ямар ч захиалга эсвэл нэмэлт програм шаардлагагүй.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Ямар ч орчин үеийн ширээний хөтөч ажилладаг - freetvgarden.com сайтад зочилно уу. Chrome эсвэл Edge дээр суулгах дүрс хаягийн мөрөнд гарч ирэх бөгөөд үүнийг ширээний програм болгон нэмэх; Үгүй бол энэ нь ердийн хөтөчийн таб шиг сайн ажилладаг.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Garden үнэхээр үнэ төлбөргүй юу?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Тиймээ. Ямар ч үед бүртгүүлэх, захиалга өгөх, төлбөр төлөх шаардлагагүй - зүгээр л улс эсвэл сувгийг сонгоод үзэж эхлээрэй.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden нь FreeTV Garden-тай адилхан уу?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Үгүй. Анхны tv.garden нь 2026 онд Famelack болгон өөрчилсөн бөгөөд TV Garden нэрийг ашиглахаа больсон. FreeTV Garden нь тусдаа бие даасан сайт бөгөөд Famelack эсвэл анхны tv.garden-тай холбоогүй.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden нь ТВ цэцэрлэгтэй адил онцлогтой юу?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Тийм ээ, үүнээс гадна. FreeTV Garden нь 84+ хэлний шүүлтүүр, 25+ контентын ангилал, зураг доторх зургийг тоглуулах, од болон дахин үзэх дуртай зүйлс, санамсаргүй сувгийн товчлуур, Chrome эсвэл Safari-аас шууд нэг товшилтоор суулгах зэрэгтэй адил дэлхийн бөмбөрцгийг эргүүлэх, улс орныг сонгох боломжтой бөгөөд ямар ч апп дэлгүүр хэрэггүй.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden бас радио, вэбкамертай юу?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Тиймээ. FreeTV Garden нь мөн Поп, Жазз, Ярилцах зэрэг төрөл бүрийн шууд дамжуулалт бүхий Радио таб, мөн дэлхийн өнцөг булан бүрээс шууд камераар дамжуулдаг вэб камертай. Дэлхий дээрх табуудыг сэлгэх.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden radio.garden-аас юугаараа ялгаатай вэ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden бол radio.garden-тай холбоогүй, бие даасан, бие даасан төсөл юм. Энэ нь илүү хялбар навигаци бүхий илүү хялбар, ойлгомжтой интерфэйсийг санал болгодог бөгөөд нэг товшилтын үнэгүй хэрэгсэлд суурилагдсан шууд ТВ, вэбкамер бүхий радиогоос давж гардаг.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo дээрх хуучин FreeTool TV Garden хуудсанд юу тохиолдсон бэ?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Энд дахин эхлүүлсэн. Өмнө нь freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden хаягаар амьдардаг байсан хуудас нь яг ижил төсөл бөгөөд одоо өөрийн нэр болон домэйн дор ажиллаж байна: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Бүртгэл шаардлагагүй. FreeTV Garden нь үзэхийн тулд имэйл, нууц үг эсвэл хувийн мэдээлэл шаарддаггүй.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: Энэ нь гар утсан дээр ажилладаг уу?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Тийм — FreeTV Garden нь Андройд эсвэл iPhone дээрх орчин үеийн ямар ч гар утасны хөтөч дээр ажилладаг бөгөөд нэг товшилтоор хандахын тулд үндсэн дэлгэц дээрээ нэмж болно (дээрх Суулгах хэсгийг үзнэ үү).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Суваг яагаад "Боломжгүй" гэж харуулж байна вэ?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Сувгууд нь олон нийтийн өргөн нэвтрүүлгээс шууд дамжуулж байгаа тул зарим нь нэвтрүүлэгчийн өөрийн серверийн асуудлаас болж түр офлайн болдог. Өөр суваг үзээрэй, эсвэл дараа дахин шалгана уу - ихэнх нь хэдхэн минутаас хэдэн цагийн дотор буцаж ирдэг.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden нь үндсэндээ iptv-org нийгэмлэгийн лавлахаас олон нийтэд нээлттэй шууд дамжуулалтыг нэгтгэдэг бөгөөд ямар ч видео файлыг өөрөө байршуулж, хадгалдаггүй. Дэлгэрэнгүйг доорх хууль эрх зүй, аюулгүй байдлын хэсгээс үзнэ үү.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Илүү олон асуултад бүрэн {link1} хариултыг авах болно.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden нь iptv-org олон нийтийн лавлах зэрэг үнэгүй, олон нийтийн эх сурвалжаас олон нийтэд нээлттэй шууд дамжуулалтыг нэгтгэдэг. Энэ нь ямар ч видео болон аудио файлуудыг байршуулж, хадгалахгүй бөгөөд ашиглахад бүртгэл шаарддаггүй.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Асуулт, санал хүсэлт эсвэл санал болгох суваг байна уу? Имэйл {link1} .
