seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Setiap satu daripada 200+ negara yang dilindungi FreeTV Garden mempunyai halaman saluran khusus sendiri — pilih saluran anda di bawah, atau semak imbas mengikut benua daripada senarai penuh.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden tiada di Play Store atau App Store — ia dipasang terus daripada penyemak imbas anda sebaliknya, pada mana-mana peranti, dalam beberapa ketikan.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Buka Chrome (atau penyemak imbas lain yang menyokong pemasangan web) dan pergi ke freetvgarden.com. Cari ikon pasang dalam bar alamat atau buka menu penyemak imbas dan pilih "Tambah pada Skrin Utama" / "Pasang Apl." FreeTV Garden kemudiannya akan membuka skrin penuh dari skrin utama anda, sama seperti apl asli, tanpa muat turun dari Gedung Play diperlukan.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Buka freetvgarden.com dalam Safari. Ketik ikon Kongsi, kemudian "Tambah pada Skrin Utama." Ini menambahkan ikon apl pada iPhone atau iPad anda yang melancarkan tapak skrin penuh — tiada penyenaraian App Store diperlukan dan tiada apa yang perlu dikemas kini.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Buka penyemak imbas terbina dalam TV anda dan navigasi ke freetvgarden.com. Jika TV anda tidak mempunyai penyemak imbas yang boleh digunakan, hantar halaman daripada telefon atau komputer riba anda menggunakan Chromecast atau AirPlay untuk menonton pada skrin besar.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Buka Pelayar Sutera (dipasang pada peranti Fire TV, atau percuma dari Amazon Appstore) dan pergi ke freetvgarden.com. Pilih negara atau kategori dan mula menonton — tiada langganan atau apl tambahan diperlukan.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Sebarang penyemak imbas desktop moden berfungsi — hanya lawati freetvgarden.com. Dalam Chrome atau Edge, ikon pemasangan muncul dalam bar alamat untuk menambahkannya sebagai apl desktop; jika tidak, ia berfungsi dengan baik sebagai tab penyemak imbas biasa.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ya. Tiada pendaftaran, tiada langganan dan tiada pembayaran pada bila-bila masa — cuma pilih negara atau saluran dan mula menonton.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Adakah tv.garden sama dengan FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Tidak. tv.garden asal dijenamakan semula kepada Famelack pada 2026 dan tidak lagi menggunakan nama TV Garden. FreeTV Garden ialah tapak berasingan yang dikendalikan secara bebas — tidak bergabung dengan Famelack atau tv.garden asal.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Adakah FreeTV Garden mempunyai ciri yang sama seperti TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ya, tambah lagi. FreeTV Garden mempunyai pengalaman spin-the-globe, pilih negara yang sama, bersama-sama dengan 84+ penapis bahasa, 25+ kategori kandungan, main balik gambar dalam gambar, kegemaran yang boleh anda bintangkan dan lawati semula, butang saluran rawak dan pemasangan sekali ketik terus daripada Chrome atau Safari — tiada kedai aplikasi diperlukan.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Adakah FreeTV Garden juga mempunyai radio dan kamera web?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ya. FreeTV Garden juga mempunyai tab Radio dengan stesen langsung merentas genre seperti Pop, Jazz dan Talk serta tab Webcam dengan suapan kamera langsung dari seluruh dunia. Tukar tab di atas dunia.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Bagaimanakah FreeTV Garden berbeza daripada radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden ialah projek berasingan yang dikendalikan secara bebas — tidak bergabung dengan radio.garden. Ia menawarkan antara muka yang lebih mudah, lebih intuitif dengan navigasi yang lebih mudah, dan melangkaui radio dengan TV langsung dan kamera web yang terbina dalam alat percuma sekali ketik yang sama.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Apakah yang berlaku kepada halaman Taman TV FreeTool lama di Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Ia dilancarkan semula di sini. Halaman yang pernah hidup di freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden adalah projek yang sama, kini berjalan di bawah nama dan domainnya sendiri: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Tiada akaun diperlukan. FreeTV Garden tidak meminta e-mel, kata laluan atau sebarang butiran peribadi untuk ditonton.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: Adakah ia berfungsi pada mudah alih?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ya — FreeTV Garden berjalan dalam mana-mana penyemak imbas mudah alih moden pada Android atau iPhone, dan boleh ditambahkan pada skrin utama anda untuk akses sekali ketik (lihat bahagian Pasang di atas).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Saluran ialah strim langsung yang diperoleh daripada penyiar awam, jadi sesetengahnya pergi ke luar talian buat sementara waktu kerana masalah pelayan penyiar itu sendiri. Cuba saluran lain atau semak semula kemudian — kebanyakannya kembali dalam beberapa minit hingga beberapa jam.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Adakah aliran itu sah untuk ditonton?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden mengagregatkan strim langsung yang tersedia secara umum — terutamanya daripada direktori komuniti iptv-org — dan tidak mengehoskan atau menyimpan sebarang fail video itu sendiri. Lihat bahagian Undang-undang & Keselamatan di bawah untuk maklumat lanjut.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Lebih banyak soalan dijawab pada {link1} penuh.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden mengagregatkan strim langsung yang tersedia untuk umum daripada sumber awam percuma, termasuk direktori komuniti iptv-org. Ia tidak mengehoskan atau menyimpan sebarang fail video atau audio, dan tidak memerlukan akaun untuk digunakan.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Soalan, maklum balas atau saluran untuk dicadangkan? E-mel {link1} .

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Buksan ang page na ito sa Safari at i-tap ang anumang {countryName} na channel upang agad na magsimulang mag-stream. I-tap ang icon ng Ibahagi at piliin ang "Idagdag sa Home Screen" para sa isang pag-tap na access nang hindi nagda-download ng app mula sa App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Gumagana ang anumang modernong browser - Chrome, Safari, Firefox o Edge. Magbukas ng {countryName} channel at gamitin ang fullscreen na icon sa player para sa walang distraction, parang TV na karanasan sa panonood.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Buksan ang page na ito sa built-in na browser ng iyong TV, o i-cast ito mula sa iyong telepono o laptop gamit ang Chromecast o AirPlay upang manood ng {countryName} na mga channel sa malaking screen.

seo.countryAnotherH2.translated: Gusto ng mga channel mula sa ibang bansa?

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Libre ba ang panonood ng {countryName} TV sa FreeTV Garden?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Oo. Pinagsasama-sama ng FreeTV Garden ang mga Free-to-Air (FTA) na channel na available sa publiko online. Walang kinakailangang subscription, account o app para mapanood.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: Ilang {countryName} channel mayroon ang FreeTV Garden?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: Kasalukuyang humigit-kumulang {count} live na channel, na sumasaklaw sa mga kategorya tulad ng {categories} .

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: Ang bilang ng channel ay madalas na nagbabago habang ang mga pampublikong stream ay nagpapatuloy at offline — buksan ang tool sa itaas upang makita kung ano ang live ngayon.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: Awtomatikong nag-a-update ang listahang ito mula sa pampublikong direktoryo ng iptv-org.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Bakit ang ilang {countryName} channel ay buffer o hindi naglo-load?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Direkta kang kumokonekta sa sariling server ng broadcaster, kaya ang bilis at pagiging maaasahan ay nakasalalay sa kanilang imprastraktura, hindi sa amin. Kung hindi naglo-load ang isang channel, subukan ang isa pa mula sa listahan.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Maaari ba akong manood ng {countryName} na mga channel ng balita nang live sa aking telepono?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Oo — gumagana ang player sa anumang browser ng telepono na walang pag-download ng app. Buksan lang ang page na ito, i-tap ang isang channel ng balita, at gamitin ang fullscreen para sa pinakamagandang view.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Ito ba ang opisyal na website ng sinumang {countryName} broadcaster?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Hindi. Ang FreeTV Garden ay isang independiyenteng direktoryo na nagli-link sa mga stream na available sa publiko. Ito ay hindi kaakibat sa, ineendorso ng, o pinapatakbo ng alinmang broadcaster na nakalista sa pahinang ito.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: Galugarin ang libu-libong live na istasyon ng radyo mula sa buong mundo sa isang interactive na satellite globe. I-click ang anumang istasyon upang makinig nang live, libre.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: Ang {stationName} ay magagamit nang libre sa interactive satellite radio globe ng FreeTV Garden — walang pag-signup, walang app, walang kinakailangang subscription. Paikutin ang globo, hanapin ang istasyon, at pindutin ang play.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: Gusto mo pa? I-browse ang buong {link} sa FreeTV Garden.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Galugarin ang Live Radio sa isang Interactive Satellite Globe

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Paikutin ang isang photorealistic na 3D satellite globe at tuklasin ang libu-libong live na istasyon ng radyo mula sa buong mundo, na naka-plot ng kanilang tunay na lokasyon ng broadcast — libre, walang kinakailangang pag-signup.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Ang mga live na channel sa TV ay nakaayos sa 25+ na kategorya — Balita, Palakasan, Pelikula, Musika, Bata, Dokumentaryo, at higit pa — para makapag-browse ka ayon sa gusto mong panoorin sa halip na mag-scroll sa lahat.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Libu-libong libreng live na istasyon ng radyo, na inayos ayon sa genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, at higit pa. I-browse ang {link1} o lumipat sa tab na Radyo sa itaas ng globo.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Mga live na feed ng camera mula sa mga lungsod, landmark, beach, at nature spot sa buong mundo — libre, walang pag-signup. I-browse ang {link1} o lumipat sa tab na Webcam sa itaas ng globo.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Ang bawat channel ay nakaayos din ayon sa wika — 84+ sa kabuuan — para makakita ka ng mapapanood sa wikang aktwal mong sinasalita, hindi lang sa bansang iyong bina-browse.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Bawat isa sa 200+ na bansang sakop ng FreeTV Garden ay may sariling dedikadong page ng mga channel — piliin ang sa iyo sa ibaba, o mag-browse ayon sa kontinente mula sa buong listahan.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: Ang FreeTV Garden ay wala sa Play Store o App Store — nag-i-install ito nang direkta mula sa iyong browser sa halip, sa anumang device, sa ilang pag-tap.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Buksan ang Chrome (o isa pang browser na sumusuporta sa mga pag-install sa web) at pumunta sa freetvgarden.com. Hanapin ang icon ng pag-install sa address bar, o buksan ang menu ng browser at piliin ang "Idagdag sa Home Screen" / "I-install ang App." Ang FreeTV Garden ay magbubukas ng full-screen mula sa iyong home screen, tulad ng isang native na app, na walang kinakailangang pag-download mula sa Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Buksan ang freetvgarden.com sa Safari. I-tap ang icon ng Ibahagi, pagkatapos ay "Idagdag sa Home Screen." Nagdaragdag ito ng icon ng app sa iyong iPhone o iPad na naglulunsad ng site na full-screen — hindi kailangan ng listahan ng App Store, at walang dapat panatilihing na-update.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Buksan ang built-in na browser ng iyong TV at mag-navigate sa freetvgarden.com. Kung walang magagamit na browser ang iyong TV, i-cast ang page mula sa iyong telepono o laptop gamit ang Chromecast o AirPlay upang manood na lang sa malaking screen.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Buksan ang Silk Browser (pre-installed sa Fire TV device, o libre mula sa Amazon Appstore) at pumunta sa freetvgarden.com. Pumili ng bansa o kategorya at magsimulang manood — walang kinakailangang subscription o karagdagang app.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Gumagana ang anumang modernong desktop browser — bisitahin lamang ang freetvgarden.com. Sa Chrome o Edge, may lalabas na icon ng pag-install sa address bar upang idagdag ito bilang isang desktop app; kung hindi, ito ay tumatakbo nang maayos bilang isang regular na tab ng browser.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Oo. Walang pag-signup, walang subscription, at walang bayad sa anumang punto — pumili lang ng bansa o channel at magsimulang manood.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Pareho ba ang tv.garden sa FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Hindi. Nag-rebrand ang orihinal na tv.garden sa Famelack noong 2026 at hindi na ginagamit ang pangalan ng TV Garden. Ang FreeTV Garden ay isang hiwalay, independiyenteng pinapatakbo na site — hindi kaakibat sa Famelack o sa orihinal na tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ang FreeTV Garden ba ay may parehong mga tampok sa TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Oo, dagdag pa. Ang FreeTV Garden ay may parehong spin-the-globe, pick-a-country na karanasan, kasama ang 84+ na mga filter ng wika, 25+ na kategorya ng content, picture-in-picture na playback, mga paborito na maaari mong lagyan ng star at muling bisitahin, isang random-channel na button, at one-tap na pag-install diretso mula sa Chrome o Safari — hindi na kailangan ng app store.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Mayroon din bang radyo at webcam ang FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Oo. Ang FreeTV Garden ay mayroon ding Radio tab na may mga live na istasyon sa mga genre tulad ng Pop, Jazz, at Talk, at isang tab sa Webcam na may mga live na feed ng camera mula sa buong mundo. Lumipat ng mga tab sa itaas ng globo.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Paano naiiba ang FreeTV Garden sa radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: Ang FreeTV Garden ay isang hiwalay, malayang pinapatakbo na proyekto — hindi kaakibat sa radio.garden. Nag-aalok ito ng mas simple, mas madaling gamitin na interface na may mas madaling pag-navigate, at higit pa sa radyo na may live na TV at mga webcam na nakapaloob sa parehong libre, isang-tap na tool.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Ano ang nangyari sa lumang pahina ng FreeTool TV Garden sa Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Ito ay muling inilunsad dito. Ang page na dating nakatira sa freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden ay ang parehong proyekto, ngayon ay tumatakbo sa ilalim ng sarili nitong pangalan at domain: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Kailangan ko bang gumawa ng account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Walang account na kailangan. Ang FreeTV Garden ay hindi humihingi ng email, password, o anumang personal na detalye upang panoorin.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Oo — Gumagana ang FreeTV Garden sa anumang modernong mobile browser sa Android o iPhone, at maaaring idagdag sa iyong home screen para sa isang pag-tap na access (tingnan ang seksyong I-install sa itaas).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Bakit "Hindi available" ang ipinapakita ng isang channel?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Ang mga channel ay mga live stream na nagmula sa mga pampublikong tagapagbalita, kaya pansamantalang offline ang ilan dahil sa mga isyu sa server ng sariling broadcaster. Subukan ang isa pang channel, o bumalik sa ibang pagkakataon — karamihan ay babalik sa loob ng ilang minuto hanggang oras.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Legal bang panoorin ang mga stream?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: Pinagsasama-sama ng FreeTV Garden ang mga live stream na available sa publiko — pangunahin mula sa direktoryo ng komunidad ng iptv-org — at hindi nagho-host o nag-iimbak ng anumang mga video file mismo. Tingnan ang seksyong Legal at Kaligtasan sa ibaba para sa higit pa.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Mas maraming tanong ang sinasagot sa buong {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: Pinagsasama-sama ng FreeTV Garden ang mga live stream na available sa publiko mula sa libre, pampublikong mapagkukunan, kabilang ang direktoryo ng komunidad ng iptv-org. Hindi ito nagho-host o nag-iimbak ng anumang mga video o audio file, at hindi nangangailangan ng account na gagamitin.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Mga tanong, feedback, o channel na imumungkahi? Email {link1} .

seo.faqCountNoneA.en: The count changes as streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် လောလောဆယ်တွင် {count} {names} အပါအဝင် တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်သည့် {countryName} ချန်နယ်များကို စာရင်းပြုစုထားသည်။ — အများသူငှာ iptv-org ချန်နယ်လမ်းညွှန်မှ တိုက်ရိုက်ဆွဲထုတ်ပြီး အပိုဆော့ဖ်ဝဲမပါဘဲ သင့်ဘရောက်ဆာတွင် ချက်ချင်းဖွင့်နိုင်သည်။ အခမဲ့-to-air စုစည်းမှုကဲ့သို့ပင်၊ တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်မှုများနှင့် အော့ဖ်လိုင်းဖြစ်နေသဖြင့် ချန်နယ်စာရင်းအတိအကျသည် နေ့စဥ်ပြောင်းလဲနိုင်သည်။

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: သင့်စက်ပေါ်တွင် {countryName} TV ကို မည်သို့ကြည့်ရှုမည်နည်း။

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ချန်နယ်များကို ကြည့်ရှုရန် အက်ပ် သို့မဟုတ် အကောင့် မလိုအပ်ပါ။ ဤစာမျက်နှာသည် မည်သည့်စက်ပစ္စည်းတွင်မဆို သင့်ဘရောက်ဆာတွင် တိုက်ရိုက်အလုပ်လုပ်သည် - ချန်နယ်တစ်ခုကိုနှိပ်ပြီး play ကိုနှိပ်ရုံသာဖြစ်သည်။

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: ဤစာမျက်နှာကို Chrome တွင်ဖွင့်ပါ၊ ကြည့်ရှုရန် {countryName} ချန်နယ်တစ်ခုကို နှိပ်ပါ၊ ထို့နောက် အကောင်းဆုံးမြင်ကွင်းအတွက် မျက်နှာပြင်အပြည့်ခလုတ်ကို အသုံးပြုပါ။ နောက်တစ်ကြိမ် အမြန်ဝင်ရောက်နိုင်ရန် Chrome မီနူးကို နှိပ်ပြီး အက်ပ်နှင့်တူသော အိုင်ကွန်တစ်ခု ဖန်တီးရန် "ပင်မစခရင်သို့ ထည့်ရန်" ကို ရွေးချယ်ပါ။

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Safari တွင် ဤစာမျက်နှာကိုဖွင့်ပြီး ချက်ချင်းထုတ်လွှင့်ခြင်းစတင်ရန် မည်သည့် {countryName} ချန်နယ်ကိုမဆိုနှိပ်ပါ။ အက်ပ်စတိုးမှ အက်ပ်ကိုဒေါင်းလုဒ်မလုပ်ဘဲ တစ်ချက်ထိရုံဖြင့် ဝင်ရောက်အသုံးပြုနိုင်ရန် မျှဝေသင်္ကေတကို နှိပ်ပြီး "ပင်မစခရင်သို့ ထည့်ပါ" ကို ရွေးပါ။

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: မည်သည့်ခေတ်မီဘရောက်ဆာမဆို အလုပ်လုပ်သည် - Chrome၊ Safari၊ Firefox သို့မဟုတ် Edge။ {countryName} ချန်နယ်တစ်ခုကိုဖွင့်ပြီး အာရုံထွေပြားမှုမရှိဘဲ တီဗီကြည့်ရှုခြင်းအတွေ့အကြုံအတွက် ပလေယာရှိ မျက်နှာပြင်အပြည့်အိုင်ကွန်ကို အသုံးပြုပါ။

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: သင့် TV ၏ built-in ဘရောက်ဆာတွင် ဤစာမျက်နှာကိုဖွင့်ပါ၊ သို့မဟုတ် မျက်နှာပြင်ကြီးပေါ်တွင် {countryName} ချန်နယ်များကိုကြည့်ရှုရန် Chromecast သို့မဟုတ် AirPlay ကို အသုံးပြု၍ သင့်ဖုန်း သို့မဟုတ် လက်ပ်တော့မှ ၎င်းကို ကာစ်လုပ်ပါ။

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: အပြန်အလှန်အကျိုးသက်ရောက်သော 3D ကမ္ဘာလုံးကိုလှည့်ပတ်ရန် {homeLink} သို့ပြန်သွားကာ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့ပံ့ပိုးသည့်နိုင်ငံပေါင်း 200+ ကိုရွေးချယ်ပါ သို့မဟုတ် {countriesLink} ကိုရှာဖွေပါ။

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ FreeTV Garden သည် အွန်လိုင်းတွင် အများသူငှာရရှိနိုင်သည့် Free-to-Air (FTA) ချန်နယ်များကို စုစည်းထားသည်။ ကြည့်ရှုရန် စာရင်းသွင်းခြင်း၊ အကောင့် သို့မဟုတ် အက်ပ်မလိုအပ်ပါ။

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: FreeTV Garden တွင် ချန်နယ် {countryName} လိုင်းမည်မျှရှိသည်

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: လောလောဆယ် {count} တိုက်ရိုက်ချန်နယ်များဝန်းကျင်၊ {categories} ကဲ့သို့သော အမျိုးအစားများ ကျယ်ဝန်းသည်။

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: အများသူငှာ တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်မှုများနှင့် အော့ဖ်လိုင်းများပေါ်နေသဖြင့် ချန်နယ်အရေအတွက်သည် မကြာခဏ ပြောင်းလဲတတ်သည် — ယခု တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်နေသည့်အရာကို ကြည့်ရန် အထက်ပါကိရိယာကို ဖွင့်ပါ။

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: အချို့သော {countryName} ချန်နယ်များသည် အဘယ်ကြောင့် ကြားခံ သို့မဟုတ် တင်ရန် ပျက်ကွက်သနည်း။

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: သင်သည် ရုပ်မြင်သံကြား၏ ကိုယ်ပိုင်ဆာဗာသို့ တိုက်ရိုက်ချိတ်ဆက်နေသောကြောင့် မြန်နှုန်းနှင့် ယုံကြည်စိတ်ချရမှုသည် ကျွန်ုပ်တို့၏အခြေခံအဆောက်အအုံမဟုတ်ဘဲ ၎င်းတို့၏အခြေခံအဆောက်အအုံပေါ်တွင် မူတည်ပါသည်။ ချန်နယ်တစ်ခု မဖွင့်ပါက အခြားစာရင်းမှ နောက်တစ်ခုကို စမ်းကြည့်ပါ။

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: ကျွန်ုပ်၏ဖုန်းပေါ်တွင် {countryName} သတင်းချန်နယ်များကို တိုက်ရိုက်ကြည့်ရှုနိုင်ပါသလား။

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ဟုတ်သည် — ပလေယာသည် အက်ပ်ဒေါင်းလုဒ်မရှိသော မည်သည့်ဖုန်းဘရောက်ဆာတွင်မဆို အလုပ်လုပ်ပါသည်။ ဤစာမျက်နှာကိုဖွင့်ပါ၊ သတင်းချန်နယ်တစ်ခုကိုနှိပ်ပါ၊ အကောင်းဆုံးကြည့်ရှုရန်အတွက် မျက်နှာပြင်အပြည့်ကိုသုံးပါ။

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeSeeCountriesLink1.translated: နိုင်ငံစာရင်း

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် Play Store သို့မဟုတ် App Store တွင်မဟုတ်ပါ — ၎င်းသည် တစ်ချက်နှိပ်ရုံဖြင့် သင့်ဘရောက်ဆာမှ တိုက်ရိုက်ထည့်သွင်းပေးမည်ဖြစ်သည်။

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome (သို့မဟုတ် ဝဘ်ထည့်သွင်းမှုများကို ပံ့ပိုးပေးသည့် အခြားဘရောက်ဆာ) ကိုဖွင့်ပြီး freetvgarden.com သို့သွားပါ။ လိပ်စာဘားတွင် ထည့်သွင်းသည့်အိုင်ကွန်ကို ရှာပါ၊ သို့မဟုတ် ဘရောက်ဆာမီနူးကိုဖွင့်ပြီး "ပင်မစာမျက်နှာသို့ ပေါင်းထည့်ရန်" / "အက်ပ်ကို ထည့်သွင်းပါ။" ထို့နောက်တွင် FreeTV Garden သည် Play Store မှဒေါင်းလုဒ်လုပ်ရန်မလိုအပ်ဘဲ မူရင်းအက်ပ်ကဲ့သို့ သင့်ပင်မစခရင်မှ မျက်နှာပြင်အပြည့်ဖွင့်ပါမည်။

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Safari တွင် freetvgarden.com ကိုဖွင့်ပါ။ မျှဝေခြင်းအိုင်ကွန်ကို နှိပ်ပါ၊ ထို့နောက် "ပင်မစခရင်သို့ ထည့်ပါ။" ၎င်းသည် ဝဘ်ဆိုက်ကို မျက်နှာပြင်အပြည့်ဖွင့်ပေးသည့် သင့် iPhone သို့မဟုတ် iPad သို့ အက်ပ်အိုင်ကွန်ကို ပေါင်းထည့်သည် — App Store စာရင်းမလိုအပ်ဘဲ အပ်ဒိတ်လုပ်ရန် ဘာမျှမရှိပါ။

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: သင့် TV ၏ built-in browser ကိုဖွင့်ပြီး freetvgarden.com သို့သွားပါ။ သင့် TV တွင် အသုံးပြုနိုင်သော ဘရောက်ဆာမရှိပါက၊ ၎င်းအစား မျက်နှာပြင်ကြီးပေါ်တွင် ကြည့်ရှုရန် Chromecast သို့မဟုတ် AirPlay ကို အသုံးပြု၍ သင့်ဖုန်း သို့မဟုတ် လက်ပ်တော့မှ စာမျက်နှာကို ကာစ်စ်လုပ်ပါ။

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Silk Browser ကိုဖွင့်ပါ (Fire TV စက်များတွင် ကြိုတင်ထည့်သွင်းထားသည့် သို့မဟုတ် Amazon Appstore မှအခမဲ့) ကိုဖွင့်ပြီး freetvgarden.com သို့သွားပါ။ နိုင်ငံတစ်ခု သို့မဟုတ် အမျိုးအစားတစ်ခုကို ရွေးချယ်ပြီး စတင်ကြည့်ရှုပါ — စာရင်းသွင်းမှု သို့မဟုတ် နောက်ထပ်အက်ပ်မလိုအပ်ပါ။

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: မည်သည့်ခေတ်မီဒက်စ်တော့ဘရောက်ဆာမဆိုအလုပ်လုပ်သည် — freetvgarden.com သို့ဝင်ရောက်ကြည့်ရှုပါ။ Chrome သို့မဟုတ် Edge တွင်၊ ၎င်းကို desktop အက်ပ်တစ်ခုအဖြစ် ထည့်ရန် လိပ်စာဘားတွင် ထည့်သွင်းရန် အိုင်ကွန်တစ်ခု ပေါ်လာသည်။ သို့မဟုတ်ပါက ၎င်းသည် ပုံမှန်ဘရောက်ဆာ တက်ဘ်တစ်ခုကဲ့သို့ ကောင်းမွန်စွာ အလုပ်လုပ်ပါသည်။

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Garden က တကယ်အခမဲ့လား။

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ အကောင့်ဖွင့်ခြင်း၊ စာရင်းသွင်းခြင်း မရှိခြင်းနှင့် မည်သည့်အချိန်တွင် ငွေပေးချေမှုမှ မရှိပါ — နိုင်ငံတစ်ခု သို့မဟုတ် ချန်နယ်ကို ရွေးချယ်ပြီး စတင်ကြည့်ရှုလိုက်ပါ။

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden သည် FreeTV Garden နှင့် တူညီပါသလား။

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: နံပါတ်၊ မူရင်း tv.garden ကို 2026 ခုနှစ်တွင် Famelack သို့ ပြန်လည်တံဆိပ်တပ်ခဲ့ပြီး TV Garden အမည်ကို အသုံးမပြုတော့ပါ။ FreeTV Garden သည် Famelack သို့မဟုတ် မူရင်း tv.garden နှင့် မသက်ဆိုင်သော သီးခြား၊ အမှီအခိုကင်းသော လည်ပတ်သည့်ဆိုက်တစ်ခုဖြစ်သည်။

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် TV Garden ကဲ့သို့ တူညီသောအင်္ဂါရပ်များ ရှိပါသလား။

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ အပေါင်း FreeTV Garden တွင် တူညီသောလှည့်ပတ်-the-globe၊ ရွေးချယ်-a-country အတွေ့အကြုံ၊ ဘာသာစကား 84+ စစ်ထုတ်မှုများ၊ အကြောင်းအရာ 25+ အမျိုးအစား၊ ရုပ်ပုံတစ်ပုံချင်းပြန်ဖွင့်ခြင်း၊ သင်ကြယ်ပွင့်နှင့် ပြန်လည်ကြည့်ရှုနိုင်သော အကြိုက်ဆုံးများ၊ ကျပန်းချန်နယ်ခလုတ်တစ်ခုနှင့် Chrome သို့မဟုတ် Safari မှ တိုက်ရိုက်ထည့်သွင်းခြင်းတို့ကို တစ်ချက်နှိပ်ရုံပါ — အက်ပ်စတိုးမလိုအပ်ပါ။

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden တွင် ရေဒီယိုနှင့် ဝဘ်ကင်မရာများ ရှိပါသလား။

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ FreeTV Garden တွင် Pop၊ Jazz နှင့် Talk ကဲ့သို့သော အမျိုးအစားများအလိုက် တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်သည့် ဘူတာများပါသည့် ရေဒီယိုတဘ်တစ်ခုနှင့် ကမ္ဘာတစ်ဝှမ်းမှ တိုက်ရိုက်ကင်မရာဖိဒ်များပါရှိသော Webcam တက်ဘ်တစ်ခုလည်း ရှိပါသည်။ ကမ္ဘာလုံးဆိုင်ရာ အထက်ရှိ တဘ်များကို ပြောင်းပါ။

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် radio.garden နှင့် မည်သို့ကွာခြားသနည်း။

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် radio.garden နှင့် မသက်ဆိုင်သော သီးခြား၊ အမှီအခိုကင်းစွာ လုပ်ဆောင်သည့် ပရောဂျက်တစ်ခုဖြစ်သည်။ ၎င်းသည် ရိုးရှင်းသော၊ ပိုမိုလွယ်ကူသော လမ်းကြောင်းပြမှုနှင့်အတူ ပိုမိုလွယ်ကူသော အင်တာဖေ့စ်ကို ပေးဆောင်ပြီး တူညီသော အခမဲ့ တစ်ချက်နှိပ်ကိရိယာဖြင့် တည်ဆောက်ထားသော တိုက်ရိုက်လွှင့် TV နှင့် ဝဘ်ကင်မရာများဖြင့် ရေဒီယိုကို ကျော်လွန်သွားပါသည်။

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo ရှိ FreeTool TV Garden စာမျက်နှာဟောင်းတွင် ဘာဖြစ်ခဲ့သနည်း။

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: ဤနေရာတွင် ပြန်လည်စတင်ခဲ့သည်။ freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden တွင် နေထိုင်ခဲ့ဖူးသော စာမျက်နှာသည် ယခု ၎င်း၏ကိုယ်ပိုင်အမည်နှင့် ဒိုမိန်း- FreeTV Garden အောက်တွင် လုပ်ဆောင်နေသည့် အလားတူပရောဂျက်ဖြစ်သည်။

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: အကောင့်တစ်ခုဖန်တီးရန် လိုအပ်ပါသလား။

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: အကောင့်မလိုအပ်ပါ။ FreeTV Garden သည် ကြည့်ရှုရန် အီးမေးလ်၊ စကားဝှက် သို့မဟုတ် ကိုယ်ရေးကိုယ်တာအသေးစိတ်အချက်အလက်များကို မတောင်းပါ။

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: မိုဘိုင်းတွင် အလုပ်လုပ်ပါသလား။

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: ဟုတ်သည် — FreeTV Garden သည် Android သို့မဟုတ် iPhone ရှိ ခေတ်မီမိုဘိုင်းဘရောက်ဆာတွင် အလုပ်လုပ်ပြီး တစ်ချက်နှိပ်ရုံဖြင့် ဝင်ရောက်အသုံးပြုနိုင်ရန် သင့်ပင်မစခရင်တွင် ထည့်သွင်းနိုင်သည် (အထက်တွင် ထည့်သွင်းခြင်းကဏ္ဍကို ကြည့်ပါ)။

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: ချန်နယ်တစ်ခုသည် အဘယ်ကြောင့် "မရနိုင်ပါ" ကို ပြသနေရသနည်း။

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ချန်နယ်များသည် အများသူငှာ ထုတ်လွှင့်သူများထံမှ တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်မှုများဖြစ်ပြီး အချို့သော ထုတ်လွှင့်သူ၏ ကိုယ်ပိုင်ဆာဗာပြဿနာများကြောင့် အော့ဖ်လိုင်းတွင် ခေတ္တပိတ်ထားပါသည်။ အခြားချန်နယ်ကို စမ်းကြည့်ပါ သို့မဟုတ် နောက်မှ ပြန်စစ်ဆေးကြည့်ပါ — အများစုသည် မိနစ်အနည်းငယ်မှ နာရီပိုင်းအတွင်း ပြန်လာကြသည်။

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: တိုက်ရိုက်ကြည့်ရှုရန် တရားဝင်ဖြစ်ပါသလား။

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် အများသူငှာရရှိနိုင်သော တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်မှုများကို စုစည်းထားပါသည် — အဓိကအားဖြင့် iptv-org ကွန်မြူနတီလမ်းညွှန်မှ — နှင့် မည်သည့်ဗီဒီယိုဖိုင်ကိုမျှ ကိုယ်တိုင်ကျင်းပခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် သိမ်းဆည်းခြင်းမပြုပါ။ ပိုမိုသိရှိနိုင်စေရန် အောက်ဖော်ပြပါ ဥပဒေနှင့် လုံခြုံရေးကဏ္ဍကို ကြည့်ပါ။

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: {link1} အပြည့်အစုံတွင် နောက်ထပ်မေးခွန်းများကို ဖြေကြားပေးပါသည်။

seo.homeFaqMoreLink1.translated: FAQ စာမျက်နှာ

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden သည် iptv-org ကွန်မြူနတီလမ်းညွှန်အပါအဝင် အခမဲ့၊ အများသူငှာ အရင်းအမြစ်များမှ အများသူငှာရရှိနိုင်သော တိုက်ရိုက်ထုတ်လွှင့်မှုများကို စုစည်းထားသည်။ ၎င်းသည် မည်သည့် ဗီဒီယို သို့မဟုတ် အသံဖိုင်များကိုမျှ သိုလှောင်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် သိမ်းဆည်းခြင်း မပြုပါ၊ အသုံးပြုရန် အကောင့်တစ်ခု မလိုအပ်ပါ။

seo.homePrivacy.translated: ကိုယ်ရေးကိုယ်တာ

seo.homeContactP.translated: မေးခွန်းများ၊ အကြံပြုချက် သို့မဟုတ် အကြံပြုရန် ချန်နယ်တစ်ခုလား။ အီးမေးလ် {link1} ။

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channel, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: របៀបមើលទូរទស្សន៍ {countryName} នៅលើឧបករណ៍របស់អ្នក។

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: មិនចាំបាច់មានកម្មវិធី ឬគណនីដើម្បីមើលប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} ទេ។ ទំព័រនេះដំណើរការដោយផ្ទាល់នៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតរបស់អ្នកនៅលើឧបករណ៍ណាមួយ - គ្រាន់តែប៉ះឆានែលមួយហើយចុចលេង។

seo.platformAndroid.translated: ប្រព័ន្ធប្រតិបត្តិការ Android៖

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: បើកទំព័រនេះនៅក្នុង Chrome ចុចឆានែល {countryName} ដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមមើល បន្ទាប់មកប្រើប៊ូតុងពេញអេក្រង់សម្រាប់ការមើលដ៏ល្អបំផុត។ សម្រាប់ការចូលប្រើរហ័សនៅពេលក្រោយ សូមចុចលើម៉ឺនុយ Chrome ហើយជ្រើសរើស "បន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើម" ដើម្បីបង្កើតរូបតំណាងដូចកម្មវិធី។

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: បើកទំព័រនេះនៅក្នុង Safari ហើយប៉ះឆានែល {countryName} ណាមួយដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមការផ្សាយភ្លាមៗ។ ប៉ះរូបតំណាងចែករំលែក ហើយជ្រើសរើស "បន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើម" សម្រាប់ការចូលប្រើដោយចុចតែម្តង ដោយមិនចាំបាច់ទាញយកកម្មវិធីពី App Store ។

seo.platformDesktop.translated: កុំព្យូទ័រ និង Mac៖

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: កម្មវិធីរុករកទំនើបណាមួយដំណើរការ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ឬ Edge ។ បើកប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} ហើយប្រើរូបតំណាងពេញអេក្រង់នៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីចាក់ ដើម្បីទទួលបានបទពិសោធន៍មើលដូចទូរទស្សន៍គ្មានការរំខាន។

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: បើកទំព័រនេះនៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតដែលភ្ជាប់មកជាមួយទូរទស្សន៍របស់អ្នក ឬបោះវាចេញពីទូរសព្ទ ឬកុំព្យូទ័រយួរដៃរបស់អ្នកដោយប្រើ Chromecast ឬ AirPlay ដើម្បីមើលប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} នៅលើអេក្រង់ធំ។

seo.countryAnotherH2.translated: ចង់បានប៉ុស្តិ៍ពីប្រទេសផ្សេងទេ?

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ត្រលប់ទៅ {homeLink} ដើម្បីបង្វិលពិភពលោក 3D អន្តរកម្ម ហើយជ្រើសរើសប្រទេសណាមួយក្នុងចំណោម 200+ ប្រទេសដែលយើងគាំទ្រ ឬរុករក {countriesLink} ។

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: តើការមើលទូរទស្សន៍ {countryName} នៅលើ FreeTV Garden ឥតគិតថ្លៃទេ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: បាទ។ FreeTV Garden ប្រមូលផ្តុំបណ្តាញ Free-to-Air (FTA) ដែលមានជាសាធារណៈតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិត។ មិនចាំបាច់ជាវ គណនី ឬកម្មវិធីដើម្បីមើលទេ។

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: តើ FreeTV Garden មានប៉ុស្តិ៍ {countryName} ប៉ុន្មាន?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: បច្ចុប្បន្ននៅជុំវិញ {count} ឆានែលបន្តផ្ទាល់ វិសាលភាពប្រភេទដូចជា {categories} ។

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ចំនួនឆានែលផ្លាស់ប្តូរជាញឹកញាប់នៅពេលដែលការផ្សាយជាសាធារណៈបន្ត និងក្រៅបណ្តាញ — បើកឧបករណ៍ខាងលើដើម្បីមើលអ្វីដែលកំពុងផ្សាយបន្តផ្ទាល់ឥឡូវនេះ។

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: បញ្ជីនេះធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិពីថត iptv-org សាធារណៈ។

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ហេតុអ្វីបានជាឆានែល {countryName} មួយចំនួនមានសតិបណ្ដោះអាសន្ន ឬបរាជ័យក្នុងការផ្ទុក?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: បើក Chrome (ឬកម្មវិធីរុករកផ្សេងទៀតដែលគាំទ្រការដំឡើងគេហទំព័រ) ហើយចូលទៅកាន់ freetvgarden.com ។ រកមើលរូបតំណាងដំឡើងនៅក្នុងរបារអាសយដ្ឋាន ឬបើកម៉ឺនុយកម្មវិធីរុករកហើយជ្រើសរើស "បន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើម" / "ដំឡើងកម្មវិធី" ។ បន្ទាប់មក FreeTV Garden នឹងបើកពេញអេក្រង់ពីអេក្រង់ដើមរបស់អ្នក ដូចកម្មវិធីដើមដែរ ដោយមិនចាំបាច់ទាញយកពី Play Store ទេ។

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: បើក freetvgarden.com នៅក្នុង Safari ។ ប៉ះរូបតំណាងចែករំលែក បន្ទាប់មក "បន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើម"។ វាបន្ថែមរូបតំណាងកម្មវិធីទៅ iPhone ឬ iPad របស់អ្នកដែលបើកដំណើរការគេហទំព័រពេញអេក្រង់ — មិនត្រូវការបញ្ជី App Store និងគ្មានអ្វីដែលត្រូវបន្តធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពទេ។

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: បើកកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតដែលភ្ជាប់មកជាមួយទូរទស្សន៍របស់អ្នក ហើយចូលទៅកាន់ freetvgarden.com ។ ប្រសិនបើទូរទស្សន៍របស់អ្នកមិនមានកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមអ៊ីនធឺណិតដែលអាចប្រើបានទេ សូមខាសទំព័រចេញពីទូរស័ព្ទ ឬកុំព្យូទ័រយួរដៃរបស់អ្នកដោយប្រើ Chromecast ឬ AirPlay ដើម្បីមើលនៅលើអេក្រង់ធំជំនួសវិញ។

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: បើកកម្មវិធីរុករកសូត្រ (ដំឡើងជាមុននៅលើឧបករណ៍ Fire TV ឬឥតគិតថ្លៃពី Amazon Appstore) ហើយចូលទៅកាន់ freetvgarden.com ។ ជ្រើសរើសប្រទេស ឬប្រភេទ ហើយចាប់ផ្តើមមើល — មិនត្រូវការការជាវ ឬកម្មវិធីបន្ថែមទេ។

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: កម្មវិធីរុករកកុំព្យូទ័រទំនើបណាមួយដំណើរការ - គ្រាន់តែចូលទៅកាន់គេហទំព័រ freetvgarden.com ។ នៅក្នុង Chrome ឬ Edge រូបតំណាងដំឡើងនឹងបង្ហាញនៅក្នុងរបារអាសយដ្ឋាន ដើម្បីបន្ថែមវាជាកម្មវិធីកុំព្យូទ័រ។ បើមិនដូច្នេះទេ វាដំណើរការល្អដូចផ្ទាំងកម្មវិធីរុករកធម្មតា។

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: តើ FreeTV Garden ពិតជាឥតគិតថ្លៃមែនទេ?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: បាទ។ មិនមានការចុះឈ្មោះ គ្មានការជាវ និងមិនមានការទូទាត់នៅពេលណាមួយ — គ្រាន់តែជ្រើសរើសប្រទេស ឬប៉ុស្តិ៍ ហើយចាប់ផ្តើមមើល។

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: តើ tv.garden ដូចគ្នានឹង FreeTV Garden ដែរទេ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: លេខ tv.garden ដើមបានប្តូរឈ្មោះទៅជា Famelack ក្នុងឆ្នាំ 2026 ហើយលែងប្រើឈ្មោះ TV Garden ទៀតហើយ។ FreeTV Garden គឺជាគេហទំព័រដែលដំណើរការដោយឯករាជ្យ ដាច់ដោយឡែកមួយ - មិនមានទំនាក់ទំនងជាមួយ Famelack ឬ tv.garden ដើមទេ។

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: តើ FreeTV Garden មានមុខងារដូច TV Garden ដែរឬទេ?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: បាទ បូកបន្ថែម។ FreeTV Garden មានបទពិសោធន៍បង្វិលជុំវិញពិភពលោក បទពិសោធន៍ជ្រើសរើសប្រទេសមួយ រួមជាមួយនឹងតម្រងភាសា 84+ ប្រភេទមាតិកា 25+ ការចាក់សារថ្មីដោយរូបភាពក្នុងរូបភាព ចំណូលចិត្តដែលអ្នកអាចដាក់ផ្កាយ និងទស្សនាឡើងវិញ ប៊ូតុងឆានែលចៃដន្យ និងដំឡើងតែម្តងគត់ដោយផ្ទាល់ពី Chrome ឬ Safari — មិនត្រូវការហាងកម្មវិធីទេ។

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: តើ FreeTV Garden ក៏មានវិទ្យុ និងគេហទំព័រខេមដែរឬទេ?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: បាទ។ FreeTV Garden ក៏មានផ្ទាំងវិទ្យុដែលមានស្ថានីយ៍ផ្សាយបន្តផ្ទាល់តាមប្រភេទដូចជា Pop, Jazz, និង Talk និងផ្ទាំង Webcam ដែលមានការផ្សាយតាមកាមេរ៉ាផ្ទាល់ពីជុំវិញពិភពលោក។ ប្តូរផ្ទាំងពីលើពិភពលោក។

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: តើ FreeTV Garden ខុសពី radio.garden យ៉ាងដូចម្តេច?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden គឺជាគម្រោងដាច់ដោយឡែក ដំណើរការដោយឯករាជ្យ - មិនមានទំនាក់ទំនងជាមួយ radio.garden ទេ។ វាផ្តល់នូវចំណុចប្រទាក់ងាយស្រួល និងវិចារណញាណជាងមុនជាមួយនឹងការរុករកកាន់តែងាយស្រួល និងហួសពីវិទ្យុជាមួយនឹងទូរទស្សន៍ផ្សាយបន្តផ្ទាល់ និងកាមេរ៉ាបណ្ដាញដែលបានបង្កើតឡើងនៅក្នុងឧបករណ៍ឥតគិតថ្លៃតែមួយដង។

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: តើមានអ្វីកើតឡើងចំពោះទំព័រ FreeTool TV Garden ចាស់នៅលើ Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: វាបានបើកដំណើរការឡើងវិញនៅទីនេះ។ ទំព័រដែលធ្លាប់រស់នៅ freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden គឺជាគម្រោងដូចគ្នា ដែលឥឡូវនេះដំណើរការក្រោមឈ្មោះ និងដែនផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់វា៖ FreeTV Garden។

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: តើខ្ញុំត្រូវការបង្កើតគណនីទេ?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: មិនចាំបាច់មានគណនីទេ។ FreeTV Garden មិនសុំអ៊ីមែល ពាក្យសម្ងាត់ ឬព័ត៌មានលម្អិតផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនណាមួយដើម្បីមើលទេ។

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: តើវាដំណើរការលើទូរសព្ទដៃទេ?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: បាទ — FreeTV Garden ដំណើរការនៅក្នុងកម្មវិធីរុករកតាមទូរស័ព្ទទំនើបណាមួយនៅលើ Android ឬ iPhone ហើយអាចត្រូវបានបន្ថែមទៅអេក្រង់ដើមរបស់អ្នកសម្រាប់ការចូលប្រើដោយចុចតែម្តង (សូមមើលផ្នែកដំឡើងខាងលើ)។

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: ហេតុអ្វីបានជាប៉ុស្តិ៍បង្ហាញ "មិនអាចប្រើបាន"?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ប៉ុស្តិ៍​គឺ​ជា​ការ​ផ្សាយ​បន្ត​ផ្ទាល់​ដែល​បាន​មក​ពី​អ្នក​ផ្សាយ​ជា​សាធារណៈ ដូច្នេះ​ខ្លះ​ទៅ​ក្រៅ​អ៊ីនធឺណិត​បណ្ដោះ​អាសន្ន​ដោយ​សារ​បញ្ហា​ម៉ាស៊ីន​មេ​ផ្ទាល់​របស់​អ្នក​ផ្សាយ។ សាកល្បងឆានែលផ្សេងទៀត ឬពិនិត្យមើលឡើងវិញនៅពេលក្រោយ — ភាគច្រើនត្រឡប់មកវិញក្នុងរយៈពេលពីរបីនាទីទៅម៉ោង។

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: តើ​ការ​ផ្សាយ​មាន​ច្បាប់​សម្រាប់​មើល​ដែរ​ឬ​ទេ?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden ប្រមូលផ្តុំការផ្សាយបន្តផ្ទាល់ដែលមានជាសាធារណៈ — ជាចម្បងពីបញ្ជីសហគមន៍ iptv-org — ហើយមិនបង្ហោះ ឬរក្សាទុកឯកសារវីដេអូណាមួយដោយខ្លួនឯងទេ។ សូមមើលផ្នែកច្បាប់ និងសុវត្ថិភាពខាងក្រោមសម្រាប់បន្ថែម។

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: សំណួរជាច្រើនទៀតត្រូវបានឆ្លើយនៅលើ {link1} ពេញលេញ។

seo.homeFaqMoreLink1.translated: ទំព័រសំណួរគេសួរញឹកញាប់

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden ប្រមូលផ្តុំការផ្សាយបន្តផ្ទាល់ដែលមានជាសាធារណៈពីប្រភពសាធារណៈដោយឥតគិតថ្លៃ រួមទាំងបញ្ជីសហគមន៍ iptv-org ផងដែរ។ វាមិនបង្ហោះ ឬរក្សាទុកវីដេអូ ឬឯកសារអូឌីយ៉ូ និងមិនត្រូវការគណនីដើម្បីប្រើ។

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ໜ້ານີ້ເປັນສ່ວນໜຶ່ງຂອງ {siteLink}, ເຄື່ອງມືໂທລະພາບສົດຂອງພວກເຮົາທີ່ກວມເອົາ 1000+ ຊ່ອງຈາກ 200+ ປະເທດ. ທີ່ນີ້ເຄື່ອງມືເປີດໂດຍກົງຫາ {countryName} , ດັ່ງນັ້ນທ່ານສາມາດເລີ່ມເບິ່ງທັນທີໃນຕົວທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານ - ບໍ່ມີການລົງທະບຽນ, ບໍ່ມີແອັບຯ, ບໍ່ມີການສະຫມັກ, ແລະບໍ່ຈໍາເປັນຕ້ອງມີບັດເຄຣດິດ.

seo.countryWhatYouCanWatchH2.translated: ທ່ານສາມາດເບິ່ງຫຍັງໄດ້ຈາກ {countryName}

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: ຊ່ອງໂທລະພາບຟຣີຂອງ {countryName} ໄດ້ຖືກດຶງອອກມາຈາກຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ, ກວມເອົາໝວດໝູ່ເຊັ່ນຂ່າວ, ຄວາມບັນເທີງ, ກິລາ ແລະເພງທີ່ມີໃຫ້, ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ. ເຊັ່ນດຽວກັບຕົວຮວບຮວມແບບຟຣີຫາ-ອາກາດ, ລາຍຊື່ຊ່ອງທີ່ແນ່ນອນສາມາດປ່ຽນມື້ຕໍ່ວັນໄດ້ເນື່ອງຈາກການຖ່າຍທອດສົດຕໍ່ ແລະອອບລາຍ.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channel, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: ປະຈຸບັນ FreeTV Garden ລາຍຊື່ {count} ຊ່ອງ {countryName} ສົດ, ລວມທັງ {names} — ດຶງອອກສົດຈາກໄດເຣັກທໍຣີຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ. ເຊັ່ນດຽວກັບຕົວຮວບຮວມແບບຟຣີຫາ-ອາກາດ, ລາຍຊື່ຊ່ອງທີ່ແນ່ນອນສາມາດປ່ຽນມື້ຕໍ່ວັນໄດ້ເນື່ອງຈາກການຖ່າຍທອດສົດຕໍ່ ແລະອອບລາຍ.

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channels, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: ປະຈຸບັນ FreeTV Garden ລາຍຊື່ {count} ຊ່ອງ {countryName} ສົດ, ລວມທັງ {names} — ດຶງອອກສົດຈາກໄດເຣັກທໍຣີຊ່ອງ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ ແລະສາມາດຫຼິ້ນໄດ້ທັນທີໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍບໍ່ມີຊອບແວເພີ່ມເຕີມ. ເຊັ່ນດຽວກັບຕົວຮວບຮວມແບບຟຣີຫາ-ອາກາດ, ລາຍຊື່ຊ່ອງທີ່ແນ່ນອນສາມາດປ່ຽນມື້ຕໍ່ວັນໄດ້ເນື່ອງຈາກການຖ່າຍທອດສົດຕໍ່ ແລະອອບລາຍ.

seo.countryChannelsByCategoryH2.translated: {countryName} ຊ່ອງຕາມໝວດໝູ່

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: ວິທີເບິ່ງ {countryName} TV ໃນອຸປະກອນຂອງທ່ານ

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: ບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງໃຊ້ແອັບ ຫຼືບັນຊີເພື່ອເບິ່ງ {countryName} ຊ່ອງ. ຫນ້ານີ້ເຮັດວຽກໂດຍກົງໃນຕົວທ່ອງເວັບຂອງທ່ານໃນອຸປະກອນໃດກໍ່ຕາມ - ພຽງແຕ່ແຕະຊ່ອງແລະກົດຫຼິ້ນ.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: ເປີດໜ້ານີ້ໃນ Chrome, ແຕະຊ່ອງ {countryName} ເພື່ອເລີ່ມການເບິ່ງ, ຈາກນັ້ນໃຊ້ປຸ່ມເຕັມຈໍເພື່ອການເບິ່ງທີ່ດີທີ່ສຸດ. ສໍາລັບການເຂົ້າເຖິງດ່ວນໃນຄັ້ງຕໍ່ໄປ, ແຕະທີ່ເມນູ Chrome ແລະເລືອກ "ເພີ່ມໃສ່ໜ້າຈໍຫຼັກ" ເພື່ອສ້າງໄອຄອນທີ່ຄ້າຍຄືກັບແອັບຯ.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: ເປີດໜ້ານີ້ໃນ Safari ແລະແຕະຊ່ອງ {countryName} ໃດກໍໄດ້ເພື່ອເລີ່ມການຖ່າຍທອດທັນທີ. ແຕະທີ່ໄອຄອນ Share ແລະເລືອກ "Add to Home Screen" ສໍາລັບການເຂົ້າເຖິງຫນຶ່ງແຕະໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງດາວໂຫລດແອັບຯຈາກ App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ທຸກຕົວທ່ອງເວັບທີ່ທັນສະໄຫມເຮັດວຽກ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ຫຼື Edge. ເປີດຊ່ອງ {countryName} ແລະໃຊ້ໄອຄອນເຕັມຈໍໃນເຄື່ອງຫຼິ້ນເພື່ອປະສົບການການເບິ່ງແບບໂທລະພາບແບບບໍ່ມີສິ່ງລົບກວນ.

seo.platformSmartTV.translated: Smart TV ແລະ Fire Stick:

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: ເປີດໜ້ານີ້ຢູ່ໃນໂປຣແກຣມທ່ອງເວັບໃນຕົວຂອງໂທລະທັດຂອງທ່ານ, ຫຼືສົ່ງສັນຍານຈາກໂທລະສັບ ຫຼືແລັບທັອບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍໃຊ້ Chromecast ຫຼື AirPlay ເພື່ອເບິ່ງຊ່ອງ {countryName} ໃນໜ້າຈໍໃຫຍ່.

seo.countryAnotherH2.translated: ຕ້ອງການຊ່ອງຈາກປະເທດອື່ນບໍ?

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: ກັບຄືນໄປຫາ {homeLink} ເພື່ອໝຸນໂລກ 3D ແບບໂຕ້ຕອບ ແລະເລືອກອັນໃດກໍໄດ້ຈາກ 200+ ປະເທດທີ່ພວກເຮົາຮອງຮັບ, ຫຼືເລືອກເບິ່ງ {countriesLink} .

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: ເບິ່ງໂທລະພາບ {countryName} ຢູ່ FreeTV Garden ໄດ້ຟຣີບໍ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ. FreeTV Garden ລວບລວມຊ່ອງຟຣີຫາອາກາດ (FTA) ທີ່ມີໃຫ້ສາທາລະນະອອນໄລນ໌. ບໍ່ມີການສະໝັກໃຊ້, ບັນຊີ ຫຼື ແອັບທີ່ຕ້ອງການເພື່ອເບິ່ງ.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: FreeTV Garden ມີຊ່ອງ {countryName} ເທົ່າໃດ?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: ໃນປັດຈຸບັນປະມານ {count} ຊ່ອງສົດ, ກວມເອົາປະເພດເຊັ່ນ {categories} .

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ການນັບຊ່ອງມີການປ່ຽນແປງເລື້ອຍໆເມື່ອການຖ່າຍທອດສາທາລະນະຕໍ່ ແລະອອຟລາຍ — ເປີດເຄື່ອງມືຂ້າງເທິງເພື່ອເບິ່ງສິ່ງທີ່ມີຊີວິດຢູ່ໃນຕອນນີ້.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ບັນຊີລາຍຊື່ນີ້ປັບປຸງອັດຕະໂນມັດຈາກໄດເລກະທໍລີ iptv-org ສາທາລະນະ.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ເປັນຫຍັງບາງຊ່ອງ {countryName} ຈື່ງມີບັຟ ຫຼືໂຫຼດບໍ່ໄດ້?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: ທ່ານກໍາລັງເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ໂດຍກົງກັບເຄື່ອງແມ່ຂ່າຍຂອງຕົນເອງຂອງຜູ້ອອກອາກາດ, ດັ່ງນັ້ນຄວາມໄວແລະຄວາມຫນ້າເຊື່ອຖືແມ່ນຂຶ້ນກັບໂຄງສ້າງພື້ນຖານຂອງພວກເຂົາ, ບໍ່ແມ່ນຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ຖ້າຊ່ອງໜຶ່ງບໍ່ໂຫຼດ, ໃຫ້ລອງອີກຊ່ອງໜຶ່ງຈາກລາຍການ.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: ຂ້ອຍສາມາດເບິ່ງ {countryName} ຊ່ອງຂ່າວສົດຢູ່ໃນໂທລະສັບຂອງຂ້ອຍໄດ້ບໍ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ — ຜູ້ນເຮັດວຽກຢູ່ໃນທຸກຕົວທ່ອງເວັບຂອງໂທລະສັບໂດຍບໍ່ມີການດາວໂຫຼດ app. ພຽງ​ແຕ່​ເປີດ​ຫນ້າ​ນີ້​, ແຕະ​ຊ່ອງ​ຂ່າວ​, ແລະ​ນໍາ​ໃຊ້​ເຕັມ​ຫນ້າ​ຈໍ​ສໍາ​ລັບ​ການ​ເບິ່ງ​ທີ່​ດີ​ທີ່​ສຸດ​.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ນີ້ແມ່ນເວັບໄຊທ໌ທາງການຂອງ {countryName} ວິທະຍຸກະຈາຍສຽງບໍ?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ບໍ່. FreeTV Garden ເປັນໄດເລກະທໍລີເອກະລາດທີ່ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ກັບການຖ່າຍທອດສາທາລະນະ. ມັນບໍ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບ, ຮັບຮອງໂດຍ, ຫຼືດໍາເນີນການໂດຍຜູ້ອອກອາກາດໃດໆທີ່ມີລາຍຊື່ຢູ່ໃນຫນ້ານີ້.

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.

seo.faqOfficialAnswer.translated: ບໍ່. FreeTV Garden ເປັນໄດເລກະທໍລີເອກະລາດທີ່ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ກັບການຖ່າຍທອດສາທາລະນະ. ມັນບໍ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບ, ຮັບຮອງໂດຍ, ຫຼືດໍາເນີນການໂດຍ {channelName} .
